def verify_the_plugins_for_each_jl_images():
    for image in notebook_images:
        mistamtch_plugins = create_list()
        plugin_names = get_from_dictionary(temporary_data, image)
        old_notebok_plugin = get_from_dictionary(notebook_data, image)
        if len(plugin_names) >= len(old_notebok_plugin):
            for name in plugin_names:
                if name not in old_notebok_plugin:
                    append_to_list(mistamtch_plugins, name)
                else:
                    log(f"Plugin '{name}' has not changed")
            if mistamtch_plugins != EMPTY:
                set_to_dictionary(image_mismatch_plugins, image, mistamtch_plugins)
        else:
            missing_plugins = create_list()
            for name in old_notebok_plugin:
                if name not in plugin_names:
                    append_to_list(missing_plugins, name)
            run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('FAIL', f"Plugins '{missing_plugins}' has been removed from the '{image}' notebook image")

def verify_library_version_is_greater_than(library, target):
    ver = run_cell_and_get_output(f'!pip show {library} | grep Version: | awk \'{split($0,a); print a[2]}\' | awk \'{split($0,b,"."); printf "%s.%s.%s", b[1], b[2], b[3]}\'')
    comparison = gte(ver, target)
    if comparison==False:
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('FAIL', 'Library Version Is Smaller Than Expected')

def wait_until_jh_deployment_is_ready(retries=50):
    for index in range(0, f'1+{retries}'):
        JH = oc_get(kind='Pod', namespace=APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE, label_selector='deploymentconfig = jupyterhub')
        containerNames = create_list('jupyterhub', 'jupyterhub-ha-sidecar')
        jh_status = run_keyword_and_return_status('Verify JupyterHub Deployment', JH, 3, 2, containerNames)
        exit_for_loop_if('$jh_status == True')
        sleep('0.5')
    if jh_status == False:
        fail('Jupyter Deployment not ready. Checks the logs')
    sleep(1)

def query_model_with_grpcurl(host, port, endpoint, json_body, protobuf_file=NONE, input_filepath=NONE, json_header=NONE, insecure=FALSE, plaintext=FALSE, background=NONE, skip_res_json=FALSE, cert=False, connect_timeout=10, args):
    cmd = set_variable(f'grpcurl -connect-timeout {connect_timeout} -d {json_body}')
    if json_header != None:
        cmd = catenate(cmd, f'-H {json_header}')
    if insecure:
        cmd = catenate(cmd, '-insecure')
    else:
        if cert==False:
            log('The call will fail because you have not provided a valid CA bundle file')
        cmd = catenate(cmd, f'-cacert {cert}')
    if protobuf_file != NONE:
        cmd = catenate(cmd, f'-proto {protobuf_file}')
    if plaintext:
        cmd = catenate(cmd, '-plaintext')
    if input_filepath != NONE:
        cmd = catenate(cmd, f'< {input_filepath}')
    for index, option in enumerate(args):
        log(f'{index}: {option}: {args}[{option}]')
        cmd = catenate(cmd, f'-{option} {args}[{option}]')
    cmd = catenate(cmd, f'{host}:{port}')
    cmd = catenate(cmd, endpoint)
    if 'background' == 'NONE':
        log(cmd,console='yes')
        query_process = run_process(command=cmd, stderr='STDOUT', shell='yes')
        rc = set_variable(query_process.rc)
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Should Be Equal As Integers', rc, 0)
        log(query_process.stdout,console='yes')
        response = set_variable(query_process.stdout)
        log(response,console='yes')
        log(rc,console='yes')
        if rc != 0 or skip_res_json == TRUE:
            log(response)
            return response
        else:
            json_res = load_json_string(response)
            return json_res
    else:
        rc, response = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'{cmd}&')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Should Be Equal As Integers', rc, 0)

def verify_authentication_is_required_to_access_blackboxexporter_target(target_name, expected_endpoint_count):
    links = prometheus.get_target_endpoints(target_name=target_name, pm_url=RHODS_PROMETHEUS_URL, pm_token=RHODS_PROMETHEUS_TOKEN, username=OCP_ADMIN_USER.USERNAME, password=OCP_ADMIN_USER.PASSWORD)
    length_should_be(links, expected_endpoint_count,msg=f'Unexpected number of endpoints in blackbox-exporter target (target_name:{target_name})')
    pod_name = find_first_pod_by_name(namespace=MONITORING_NAMESPACE, pod_regex='prometheus-')
    for link in links:
        log(f'link:{link}')
        command = set_variable(f'curl --silent --insecure {link}')
        output = run_command_in_container(namespace=MONITORING_NAMESPACE, pod_name=pod_name, command=command, container_name='prometheus')
        should_contain(output, 'Log in with OpenShift',msg=f'Authentication not present in blackbox-exporter target (target_name:{target_name} link: {link})')

    seleniumlibrary.wait_until_page_contains('Select a model registry to view and manage your registered models.')
    maybe_wait_for_dashboard_loading_spinner_page()
    if allowed_user:
        loaded = run_keyword_and_return_status('SeleniumLibrary.Page Should Not Contain', 'Request access to model registries')
        while loaded!=TRUE:
            seleniumlibrary.reload_page()
            seleniumlibrary.wait_until_page_contains('Model Registry')
            seleniumlibrary.wait_until_page_contains('Select a model registry to view and manage your registered models.')
            loaded = run_keyword_and_return_status('SeleniumLibrary.Page Should Not Contain', 'Request access to model registries')
            sleep('10s')
    else:
        seleniumlibrary.page_should_contain('Request access to model registries')
    maybe_wait_for_dashboard_loading_spinner_page()

def rebuild_missing_or_failed_builds(builds, build_configs, namespace):
    no_of_builds = get_length(builds)
    for ind in range(no_of_builds):
        build_name = search_last_build(namespace=namespace, build_name_includes=f'{builds}[{ind}]')
        if build_name == "":
            build_name = start_new_build(namespace=namespace, buildconfig=f'{build_configs}[{ind}]')
        else:
            build_status = get_build_status(namespace=namespace, build_search_term=build_name)
            if build_status == "Failed" or build_status == "Error":
                delete_build(namespace=namespace, build_name=build_name)
                build_name = start_new_build(namespace=namespace, buildconfig=f'{build_configs}[{ind}]')
        wait_until_build_status_is(namespace=namespace, build_name=build_name, expected_status='Complete')

def apply_dscinitialization_customresource(dsci_name=DSCI_NAME):
    return_code, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output("oc get DSCInitialization --output json | jq -j '.items | length'")
    log_to_console(f'output : {output}, return_code : {return_code}')
    if output != 0:
        log_to_console('Skip creation of DSCInitialization')
        return
    file_path = set_variable('tasks/Resources/Files/')
    log_to_console('Requested Configuration:')
    create_dscinitialization_customresource_using_test_variables()
    yml = get_file(f'{file_path}dsci_apply.yml')
    log_to_console('Applying DSCI yaml')
    log_to_console(yml)
    return_code, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc apply -f {file_path}dsci_apply.yml')
    log_to_console(output)
    should_be_equal_as_integers(return_code, 0,msg='Error detected while applying DSCI CR')
    remove_file(f'{file_path}dsci_apply.yml')

def launch_and_access_workbench(workbench_title, username=TEST_USER_3.USERNAME, password=TEST_USER_3.PASSWORD, auth_type=TEST_USER_3.AUTH_TYPE):

    if is_started == TRUE:
        previous_handle = open_workbench(workbench_title=workbench_title)
        access_to_workbench(username=username, password=password, auth_type=auth_type)

        fail(msg=f'Cannot Launch And Access Workbench {workbench_title} because it is not running...')
    return previous_handle

def create_data_science_project_from_cli(name, display_name=EMPTY, description=EMPTY, as_user=EMPTY, randomize_name=FALSE):
    if randomize_name == TRUE:
        project_suffix = generate_random_string(4, '[NUMBERS]')
        complete_name = catenate(name, project_suffix,SEPARATOR='-')
    else:
        complete_name = set_variable(name)
        rc = run_and_return_rc(f'oc get project {complete_name}')
        if rc == 0:
            log(message=f'OpenShift Project {complete_name} already present. Skipping project creation...', level='WARN')
            return complete_name
    if display_name == EMPTY:
        display_name = set_variable(complete_name)
    if as_user != EMPTY:
        rc = run_and_return_rc(f'oc new-project "{complete_name}" --display-name="{display_name}" --description="{description}" --as={as_user} --as-group=system:authenticated --as-group=system:authenticated:oauth')
        should_be_equal_as_numbers(rc, 0)
    else:
        rc = run_and_return_rc(f'oc new-project "{complete_name}" --display-name="{display_name}" --description="{description}"')
        should_be_equal_as_numbers(rc, 0)
    run(f'oc label namespace {complete_name} opendatahub.io/dashboard=true')
    run(f'oc label namespace {complete_name} modelmesh-enabled=true')
    return complete_name

def get_list_of_ids_of_tiles():

def create_model_server(no_replicas=1, server_size='Small', ext_route=TRUE, token=TRUE, runtime='OpenVINO Model Server', server_name='Model Serving Test', no_gpus=0, existing_server=FALSE):
    move_to_tab('Models')
    if existing_server:
        existing_server = run_keyword_and_return_status('Wait Until Page Contains Element', f'//button[.="{server_name}"]')
        if existing_server:
            run_keyword_and_return('Log', f"Model Server '{server_name}' already exists, reusing server",console='True')
    else:
        seleniumlibrary.click_button('//button[@data-testid="multi-serving-select-button"]')
    seleniumlibrary.wait_until_page_contains('Select multi-model')
    seleniumlibrary.click_button('Select multi-model')
    seleniumlibrary.wait_until_page_contains('Add model server')
    seleniumlibrary.click_button('Add model server')
    seleniumlibrary.wait_until_page_contains_element('//span[.="Add model server"]')
    set_model_server_name(server_name)
    set_replicas_number_with_buttons(no_replicas)
    set_model_server_runtime(runtime)
    set_server_size(server_size)
    if no_gpus > 0:
        gpu_enabled = run_keyword_and_return_status('Verify GPU Selector Is Usable')
        if gpu_enabled==False:
            log('GPU requested but not available')
            fail()
        set_accelerator()
        set_number_of_gpu_with_buttons(no_gpus)
    if ext_route==TRUE:
        enable_external_serving_route()
        wait_until_page_contains_element(TOKEN_AUTH_CHECKBOX_XP,timeout='10s')
        if token==FALSE:
            disable_token_authentication()
        else:
            log(message='Token Auth should be enabled by default..(from v2.5)')
            seleniumlibrary.checkbox_should_be_selected(TOKEN_AUTH_CHECKBOX_XP)
    elif token==TRUE:
        enable_token_authentication()
    seleniumlibrary.wait_until_element_is_enabled('//button[contains(text(),"Add")]')
    seleniumlibrary.click_button('Add')
    sleep('1s',reason='Sometimes the modal will intercept later clicks even after being closed, wait for a second')

    fix_spawner_status()
    spawn_notebook_with_arguments(image='science-notebook')
    clone_git_repository_and_run(notebook_repo, notebook_path)
    sleep('5s')

def set_number_of_gpu_with_buttons(no_gpus):
    current = get_element_attribute(SERVING_ACCELERATOR_INPUT_XPATH, 'value')
    difference = evaluate(f'int({no_gpus})-int({current})')
    op = set_variable('plus')
    if difference<0:
        difference = evaluate(f'abs({difference})')
        op = set_variable('minus')
    for idx in range(difference):
        if 'op'=='plus':
            click_gpu_plus_button()
        else:
            click_gpu_minus_button()
    current = get_element_attribute(SERVING_ACCELERATOR_INPUT_XPATH, 'value')
    should_be_equal_as_integers(current, no_gpus)


def container_image_url_should_contain(namespace, pod, container, expected_image_url_substring):
    image = run(f'oc get pod {pod} -n {namespace} -o json | jq \'.spec.containers[] | select(.name == "{container}") | .image\'')
    should_contain(container=image, item=expected_image_url_substring, msg='Unexpected container image url')


def send_model_inference_request(namespace, model_name, inference_input, token):
    url = get_model_route_via_cli(model_name, namespace)
    token = generate_thanos_token()
    curl_cmd = set_variable(f'curl -sk {url} -d {inference_input}')
    curl_cmd = catenate(curl_cmd, f'-H "Authorization: Bearer {token}"')
    rc, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output(curl_cmd)
    should_contain(output, model_name)
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0, output)


def find_max_number_of_gpus_in_one_machineset():
    max_gpus = set_variable(0)
    machinesets = get_machinesets()
    for ms in machinesets:
        ms_gpu_num = run(f'oc get MachineSet {ms} -n openshift-machine-api -o json | jq \'.metadata.annotations["machine.openshift.io/GPU"]\' | sed \'s/"//g\'')
        ms_gpu_num = convert_to_integer(ms_gpu_num)
        if ms_gpu_num > max_gpus:
            max_gpus = set_variable(ms_gpu_num)
    return max_gpus

    wait_until_keyword_succeeds('8 min', '0 sec', 'Is Pod Ready', label_selector)

def get_pagerduty_key_from_alertmanager_configmap():

    match_list = get_regexp_matches(a_data, 'service_key(:).*')
    key = split_string(match_list[0])
    return key[-1]

def deploy_serving_runtime(namespace, runtime, protocol):
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc get ServingRuntime {runtime} -n {namespace}')
    if rc == 0:
        log(message=f'ServingRuntime {runtime} in {namespace} NS already present. Skipping runtime setup...', level='WARN')
        return
    runtime_final_filepath = replace_string(string=f'{RUNTIME_FLIEPATHS}[{runtime}]', search_for='{{protocol}}', replace_with=protocol)
    create_file_from_template(runtime_final_filepath, runtime_final_filepath)
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc apply -f {runtime_final_filepath} -n {namespace}')
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)


def serve_model(project_name, model_name, framework, data_connection_name, model_path, existing_data_connection=TRUE, model_server='Model Serving Test', existing_model=FALSE, serving_runtime=NONE):
    open_model_serving_home_page()
    switch_model_serving_project(project_name)
    if existing_model:
        model_row_xpath = set_variable(f"xpath://tr[starts-with(., '{model_name} ') and contains(., '{project_name}')]")
        existing_model = run_keyword_and_return_status('Wait Until Page Contains Element', model_row_xpath)
    if existing_model == TRUE:
        log(f"Model '{model_name}' already exists, editing model",console='True')
        odhdashboard.click_action_from_actions_menu(item_title=model_name, action='Edit')
    else:
        seleniumlibrary.wait_until_page_does_not_contain_element('//div[@id="multi-serving-platform-card"]')
        seleniumlibrary.wait_until_page_does_not_contain_element('//div[@id="single-serving-platform-card"]')
        maybe_wait_for_dashboard_loading_spinner_page()
        seleniumlibrary.wait_until_element_is_enabled(DEPLOY_MODEL_BTN)
        seleniumlibrary.click_button(DEPLOY_MODEL_BTN)
    seleniumlibrary.wait_until_page_contains_element('//div[@role="dialog"]')
    set_model_name(model_name)
    select_model_server(model_server)
    if serving_runtime != NONE:
        set_model_server_runtime(serving_runtime)
    seleniumlibrary.wait_until_page_contains_element('xpath://span[.="Model framework (name - version)"]')
    select_framework(framework)
    if existing_data_connection==TRUE:
        select_existing_data_connection(data_connection_name)
        set_folder_path(model_path)
    else:
        seleniumlibrary.click_element('//input[@id="new-data-connection-radio"]')
        set_up_new_data_connection(dc_name=data_connection_name)
        set_folder_path(model_path)
    seleniumlibrary.wait_until_element_is_enabled('//button[contains(text(),"Deploy")]')
    seleniumlibrary.click_button('Deploy')
    seleniumlibrary.wait_until_page_does_not_contain('xpath://h1[.="Deploy model"]')

def compare_rhods_versions():
    new_version = get_rhods_version()
    RHODS_VERSION_EXISTS = run_keyword_and_return_status('Variable Should Exist', RHODS_VERSION)
    if RHODS_VERSION_EXISTS:
        should_not_be_equal(new_version, RHODS_VERSION)
    else:
        fail('Upgrade has failed')
    set_global_variable(RHODS_VERSION, new_version)


def verify_the_resources_are_filtered(list_of_items=NONE, expected_types=NONE, expected_providers=NONE, expected_number=NONE):
    if list_of_items != NONE:
        exp_n_results = get_length(list_of_items)
    else:
        exp_n_results = set_variable(expected_number)
    items, _ = number_of_items_should_be(expected_number=exp_n_results)
    for item in items:
        texts = split_string(item.text, '\n')
        if list_of_items != NONE:
            run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('List Should Contain Value', list_of_items, f'{texts}[0]')
        if expected_types != NONE:
            version_check = is_rhods_version_greater_or_equal_than('1.21.0')
            if version_check==True:
                versioned_type = get_text(xpath="//ul[@aria-label='Label group category']/li[1]")
            else:
                versioned_type = set_variable(f'{texts}[2]')
            run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('List Should Contain Value', expected_types, versioned_type)
        if expected_providers != NONE:
            run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('List Should Contain Value', expected_providers, f'{texts}[1]')


def get_the_list_of_plugins_from_rhods_notebook_images():
    for image in notebook_images:
        spawn_notebook_with_arguments(image=image, size='Small')
        temp_data = get_install_plugin_list_from_jupyterlab()
        py_version = run(f'oc exec {notebook_pod_name} -n {NOTEBOOKS_NAMESPACE} -- python --version')
        python_image = split_string_from_right(py_version, '.', 1)
        append_to_list(temp_data, f'{python_image}[0]')
        log(temp_data)
        set_to_dictionary(temporary_data, image, temp_data)
        stop_jupyterlab_notebook_server()
        sleep(3)


def new_lines_in_logs_of_dashboard_pods_should_contain(exp_msg, prev_logs_lengths):
    new_logs_lengths = create_dictionary()
    for index, pod_name in enumerate(DASHBOARD_PODS_NAMES):
        log(pod_name)
        pod_log_lines_new, n_lines_new = wait_until_new_log_lines_are_generated_in_a_dashboard_pod(prev_length=f'{prev_logs_lengths}[{pod_name}]', pod_name=pod_name)
        set_to_dictionary(new_logs_lengths, pod_name, n_lines_new)
        log(pod_log_lines_new)
        for line_idx, line in enumerate(pod_log_lines_new):
            run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Should Contain',container=line, item=exp_msg)
    return new_logs_lengths

def create_starburst_enteprise_license_secret():
    secret_filepath = set_variable(f'{FILES_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/starburst-secret.yaml')
    copy_file(SEP_SECRET_TEMPLATE_FILEPATH, secret_filepath)
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'sed -i\'\' -e "s/<NAMESPACE>/{NAMESPACE}/g" {secret_filepath}')
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'sed -i\'\' -e "s/<VALUE>/{STARBURST.LICENSE_ENCODED}/g" {secret_filepath}')
    oc_apply(kind='Secret', src=secret_filepath)
    remove_file(secret_filepath)

def get_card_texts(card_locator, badges_title=EMPTY):
    log(badges_title)
    if "Red Hat managed" in badges_title:
        title_xp_mod = set_variable(f'{TITLE_XP}/..')
    else:
        title_xp_mod = set_variable(TITLE_XP)
    title = get_text(f'xpath:{card_locator}/{title_xp_mod}')
    if "Red Hat managed" in badges_title:
        title = replace_string(string=title, search_for='\n', replace_with=EMPTY)
        title = split_string(string=title, separator='by', max_split=1)
        title = set_variable(title[0])
    provider = get_text(f'xpath:{card_locator}/{PROVIDER_XP}')
    desc = get_text(f'xpath:{card_locator}/{DESCR_XP}')
    return title, provider, desc

def wait_until_rhods_uninstallation_is_completed(retries=1, retries_interval='2min'):
    for retry_idx in range(0, f'1+{retries}'):
        log_to_console(f'checking RHODS uninstall status: retry {retry_idx}')
        ns_deleted = run_keyword_and_return_status('RHODS Namespaces Should Not Exist')
        exit_for_loop_if('$ns_deleted == True')
        sleep(retries_interval)
    if ns_deleted == False:
        fail(f'RHODS didn\'t get "complete" stage after {retries} retries', f'(time between retries: {retries_interval}). Check the cluster..')

        set_suite_variable(AUTHORINO_CR_NS, 'redhat-ods-applications-auth-provider')

        set_suite_variable(DASHBOARD_LABEL_SELECTOR, 'app.kubernetes.io/part-of=rhods-dashboard')
        set_suite_variable(APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE, 'redhat-ods-applications')
        set_suite_variable(OPERATOR_SUBSCRIPTION_NAME, 'rhoai-operator-dev')
        set_suite_variable(MODEL_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE, 'rhoai-model-registries')
    elif PRODUCT == "ODH":
        set_suite_variable(OPERATOR_APPNAME, '"Open Data Hub Operator"')
        set_suite_variable(OPERATOR_DEPLOYMENT_NAME, 'opendatahub-operator-controller-manager')

        set_suite_variable(OPERATOR_SUBSCRIPTION_LABEL, 'operators.coreos.com/rhods-operator.opendatahub-operators')
        set_suite_variable(AUTHORINO_CR_NS, 'opendatahub-auth-provider')
        set_suite_variable(DASHBOARD_DEPLOYMENT_NAME, 'odh-dashboard')
        set_suite_variable(DASHBOARD_LABEL_SELECTOR, 'app.kubernetes.io/part-of=dashboard')
        set_suite_variable(APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE, 'opendatahub')

        set_suite_variable(MODEL_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE, 'odh-model-registries')

def get_all_strings_that_contain(list_of_strings, substring_to_search):
    matched_list = create_list()
    for str in list_of_strings:
        if substring_to_search in str:
            append_to_list(matched_list, str)
    return matched_list

def wait_for_dscinitialization_customresource_to_be_ready(timeout):
    log_to_console(f'Waiting {timeout} seconds for DSCInitialization CustomResource To Be Ready')
    result = run_process(f"oc wait DSCInitialization --timeout\={timeout}s --for jsonpath\='{.status.phase}'\=Ready --all",shell='true', stderr='STDOUT')
    if result.rc != 0:
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('FAIL', result.stdout)

def check_if_pvc_change_is_permanent(PVC_SIZE):
    size = get_pvc_size(APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE)
    change_pvc_size_from_configmap(PVC_SIZE)
    sleep('15s')
    new_size = get_pvc_size(APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE)
    if new_size == PVC_SIZE[:-2]:
        should_not_be_equal_as_strings(f"'{size}'", f"'{new_size}'")
    else:
        fail('Unable to change the default PVC size')

def log_error_and_fail_pods_when_pods_were_terminated(pods_info, fail_reason):
    for pod_info in pods_info:
        operator_pod_info_dict = set_variable(pod_info)
        reason = set_variable(operator_pod_info_dict.status.containerStatuses[0].lastState.terminated.reason)
        exit_code = set_variable(operator_pod_info_dict.status.containerStatuses[0].lastState.terminated.exitCode)
        log(f'{fail_reason}. Reason: {reason} Exit Code: {exit_code}')
        fail(fail_reason)


def get_kserve_default_deployment_mode_from_dsc(dsc_name=DSC_NAME):
    rc, mode = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"oc get dsc {DSC_NAME} -ojsonpath='{.spec.components.kserve.defaultDeploymentMode}'")
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Should Be Equal As Integers', rc, 0,msg=mode)
    if mode == EMPTY:
        log(message='if defaultDeploymentMode is not set, then it means Serverless')
        mode = set_variable('Serverless')
    return mode

def delete_project_via_cli_by_display_name(displayed_name):
    if displayed_name=="ALL":
        display_query = set_variable('"openshift.io/display-name"!\=null')
    else:
        display_query = set_variable(f'"openshift.io/display-name"\=\="{displayed_name}"')
    project_k8s_name = run(f'oc get projects -o json | jq -r \'.items[] | select((.metadata.labels."opendatahub.io/dashboard"\\=\\="true") and (.metadata.annotations.{display_query})) | .metadata.name\'')
    if ""project_k8s_name"" == ""EMPTY"":
        log(msg=f"Project '{displayed_name}' not found, or not a user-defined Data Science project", level='WARN')
    else:
        project_k8s_name = replace_string(project_k8s_name, '\n', SPACE)
        project_names = split_string(string=project_k8s_name)
        counter = get_length(project_names)
        counter = evaluate(f'{counter} * 20')
        rc = wait_until_keyword_succeeds(f'{counter}s', '5s', 'Run And Return Rc', f'oc delete namespace {project_k8s_name}')
        should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)


def generate_custommanifest_in_dsc_yaml(dsc_name=DSC_NAME):
    log_to_console(f'{custom_cmp}.items')
    file_path = set_variable('tasks/Resources/Files/')
    copy_file(source=f'{file_path}dsc_template.yml', destination=f'{file_path}dsc_apply.yml')
    run(f"sed -i'' -e 's/<dsc_name>/{dsc_name}/' {file_path}dsc_apply.yml")
    for cmp in COMPONENT_LIST:
        value = get_from_dictionary(custom_cmp, cmp)
        status = get_from_dictionary(value, 'managementState')
        log_to_console(status)
        if 'status' == 'Managed':
            run(f"sed -i'' -e 's/<{cmp}_value>/Managed/' {file_path}dsc_apply.yml")
        elif 'status' == 'Removed':
            run(f"sed -i'' -e 's/<{cmp}_value>/Removed/' {file_path}dsc_apply.yml")
        if 'cmp' == 'modelregistry':
            run(f"sed -i'' -e 's/<{cmp}_namespace>/{MODEL_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE}/' {file_path}dsc_apply.yml")

def spawn_minimal_python_notebook_server(username, password):
    launch_dashboard(ocp_user_name=username, ocp_user_pw=password, ocp_user_auth_type=TEST_USER.AUTH_TYPE, dashboard_url=ODH_DASHBOARD_URL, browser=BROWSER.NAME, browser_options=BROWSER.OPTIONS)
    launch_jupyterhub_spawner_from_dashboard()
    spawn_notebook_with_arguments(image='minimal-notebook')
    cr_name = get_user_cr_notebook_name(username)
    status, image_tag_name = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"oc get Notebook --field-selector=metadata.name={cr_name} -n {NOTEBOOK_NS} -o=jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.annotations.notebooks\\.opendatahub\\.io/last-image-selection}'")
    image_tag_name = split_string_from_right(string=image_tag_name, separator=':', max_split=1)
    return cr_name, image_tag_name[1]


def configure_knative_gateways():
    base_dir = set_variable('tmp/certs')
    exists = run_keyword_and_return_status('Directory Should Exist', base_dir)
    if exists == FALSE:
        create_directory(base_dir)
    rc, domain_name = run_and_return_rc_and_output('oc get ingresses.config.openshift.io cluster -o jsonpath=\'{.spec.domain}\' | awk -F\'.\' \'{print $(NF-1)"."$NF}\'')
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)
    rc, common_name = run_and_return_rc_and_output("oc get ingresses.config.openshift.io cluster -o jsonpath='{.spec.domain}'|sed 's/apps.//'")
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'./{WILDCARD_GEN_SCRIPT_FILEPATH} {base_dir} {domain_name} {common_name}')
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc create secret tls wildcard-certs --cert={base_dir}/wildcard.crt --key={base_dir}/wildcard.key -n {SERVICEMESH_CR_NS}')
    copy_file(SERVERLESS_GATEWAYS_FILEPATH, f'{LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/gateways_filled.yaml')
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"sed -i'' -e 's/{{SERVICEMESH_CR_NS}}/{SERVICEMESH_CR_NS}/g' {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/gateways_filled.yaml")
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"sed -i'' -e 's/{{SERVERLESS_CR_NS}}/{SERVERLESS_CR_NS}/g' {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/gateways_filled.yaml")
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc apply -f {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/gateways_filled.yaml')
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)

def close_previous_tabs():
    windowhandles = get_window_handles()
    len = get_length(windowhandles)
    len = evaluate(f'{len} - 1')
    for counter in range(len):
        switch_window(f'{windowhandles}[{counter}]')
        close_window()
    switch_window(f'{windowhandles}[{len}]')

def check_card_badges_and_return_titles(card_locator, app_id, expected_data):
    version_check = is_rhods_version_greater_or_equal_than('1.21.0')
    if version_check==True:
        versioned_official_badge_xp = set_variable(OFFICIAL_BADGE_XP)
    else:
        versioned_official_badge_xp = set_variable(OFFICIAL_BADGE_XP_OLD)
    card_badges_titles = get_card_badges_titles(card_locator=card_locator)
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Lists Should Be Equal', card_badges_titles, f'{expected_data}[{app_id}][badges]')
    if RH_BADGE_TITLE in card_badges_titles:
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Page Should Contain Element', f'xpath:{card_locator}/{versioned_official_badge_xp}')
    return card_badges_titles

def get_current_user_in_jupyterlab():
    current_user_escaped = run_cell_and_get_output('import os; s=os.environ["HOSTNAME"]; username = s.split("-")[2:-1]; print("-".join(username))')

def maybe_close_popup():
    sleep('0.5s')
    jl_tabs = get_webelements(f'xpath:{JL_TABBAR_NOT_SELECTED_XPATH}')
    len = get_length(jl_tabs)
    for index in range(0, f'2+{len}'):
        accept = get_webelements("xpath://div[contains(concat(' ',normalize-space(@class),' '),' jp-Dialog-footer ')]")
        if accept:
            click_element("xpath://div[contains(concat(' ',normalize-space(@class),' '),' jp-Dialog-footer ')]/button[last()]")
        capture_page_screenshot()

def check_query_response_values(response, exp_namespace, exp_model_name=EMPTY, exp_query_kind=EMPTY, exp_value=EMPTY, exp_pod_name=EMPTY):
    json_results = set_variable(response.json()["data"]["result"])
    for index, result in enumerate(json_results):
        log(f'{index}: {result}')
        value_keyname = run_keyword_and_return_status('Dictionary Should Contain Key', result, 'value')
        if value_keyname == TRUE:
            curr_value = set_variable(result["value"][-1])
        else:
            curr_value = set_variable(result["values"][-1][-1])
        source_namespace = set_variable(result["metric"]["namespace"])
        checked = run_keyword_and_return_status('Should Be Equal As Strings', source_namespace, exp_namespace)
        if checked == FALSE:
            continue_for_loop()
        else:
            log(message='Metrics source namespaced succesfully checked. Going to next step.')
        if exp_model_name != EMPTY:
            source_pod = set_variable(result["metric"]["pod"])
            checked = run_keyword_and_return_status('Should Start With', source_pod, exp_model_name)
            if checked == FALSE:
                continue_for_loop()
            else:
                log(message='Metrics source model succesfully checked. Going to next step.')
            if exp_query_kind != EMPTY:
                source_query_kind = set_variable(result["metric"]["kind"])
                checked = run_keyword_and_return_status('Should Be Equal As Strings', source_query_kind, exp_query_kind)
                if checked == FALSE:
                    continue_for_loop()
                else:
                    log(message='Metrics query kind succesfully checked. Going to next step.')
        if exp_pod_name != EMPTY:
            source_pod = set_variable(result["metric"]["pod"])
            checked = run_keyword_and_return_status('Should Be Equal As Strings', source_pod, exp_pod_name)
            if checked == FALSE:
                continue_for_loop()
            else:
                log(message='Metrics source pod succesfully checked. Going to next step.')
        if exp_value != EMPTY:
            run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Should Be Equal As Strings', curr_value, exp_value)
        else:
            run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Should Not Be Empty', curr_value)
        if checked == TRUE:
            log(message='The desired query result has been found.')
            exit_for_loop()
    if checked == FALSE:
        fail(msg='The metric you are looking for has not been found. Check the query parameter and try again')

def wait_for_pods_numbers(count, namespace, label_selector, timeout):
    status = set_variable('False')
    for counter in range(timeout):
        return_code, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc get pod -n {namespace} -l {label_selector} | tail -n +2 | wc -l')
        if output == count:
            status = set_variable('True')
            log_to_console(f'pods {label_selector} created')
            break
        sleep('1 sec')
    if 'status' == 'False':
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('FAIL', f'Timeout- {output} pods found with the label selector {label_selector} in {namespace} namespace')

def set_minimum_replicas_number(n_replicas, model_name, namespace):
    old_revision_id = get_current_revision_id(model_name=model_name, namespace=namespace)
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc patch InferenceService {model_name} -n {namespace} --type=json -p="[{\'op\': \'replace\', \'path\': \'/spec/predictor/minReplicas\', \'value\': {n_replicas}}]"')
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)
    return old_revision_id


def set_replicas_number_with_buttons(number):
    current = get_element_attribute(REPLICAS_COUNT_XP, 'value')
    difference = evaluate(f'int({number})-int({current})')
    op = set_variable('plus')
    if difference<0:
        difference = evaluate(f'abs({difference})')
        op = set_variable('minus')
    for idx in range(difference):
        if 'op'=='plus':
            click_plus_button()
        else:
            click_minus_button()
    current = get_element_attribute(REPLICAS_COUNT_XP, 'value')
    should_be_equal_as_integers(current, number)

def select_workbench_number_of_gpus(gpus, gpu_type="'NVIDIA GPU'"):
    wait_until_page_contains_element(WORKBENCH_SIZE_SIDE_MENU_BTN)
    click_element(WORKBENCH_SIZE_SIDE_MENU_BTN)
    wait_until_page_contains_element(WORKBENCH_ACCELERATOR_DROPDOWN_XPATH)
    click_element(WORKBENCH_ACCELERATOR_DROPDOWN_XPATH)
    if gpus == "0":
        click_element(xpath="//span[text()='None']")
    else:
        wait_until_page_contains_element(xpath=f'//div[@class and text()={gpu_type}]')
        click_element(xpath=f'//div[@class and text()={gpu_type}]')
        actual_gpus = get_value(WORKBENCH_ACCELERATOR_INPUT_XPATH)
        actual_gpus = convert_to_integer(actual_gpus)
        gpus = convert_to_integer(gpus)
        while actual_gpus != gpus:
            if actual_gpus < gpus:
                click_element(WORKBENCH_ACCELERATOR_PLUS_BUTTON_XPATH)
            else:
                click_element(WORKBENCH_ACCELERATOR_LESS_BUTTON_XPATH)
            actual_gpus = get_value(WORKBENCH_ACCELERATOR_INPUT_XPATH)
            actual_gpus = convert_to_integer(actual_gpus)

def wait_until_all_builds_are_complete(namespace, build_timeout='20 min'):
    buildconfigs_data = oc_get(kind='BuildConfig', namespace=namespace)
    for buildconfig_data in buildconfigs_data:
        buildconfig_name = set_variable(buildconfig_data['metadata']['name'])
        build_name = wait_until_build_exists(namespace=namespace, build_name_includes=buildconfig_name)
        build_status_should_not_be(namespace=namespace, build_name=build_name, unexpected_status='Error')
        build_status_should_not_be(namespace=namespace, build_name=build_name, unexpected_status='Failed')
        wait_until_build_status_is(namespace=namespace, build_name=build_name, expected_status='Complete', timeout=build_timeout)

        wait_until_page_contains_element(f'//td[@data-label="Name"]/div[.="{model_name} "]/../..//td[@data-label="Inference endpoint"]',timeout='30s')

        endpoint = get_element_attribute(f'//td[@data-label="Name"]/div[.="{model_name} "]/../..//td[@data-label="Inference endpoint"]//input', 'value')
        if endpoint!=EMPTY:
            return endpoint
        reload_page()
    log('Failed to get model serving host through the UI')
    take_screenshot()

def verify_model_inference(model_name, inference_input, expected_inference_output, token_auth=FALSE, project_title=NONE, deployment_mode='UI', kserve_mode='Serverless', service_port=NONE, end_point=NONE, token=NONE):
    if deployment_mode == 'UI':
        open_model_serving_home_page()
        switch_model_serving_project(project_title)
    inference_output = get_model_inference(model_name=model_name, inference_input=inference_input, token_auth=token_auth, kserve_mode=kserve_mode, project_title=project_title, deployment_mode=deployment_mode, service_port=service_port, end_point=end_point, token=token)
    log(inference_output)
    result, list = inference_comparison(expected_inference_output, inference_output)
    log(result)
    log(list)
    if result==False:
        if project_title == NONE:
            rc, project_title = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc get InferenceServices --all-namespaces -ojson | jq \'.items[] | select(.metadata.name=="{model_name}") | .metadata.namespace\' | tr -d \'"\'')
        events, podlogs = get_events_and_pod_logs(namespace=project_title, label_selector='modelmesh-service=modelmesh-serving')
        fail(msg=f'comparison between expected and actual failed, {list}')

def check_image_pull_path_is_redhatio(deployment_name):
    if deployment_name in REDHATIO_PATH_CHECK_EXCLUSTION_LIST:
        log_to_console(f'Skip image pull path check for Deployment {deployment_name}')
        return
    rc, image = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc get deployment/{deployment_name} -n {APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE} -o jsonpath="{..image}"')
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0,msg=image)
    log_to_console(f'Check deployment {deployment_name} pull path for image {image}')
    if "registry.redhat.io" in image:
        log_to_console(f'Deployment {deployment_name} image contains pull path registry.redhat.io')
    else:
        fail('Deployment image', f'{deployment_name} does not contain pull path registry.redhat.io')

def enable_single_component(component, dsc_name='default'):
    if component not in COMPONENTS and component != "none":
        log(f'unknown component: {component}',level='WARN')
        return
    len = get_length(COMPONENTS)
    patch = set_variable(PATCH_PREFIX)
    for index, cmp in enumerate(COMPONENTS):
        if cmp==component:
            sub = change_component_status(component=cmp, enable='Managed', run=FALSE)
        else:
            sub = change_component_status(component=cmp, enable='Removed', run=FALSE)
        if index ==0:
            patch = catenate(patch, sub,SEPARATOR=)
        else:
            patch = catenate(patch, sub,SEPARATOR=f',{SPACE}')
    patch = catenate(patch, "}}}'",SEPARATOR=)
    log(patch)
    return_code, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output(patch)
    log(output)
    should_be_equal_as_integers(return_code, 0,msg='Error detected while applying DSC CR')
    sleep('30s')

def verify_custom_image_description(image_name, expected_description):
    custom_image_name_record = set_variable(f'xpath://td[@data-label="Name"]/div/div/div[.="{image_name}"]')
    exists = run_keyword_and_return_status('Page Should Contain Element', f'{custom_image_name_record}/../../../../td[@data-label="Description" and .="{expected_description}"]')
    if exists==False:
        desc = get_text(f'{custom_image_name_record}/../../../../td[@data-label="Description"]')
        log(f'Description for {image_name} does not match {expected_description} - Actual description is {desc}')
        fail()
    return exists

    select_notebook_image(image)
    run_keyword_and_return_status('Wait Until JupyterHub Spawner Is Ready')
    time1 = get_time(format='%H:%M:%S.%f')
    spawn_notebook()
    run_keyword_and_warn_on_failure('Login To Openshift', TEST_USER.USERNAME, TEST_USER.PASSWORD, TEST_USER.AUTH_TYPE)
    authorization_required = is_service_account_authorization_required()
    if authorization_required:
        authorize_jupyterhub_service_account()
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Wait Until Page Contains Element', 'xpath://div[@id="jp-top-panel"]',timeout='60s')
    time2 = get_time()
    time = subtract_date_from_date(time2, time1)
    sleep('1s')
    maybe_close_popup()
    stop_jupyterlab_notebook_server()
    go_to(ODH_DASHBOARD_URL)
    wait_for_rhods_dashboard_to_load()
    launch_jupyter_from_rhods_dashboard_link()
    fix_spawner_status()
    wait_until_jupyterhub_spawner_is_ready()
    return time


def get_pod_names(namespace, label_selector):
    pod_name = create_list()
    status = check_if_pod_exists(namespace, label_selector)
    if 'status'=='PASS':
        data = oc_get(kind='Pod', namespace=namespace, label_selector=label_selector)
        for index, element in enumerate(data):
            append_to_list(pod_name, f"{data[{index}]['metadata']['name']}")
    else:
        fail(f"No POD found with the provided label selector in a given namespace '{namespace}'")
    return pod_name

def schedule_bias_metrics_request_via_cli(metricsType, modelId, protectedAttribute, favorableOutcome, outcomeName, privilegedAttribute, unprivilegedAttribute, token):
    curl_cmd = set_variable(f'curl -k -H "Authorization: Bearer {token}" {TRUSTY_ROUTE}/metrics/{metricsType}/request --header')
    curl_cmd = catenate(curl_cmd, "'Content-Type: application/json'")
    curl_cmd = catenate(curl_cmd, f'--data \'{"modelId":"{modelId}","protectedAttribute": {protectedAttribute},"favorableOutcome":', f'{favorableOutcome},"outcomeName": {outcomeName},"privilegedAttribute": {privilegedAttribute},"unprivilegedAttribute": {unprivilegedAttribute}}\'')
    rc, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output(curl_cmd)
    should_contain(output, 'requestId')
    log_to_console(output)


def recreate_s3_data_connection(project_title, dc_name, aws_access_key, aws_secret_access, aws_s3_endpoint=S3.AWS_DEFAULT_ENDPOINT, aws_region=S3.AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, connected_workbench=NONE, press_cancel=FALSE, aws_bucket_name=NONE):
    open_data_science_project_details_page(project_title=project_title, tab_id='connections')
    is_exist = run_keyword_and_return_status('Wait Until Page Contains Element', f'{DC_SECTION}//tr[td[@data-label="Name"]/*/div[.="{dc_name}"]]')
    if is_exist:
        log(f"Data Connection '{dc_name}' already exists, updating connection",console='True')
        edit_s3_data_connection(project_title=project_title, dc_name=dc_name, new_dc_name=f'{dc_name}{SPACE}', aws_access_key=aws_access_key, aws_secret_access=aws_secret_access, aws_bucket_name=aws_bucket_name, aws_region=aws_region, press_cancel=press_cancel, aws_s3_endpoint=aws_s3_endpoint, connected_workbench=connected_workbench)
    else:
        log(f"Data Connection '{dc_name}' does not exist, creating a new connection",console='True')
        create_s3_data_connection(project_title=project_title, dc_name=dc_name, aws_access_key=aws_access_key, aws_secret_access=aws_secret_access, aws_bucket_name=aws_bucket_name, aws_region=aws_region, press_cancel=press_cancel, aws_s3_endpoint=aws_s3_endpoint, connected_workbench=connected_workbench)

def is_gpu_autoscaling_enabled():
    autoscaling_enabled = set_variable(False)
    machinesets = get_machinesets()
    for ms in machinesets:
        ms_gpu_num = run(f'oc get MachineSet {ms} -n openshift-machine-api -o json | jq \'.metadata.annotations["machine.openshift.io/GPU"]\' | sed \'s/"//g\'')
        ms_gpu_num = convert_to_integer(ms_gpu_num)
        if ms_gpu_num > 0:
            autoscaler = run(f'oc get MachineSet {ms} -n openshift-machine-api -o json | jq \'.metadata.annotations["autoscaling.openshift.io/machineautoscaler"]\'')
            autoscaler_status = run_keyword_and_return_status('Should Not Be Equal As Strings', autoscaler, 'null')
            if autoscaler_status:
                autoscaling_enabled = set_variable(True)
    return autoscaling_enabled


def traffic_should_be_redirected_based_on_canary_percentage(exp_percentage, isvc_name, model_name, namespace, runtime):
    total = set_variable(20)
    hits = set_variable(0)
    toleration = set_variable(20)
    for counter in range(0, total):
        log(counter)
        status = run_keyword_and_return_status('Query Model Multiple Times',isvc_name=isvc_name, model_name=model_name, n_times=1, namespace=namespace, runtime=runtime)
        if status == TRUE:
            hits = evaluate(f'{hits}+1')
    log(hits)
    actual_percentage = evaluate(f'({hits}/{total})*100')
    diff = evaluate(f'abs({exp_percentage}-{actual_percentage})')
    if diff > toleration or actual_percentage == 0:
        fail(msg=f'Percentage of traffic redirected to new revision is greater than toleration {toleration}%')

def install_and_verify_trustyai_service(namespace):

    should_be_equal_as_integers(return_code, 0)
    return f'https://{output}'


def run_codeflare_sdk_test(TEST_TYPE, TEST_NAME, PYTHON_VERSION, RAY_IMAGE, RELEASE_BRANCH):
    log_to_console(f'"Running codeflare-sdk test: {TEST_NAME}"')
    result = run_process(f'cd {CODEFLARE-SDK_DIR} && git fetch origin && git checkout {RELEASE_BRANCH} && git branch && poetry env use {PYTHON_VERSION} && poetry install --with test,docs && poetry run pytest -v -s ./tests/{TEST_TYPE}/{TEST_NAME} --timeout\=420', f'env:RAY_IMAGE={RAY_IMAGE}', f'env:AWS_DEFAULT_ENDPOINT={AWS_DEFAULT_ENDPOINT}', f'env:AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID={AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID}', f'env:AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY={AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}', f'env:AWS_STORAGE_BUCKET={AWS_STORAGE_BUCKET}', f'env:AWS_STORAGE_BUCKET_MNIST_DIR={AWS_STORAGE_BUCKET_MNIST_DIR}', f'env:PIP_INDEX_URL={PIP_INDEX_URL}', f'env:PIP_TRUSTED_HOST={PIP_TRUSTED_HOST}', 'env:CONTROL_LABEL=node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane=', 'env:WORKER_LABEL=node-role.kubernetes.io/worker=', 'env:TOLERATION_KEY=node-role.kubernetes.io/master',shell='true', stderr='STDOUT')

def spawn_notebook_with_arguments(retries=1, retries_delay='0 seconds', image='science-notebook', size='Small', spawner_timeout='600 seconds', gpus=0, refresh=False, same_tab=True, username=TEST_USER.USERNAME, password=TEST_USER.PASSWORD, auth_type=TEST_USER.AUTH_TYPE, version='default', envs):
    spawn_fail = set_variable('True')
    for index in range(0, f'1+{retries}'):
        spawner_ready = run_keyword_and_return_status('Wait Until JupyterHub Spawner Is Ready')
        if spawner_ready==True:
            select_notebook_image(image, version)
            select_container_size(size)
            gpu_visible = run_keyword_and_return_status('Wait Until Accelerator Dropdown Exists')
            if gpu_visible==True and gpus>0:
                set_gpu_accelerator()
                set_number_of_required_accelerators(gpus)
            elif gpu_visible==False and gpus>0:
                if index < retries:
                    sleep('30s',reason='Wait for GPU to free up')
                    reload_page()
                    wait_until_jupyterhub_spawner_is_ready()
                    continue
                else:
                    fail('GPUs required but not available')
            if refresh:
                reload_page()
                capture_page_screenshot('reload.png')
                wait_until_jupyterhub_spawner_is_ready()
            remove_all_spawner_environment_variables()
            if envs:
                for key, value in envs[envs]:
                    sleep(1)
                    add_spawner_environment_variable(key, value)
            spawn_notebook(spawner_timeout, same_tab)
            run_keyword_and_warn_on_failure('Wait Until Page Contains', 'Log in with OpenShift',timeout='15s')
            oauth_prompt_visible = is_openshift_oauth_login_prompt_visible()
            if oauth_prompt_visible:
                click_button('Log in with OpenShift')
            run_keyword_and_warn_on_failure('Login To Openshift', username, password, auth_type)
            authorization_required = is_service_account_authorization_required()
            if authorization_required:
                authorize_jupyterhub_service_account()
            wait_notebook_to_be_loaded(image, version)
            spawn_fail = has_spawn_failed()
            exit_for_loop_if(f'{spawn_fail} == False')
            reload_page()
        else:
            sleep(retries_delay)
            reload_page()
    if spawn_fail == True:
        fail(msg=f' Spawner failed loading after {retries} retries')

def wait_component_ready(component):
    result = run_process('oc get datascienceclusters.datasciencecluster.opendatahub.io -o name',shell='true', stderr='STDOUT')
    if result.stdout == "":
        fail('Can not find datasciencecluster')
    cluster_name = set_variable(result.stdout)
    log_to_console(f'Waiting for {component} to be ready')
    result = run_process(f'oc wait "{cluster_name}" --for condition\={component}Ready\=true --timeout\=10m',shell='true', stderr='STDOUT')
    if result.rc != 0:
        suffix = generate_random_string(4, '[LOWER]')
        result_dsc_get = run_process(f'oc get datascienceclusters.datasciencecluster.opendatahub.io -o yaml > dsc-{component}-dump-{suffix}.yaml',shell='true', stderr='STDOUT')
        if result_dsc_get.rc == 0:
            fail(f"Timeout waiting for {component} to be ready, DSC CR content stored in 'dsc-{component}-dump-{suffix}.yaml'")
        fail(f'Timeout waiting for {component} to be ready, DSC CR cannot be retrieved')
    log_to_console(f'{component} is ready')

def extract_value_from_json_path(json_dict, path):
    path_splits = split_string(string=path, separator='.')
    value = set_variable(json_dict)
    for idx, split in enumerate(path_splits, start=1):
        log(f'{idx} - {split}')
        present = run_keyword_and_return_status('Dictionary Should Contain Key',dictionary=value, key=split)
        if present == TRUE:
            value = set_variable(f'{value["{split}"]}')
        else:
            value = set_variable(EMPTY)
            log(message=f'{path} or part of it is not found in the given JSON', level='ERROR')
            break
    return value

def get_formated_container_size_to_dictionary(data):
    limit = split_string(data)
    idx = get_index_from_list(limit, 'requests:')
    f_dict = create_dictionary()
    limits = create_dictionary()
    req = create_dictionary()
    set_to_dictionary(limits, f'{limit[2]}[:-1]={limit[1]}', f'{limit[4]}={limit[3]}')
    set_to_dictionary(req, f'{limit[{idx} + {2}]}[:-1]={limit[{idx} + {1}]}', f'{limit[{idx} + {4}]}={limit[{idx} + {3}]}')
    set_to_dictionary(f_dict,limits=limits, requests=req)
    return f_dict

def wait_for_datasciencecluster_customresource_to_be_ready(timeout):
    log_to_console('Waiting for DataScienceCluster CustomResource To Be Ready')
    status = set_variable('False')
    for counter in range(timeout):
        return_code, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output('oc get DataScienceCluster --no-headers -o custom-columns=":status.phase"')
        if 'output' == 'Ready':
            status = set_variable('True')
            log_to_console('DataScienceCluster CustomResource is Ready')
            break
        sleep('1 sec')
    if 'status' == 'False':
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('FAIL', 'Timeout- DataScienceCluster CustomResource is not Ready')

def delete_pods_using_label_selector(namespace, label_selector):
    pod_exists = check_if_pod_exists(namespace, label_selector)
    if 'pod_exists'=='PASS':
        deleted_pods = oc_delete(kind='Pod', namespace=namespace, label_selector=label_selector)
        if len(deleted_pods) == 0:
            fail(f'Error deleting pods: {deleted_pods}')
        else:
            sleep(2)
            pod_exists = check_if_pod_exists(namespace, label_selector)
            if 'pod_exists'=='PASS':
                fail(f"Pods with Label '{label_selector}' in namespace '{namespace}' still exist")
    else:
        log(level='WARN', message=f"No Pods present with Label '{label_selector}' in '{namespace}' namespace")

def check_distributed_workload_resource_metrics_chart(project, cpu_requested, memory_requested, workload_type, job_name):
    wait_until_element_is_visible(xpath='//*[@id="topResourceConsumingCPU-ChartLabel-title"]', timeout=120)
    wait_until_element_is_visible(xpath='//*[@id="topResourceConsumingCPU-ChartLegend-ChartLabel-0"]', timeout=120)
    check_expected_string_contains('//*[@id="topResourceConsumingCPU-ChartLegend-ChartLabel-0"]', job_name)
    cpu_usage = get_current_cpu_usage(project, workload_type)
    cpu_usage_hover_value, cpu_requested_hover_value = get_cpu_requested_tooltip_text()
    check_resource_consuming_usage(cpu_usage, cpu_usage_hover_value, 'CPU')
    should_be_true(f'{cpu_requested_hover_value} == {cpu_requested}')
    cpu_consuming = get_text("xpath:(//*[@style[contains(., 'var(--pf-v5-chart-donut--label--title--Fill')]])[1]")
    check_resource_consuming_usage(cpu_usage, cpu_consuming, 'CPU')
    mouse_over('(//button[@class="pf-v5-c-table__button"])[1]')
    wait_until_element_is_visible(xpath='//*[@id="topResourceConsumingMemory-ChartLabel-title"]', timeout=120)
    wait_until_element_is_visible(xpath='//*[@id="topResourceConsumingMemory-ChartLegend-ChartLabel-0"]', timeout=120)
    check_expected_string_contains('//*[@id="topResourceConsumingMemory-ChartLegend-ChartLabel-0"]', job_name)
    memory_usage = get_current_memory_usage(project, workload_type)
    memory_usage_hover_value, memory_requested_hover_value = get_memory_requested_tooltip_text()
    check_resource_consuming_usage(memory_usage, memory_usage_hover_value, 'Memory')
    should_be_true(f'{memory_requested_hover_value} == {memory_requested}')
    memory_consuming = get_text("xpath:(//*[@style[contains(., 'var(--pf-v5-chart-donut--label--title--Fill')]])[2]")
    check_resource_consuming_usage(memory_usage, memory_consuming, 'Memory')


def get_dashboard_pod_logs(pod_name):
    pod_logs = oc_get_pod_logs(name=pod_name, namespace=APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE, container=DASHBOARD_APP_NAME)
    pod_logs_lines = split_string(string=pod_logs, separator='\n')
    n_lines = get_length(pod_logs_lines)
    log(f'{pod_logs_lines}[{n_lines-3}:]')
    if "pod_logs_lines[n_lines-1]" == EMPTY:
        remove_from_list(pod_logs_lines, n_lines-1)
        n_lines = get_length(pod_logs_lines)
    return pod_logs_lines, n_lines

def get_install_plugin_list_from_jupyterlab():
    plugin_names = create_list()
    maybe_open_jupyterlab_sidebar('Extension Manager')
    run_keyword_and_return_status('Wait Until Page Contains Element', 'xpath://*[@class="jp-extensionmanager-disclaimer"]//*[contains(text(), "Enable")]',timeout=10)
    run_keyword_and_return_status('Click Button', 'Enable')
    run_keyword_and_return_status('Wait Until Page Contains Element', 'xpath://*[@class="jp-extensionmanager-disclaimer"]//*[contains(text(), "Disable")]',timeout=10)
    link_elements = get_webelements('xpath://ul[@class="jp-extensionmanager-listview"]//li[contains(@class,"jp-extensionmanager-entry-ok")]//a')
    for idx, ext_link in enumerate(link_elements, start=1):
        plugin_name = get_element_attribute(ext_link, 'text')
        href = get_element_attribute(ext_link, 'href')
        append_to_list(plugin_names, plugin_name)
        status = get_http_status_code(href)
        log_to_console(f'{idx}. {href} gets status code {status}')
    return plugin_names

def perform_dashboard_api_endpoint_put_call(endpoint, token, body, str_to_json=TRUE):
    headers = create_dictionary('Content-type=application/json',Cookie=f'_oauth_proxy={token}')
    payload = prepare_payload(body=body, str_to_json=str_to_json)
    args = create_dictionary(url=f'{ODH_DASHBOARD_URL}/{endpoint}', expected_status='any', headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=5, verify=False)
    response = run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Perform Request', 'PUT', '&{args}')
    if response == NONE:
        log(msg='HTTP response is empty. The request may have failed to be performed', level='ERROR')

def clean_up_user_notebook(admin_username, username):
    oc_whoami = run('oc whoami')
    if 'oc_whoami' == 'admin_username' or 'oc_whoami' == 'SERVICE_ACCOUNT.FULL_NAME':
        notebook_pod_name = get_user_notebook_pod_name(username)
        openshiftlibrary.search_pods(notebook_pod_name,namespace=NOTEBOOKS_NAMESPACE)
        output = run(f"oc exec {notebook_pod_name} -n {NOTEBOOKS_NAMESPACE} -- find /opt/app-root/src/ -not -path '*/\.*' -not -path '/opt/app-root/src/' -exec rm -rv {} +")
        log(output)
    else:
        fail(msg=f'This command requires {admin_username} to be connected to the cluster (oc login ...)')

def deploy_kserve_model_via_ui(model_name, serving_runtime, data_connection, path, model_framework='caikit', replicas=1, size='Small', no_gpus=0, token=FALSE, multi_token=FALSE, multi_service_account_name='default-name2', public_endpoint=TRUE, service_account_name=NONE, existing_server=FALSE):
    move_to_tab('Models')
    if existing_server == False:
        seleniumlibrary.click_button(DEPLOY_SINGLE_SV_MODEL_BTN)
    seleniumlibrary.wait_until_page_contains_element(DEPLOY_SINGLE_MODEL_BTN)
    seleniumlibrary.click_button(DEPLOY_SINGLE_MODEL_BTN)
    seleniumlibrary.wait_until_page_contains_element(xpath=KSERVE_MODAL_HEADER)
    set_model_name(model_name)
    set_model_server_runtime(serving_runtime)
    select_framework(model_framework)
    set_replicas_number_with_buttons(replicas)
    set_server_size(size)
    if public_endpoint:
        enable_external_serving_route()
        token_enabled = run_keyword_and_return_status('SeleniumLibrary.Checkbox Should Be Selected', TOKEN_AUTH_CHECKBOX_XP)
        if token_enabled:
            disable_token_authentication()
        else:
            log("Token Authentication was supposed to be automatically enabled, but it wasn't",level='ERROR', console=True)
    if token:
        enable_token_authentication(service_account_name=service_account_name)
        if multi_token:
            add_another_service_account(multi_service_account_name)
    select_existing_data_connection(data_connection)
    set_folder_path(path)
    if no_gpus > 0:
        gpu_enabled = run_keyword_and_return_status('Verify GPU Selector Is Usable')
        if gpu_enabled==False:
            log('GPU requested but not available')
            fail()
        set_accelerator()
        set_number_of_gpu_with_buttons(no_gpus)
    click_button('Deploy')
    wait_until_page_does_not_contain_element(xpath='//button[@data-testid="modal-submit-button"]', timeout='60s')

        oc_delete(kind='Template', name=resource_name, namespace=APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE)


def run_model_query_command(body, endpoint, expected_string):
    header = set_variable("'Content-Type: application/json'")
    cmd = set_variable('curl -ks')
    cmd = catenate(cmd, f'-H {header} -d {body} {endpoint}')
    rc, result = run_and_return_rc_and_output(cmd)
    should_be_true(f'{rc} == 0')
    should_contain(result, expected_string,msg='"Expected vectors not found"')

def fill_data_connection_form(project_title, dc_name, aws_access_key, aws_secret_access, action_btn, aws_s3_endpoint=S3.AWS_DEFAULT_ENDPOINT, aws_region=S3.AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, connected_workbench=NONE, press_cancel=FALSE, aws_bucket_name=NONE):
    wait_until_page_contains_element(S3_NAME_DC_INPUT)
    input_text(S3_NAME_DC_INPUT, dc_name)
    input_text(S3_KEY_DC_INPUT, aws_access_key)
    input_text(S3_SECRET_DC_INPUT, aws_secret_access)
    input_text(S3_ENDPOINT_DC_INPUT, aws_s3_endpoint)
    input_text(S3_REGION_DC_INPUT, aws_region)
    input_text(S3_BUCKET_DC_INPUT, aws_bucket_name)
    if connected_workbench == NONE:
        log(msg=f'you are not connecting any workbenchs to {dc_name} DataConnection')
    else:
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Element Should Be Enabled',xpath='//div[contains(@class,"modal")]//button[@aria-label="Notebook select"]')
        for workbench_title in connected_workbench:
            set_connection_between_data_connection_and_workbench(workbench_title)
            run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Element Should Be Enabled', S3_DC_SUBMIT_BTN)
    if press_cancel == TRUE:
        click_button(GENERIC_CANCEL_BTN)
    else:
        wait_until_element_is_enabled(action_btn)
        click_button(action_btn)
    wait_until_generic_modal_disappears()
    wait_until_project_is_open(project_title=project_title)

def is_rhods_installed():
    log(f'Checking if RHODS is installed with "{clusterType}" "{UPDATE_CHANNEL}" "{INSTALL_TYPE}"',console='yes')
    if cluster_type == "selfmanaged":
        if INSTALL_TYPE == "CLi":
            result = run_keyword_and_return_status('Run Keywords', 'Check A RHODS Family Operator Is Installed', 'AND', 'Oc Get', 'AND', 'Oc Get', 'AND', 'Oc Get', 'AND', 'Oc Get',namespace='openshift-marketplace', subscription='rhoai-operator-dev', kind='CatalogSource', field_selector='metadata.name=rhoai-catalog-dev')
        elif INSTALL_TYPE == "OperatorHub":
            result = run_keyword_and_return_status('Run Keywords', 'Check A RHODS Family Operator Is Installed', 'AND', 'Oc Get', 'AND', 'Oc Get', 'AND', 'Oc Get',namespace=OPERATOR_NAMESPACE, subscription=OPERATOR_NAME, kind='Namespace', field_selector=f'metadata.name={OPERATOR_NAMESPACE}')
        else:
            fail('Provided test environment and install type combination is not supported')
    elif cluster_type == "managed":
        set_global_variable(SUB_NAME, 'addon-managed-odh')
        set_global_variable(CATALOG_NAME, 'addon-managed-odh-catalog')
        if UPDATE_CHANNEL == "odh-nightlies":
            set_global_variable(OPERATOR_NAMESPACE, 'openshift-marketplace')
            set_global_variable(SUB_NAME, 'rhoai-operator-dev')
            set_global_variable(CATALOG_NAME, 'rhoai-catalog-dev')
        result = run_keyword_and_return_status('Run Keywords', 'Check A RHODS Family Operator Is Installed', 'AND', 'Oc Get', 'AND', 'Oc Get', 'AND', 'Oc Get', 'AND', 'Oc Get',namespace=OPERATOR_NAMESPACE, subscription=SUB_NAME, kind='CatalogSource', field_selector=f'metadata.name={CATALOG_NAME}')
    else:
        fail(f'Provided test environment and install type {INSTALL_TYPE} {UPDATE_CHANNEL} {cluster_type} combination', 'is not supported')
    log(f'RHODS is installed: {result}',console='yes')
    return result


def skip_if_rhods_is_self_managed(msg=EMPTY):
    is_self_managed = is_rhods_self_managed()
    if msg != EMPTY:
        skip_if(condition=f'{is_self_managed}==True', msg=msg)
    else:
        skip_if(condition=f'{is_self_managed}==True', msg='This test is skipped for Self-managed RHODS')

def clean_up_model_serving_page():
    switch_model_serving_project(project_name='All projects')
    projects = get_webelements('xpath://table/tbody/tr/td[@data-label="Project"]')
    log(projects)
    projects_length = get_length(projects)
    while projects_length > 0:
        project = set_variable(f'{projects}[0]')
        project = get_text(project)
        project description = split_string(project)
        switch_model_serving_project(f'{project description}[0]')
        models = get_webelements('xpath://table/tbody/tr/td[@data-label="Name"]')
        for model in models:
            model = get_text(model)
            delete_model_via_ui(model)
            sleep('1s')
        switch_model_serving_project(project_name='All projects')
        projects = get_webelements('xpath://table/tbody/tr/td[@data-label="Project"]')
        projects_length = get_length(projects)

def check_versions_in_jupyterlab(libraries-to-check):
    return_status = set_variable('PASS')
    for libString in libraries-to-check:
        libDetail = split_string(libString, f'{SPACE}v')
        if "libDetail[0]" == "TensorFlow":
            status, value = verify_installed_library_version('tensorflow', f'{libDetail}[1]')
            if 'status' == 'FAIL':
                return_status = set_variable('FAIL')
        elif "libDetail[0]" == "PyTorch":
            status, value = verify_installed_library_version('torch', f'{libDetail}[1]')
            if 'status' == 'FAIL':
                return_status = set_variable('FAIL')
        elif "libDetail[0]" == "Python":
            status = python_version_check(f'{libDetail}[1]')
        elif "libDetail[0]" == "Sklearn-onnx" or "libDetail[0]" == "sklearn-onnx":
            status, value = verify_installed_library_version('skl2onnx', f'{libDetail}[1]')
            if 'status' == 'FAIL':
                return_status = set_variable('FAIL')
            if "libDetail[0]" == "sklearn-onnx":
                log(f'Library name "{libDetail}[0]" is in all lowercase',level='WARN')
        elif "libDetail[0]" == "MySQL Connector/Python":
            status, value = verify_installed_library_version('mysql-connector-python', f'{libDetail}[1]')
            if 'status' == 'FAIL':
                return_status = set_variable('FAIL')
        elif "libDetail[0]" == "CUDA":
            continue
        elif "libDetail[0]" == "Nvidia-CUDA-CU12-Bundle":
            status, value = verify_installed_library_version('nvidia-cuda-nvcc-cu12', f'{libDetail}[1]')
            if 'status' == 'FAIL':
                return_status = set_variable('FAIL')
        elif "libDetail[0]" == "Elyra":
            status, value = verify_installed_library_version('elyra-code-snippet-extension', f'{libDetail}[1]')
            if 'status' == 'FAIL':
                return_status = set_variable('FAIL')
            status, value = verify_installed_library_version('elyra-pipeline-editor-extension', f'{libDetail}[1]')
            if 'status' == 'FAIL':
                return_status = set_variable('FAIL')
            status, value = verify_installed_library_version('elyra-python-editor-extension', f'{libDetail}[1]')
            if 'status' == 'FAIL':
                return_status = set_variable('FAIL')
            status, value = verify_installed_library_version('elyra-server', f'{libDetail}[1]')
            if 'status' == 'FAIL':
                return_status = set_variable('FAIL')
            status, value = verify_installed_labextension_version('elyra/metadata-extension', f'{libDetail}[1]')
            if 'status' == 'FAIL':
                return_status = set_variable('FAIL')
            status, value = verify_installed_labextension_version('elyra/code-viewer-extension', f'{libDetail}[1]')
            if 'status' == 'FAIL':
                return_status = set_variable('FAIL')
            status, value = verify_installed_labextension_version('elyra/script-debugger-extension', f'{libDetail}[1]')
            if 'status' == 'FAIL':
                return_status = set_variable('FAIL')
            status, value = verify_installed_labextension_version('elyra/theme-extension', f'{libDetail}[1]')
            if 'status' == 'FAIL':
                return_status = set_variable('FAIL')
        else:
            status, value = verify_installed_library_version(f'{libDetail}[0]', f'{libDetail}[1]')
            if 'status' == 'FAIL':
                return_status = set_variable('FAIL')
        packages = create_list('Python', 'Boto3', 'Kafka-Python', 'Scipy')
        continue_for_loop_if(f'"{libDetail}[0]" not in {packages}')
        if "libDetail[0]" not in package_versions:
            set_to_dictionary(package_versions, f'{libDetail}[0]={libDetail}[1]')
        if "package_versions["${libDetail[0]"]}" != "libDetail[1]":
            return_status = set_variable('FAIL')
            run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Fail', "Version of this library in this image doesn't align with versions in other images", f'"{package_versions["{libDetail}[0]"]} != {libDetail}[1]"')
    return return_status

def compare_workload_created_date_with_current_date(workload_created_date, current_date):
    check_workload_created_date = evaluate(f"datetime.datetime.strptime('{workload_created_date}','%m/%d/%Y') <= datetime.datetime.strptime('{current_date}','%m/%d/%Y')")
    should_be_true(check_workload_created_date, f'Workload created date ({workload_created_date}) should be less than or equal to the current date ({current_date}).')


def request_explanation(inference_id, token, trusty_route, model_name, explainer_type):
    curl_cmd = set_variable(f'curl -sk -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer {token}"')
    curl_cmd = catenate(curl_cmd, "-H 'Content-Type: application/json'")
    curl_cmd = catenate(curl_cmd, f'-d "{ \\"predictionId\\": \\"{inference_id}\\", \\"config\\": {\\"model\\": { \\"target\\": \\"modelmesh-serving:8033\\", \\"name\\":\\"{model_name}\\", \\"version\\": \\"v1\\"}}}"')
    curl_cmd = catenate(curl_cmd, f'{trusty_route}/explainers/local/{explainer_type}')
    rc, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output(curl_cmd)
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0, output)
    should_contain(output, 'score')
    should_contain(output, 'confidence')

def environment_variables_should_be_available_in_jupyter(exp_env_variables):
    open_with_jupyterlab_menu('File', 'New', 'Notebook')
    sleep('1s')
    maybe_close_popup()
    maybe_select_kernel()
    sleep('3s')
    for idx, env_variable_dict in enumerate(exp_env_variables):
        remove_from_dictionary(env_variable_dict, 'k8s_type', 'input_type')
        n_pairs = get_length(env_variable_dict.keys())
        for pair_idx, key, value in enumerate(env_variable_dict):
            log(f'{pair_idx}-{key}-{value}')
            run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Run Cell And Check Output', f'import os;print(os.environ["{key}"])', value)
            capture_page_screenshot()
    open_with_jupyterlab_menu('Edit', 'Select All Cells')
    open_with_jupyterlab_menu('Edit', 'Delete Cells')

def get_model_pods_creation_date_and_image_url(model_name, namespace, container):
    created_at = oc_get(kind='Pod', label_selector=f'serving.kserve.io/inferenceservice={model_name}', namespace=namespace, fields='["metadata.creationTimestamp"]')
    rc, container_idx = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc get pod --selector serving.kserve.io/inferenceservice={model_name} -n {namespace} -o json | jq \'.items[].spec.containers | map(.name == "{container}") | index(true)\'')
    rc, image_url = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"oc get pod --selector serving.kserve.io/inferenceservice={model_name} -n {namespace} -ojson | jq '.items[].spec.containers[{container_idx}].image'")
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)
    return created_at, image_url

    if result.rc == 0:
        prom_namespace = set_variable(result.stdout)
        log(f'Prometheus is running in the namespace: {prom_namespace}',console='True')
        if RHODS_PROMETHEUS_URL == "" or RHODS_PROMETHEUS_URL == "PROMETHEUS_URL":
            result = run_process(f"oc get route prometheus -n {prom_namespace} -o jsonpath\='{.spec.host}'",shell='yes')
            should_be_true(f'{result.rc} == 0', f'Error getting Prometheus host: {result.stderr}')
            RHODS_PROMETHEUS_URL = set_variable(f'https://{result.stdout}')
            log(f'Prometheus URL: {RHODS_PROMETHEUS_URL}',console='True')
            set_global_variable(RHODS_PROMETHEUS_URL)
        if RHODS_PROMETHEUS_TOKEN == "" or RHODS_PROMETHEUS_TOKEN == "PROMETHEUS_TOKEN":
            result = run_process(f'oc create token prometheus -n {prom_namespace} --duration 6h',shell='yes')
            should_be_true(f'{result.rc} == 0', f'Error creating Prometheus token: {result.stderr}')
            RHODS_PROMETHEUS_TOKEN = set_variable(result.stdout)
            set_global_variable(RHODS_PROMETHEUS_TOKEN)
    else:
        log(message='No Prometheus namespace found', level='WARN')


def check_image_on_csv_and_deployment(component, deployment_name, label_selector, image):
    rc, managementState = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc get DataScienceCluster default-dsc -o jsonpath="{.spec.components[\'{component}\'].managementState}"')
    if managementState == "Managed":
        rc, csv_image = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc get ClusterServiceVersion -l {OPERATOR_SUBSCRIPTION_LABEL} -n {OPERATOR_NAMESPACE} -o jsonpath=\'{.items[?(@.kind=="ClusterServiceVersion")].spec.relatedImages[?(@.name=="{image}")].image}\'')
        should_be_equal(f'"{rc}"', '"0"',msg=csv_image)
        should_not_be_empty(csv_image)
        log_to_console(f'IMAGE ON CSV IS {csv_image}')
        wait_for_resources_to_be_available(deployment_name, label_selector)
        rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc get Deployment {deployment_name} -n {APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE} -o jsonpath=\'{.spec.template.spec.containers[?(@.images=="{csv_image}")]}\'')
        should_be_equal(f'"{rc}"', '"0"',msg=f'{csv_image} not found on {deployment_name} deployment')
        log_to_console(f'SUCCESS: Both CSV and Deployment {image} images match')

def get_model_inference(model_name, inference_input, token_auth=FALSE, project_title=NONE, kserve_mode='Serverless', deployment_mode='UI', service_port=8888, end_point=NONE, service_account_name='default-name', token=NONE):
    curl_cmd = set_variable(NONE)
    self_managed = is_rhods_self_managed()
    if deployment_mode == 'UI':
        url = get_model_route_via_ui(model_name)
        kserve = run_keyword_and_return_status('SeleniumLibrary.Page Should Contain', 'Single-model serving enabled')
        curl_cmd = set_variable(f'curl -s {url} -d {inference_input}')
        if token_auth:
            if project_title == NONE:
                project_title = get_model_project(model_name)
            if token == NONE:
                token = get_access_token_via_ui(project_title,service_account_name=service_account_name, single_model=kserve, model_name=model_name)
            curl_cmd = catenate(curl_cmd, f'-H "Authorization: Bearer {token}"')
        if kserve:
            fetch_knative_ca_certificate(filename='openshift_ca_istio_knative.crt')
            curl_cmd = catenate(curl_cmd, '--cacert openshift_ca_istio_knative.crt')
        elif self_managed:
            fetch_openshift_ca_bundle()
            curl_cmd = catenate(curl_cmd, '--cacert openshift_ca.crt')
    elif deployment_mode == 'Cli':
        rc, cmd_op = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"oc get isvc {model_name} -o jsonpath='{.metadata.annotations.serving\.kserve\.io/deploymentMode}' -n {project_title}")
        should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)
        if cmd_op != "ModelMesh":
            fetch_knative_ca_certificate(filename='openshift_ca_istio_knative.crt')
            cert = set_variable('--cacert openshift_ca_istio_knative.crt')
        elif self_managed:
            fetch_openshift_ca_bundle()
            cert = set_variable('--cacert openshift_ca.crt')
        if 'kserve_mode' == 'Serverless':
            rc, url = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"oc get ksvc {model_name}-predictor -n {project_title} -o jsonpath='{.status.url}'")
            should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)
            curl_cmd = set_variable(f'curl -s {url}{end_point} -d {inference_input}')
        elif 'kserve_mode' == 'RawDeployment':
            url = set_variable(f'http://localhost:{service_port}{end_point}')
            curl_cmd = set_variable(f'curl -s {url} -d {inference_input} --cacert openshift_ca_istio_knative.crt')
        else:
            log('"Modelmesh CLI mode only"')
        if token_auth:
            token = create_inference_access_token(project_title, DEFAULT_BUCKET_SA_NAME)
            curl_cmd = catenate(curl_cmd, f'-H "Authorization: Bearer {token}"')
    inference_output = run(curl_cmd)
    remove_file('openshift_ca_istio_knative.crt')
    remove_file('openshift_ca.crt')
    return inference_output

def verify_quick_starts_work_as_expected_when_restarting_the_previous_one(quickStartElements):
    for element in quickStartElements:
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Link Text On QuickStart Card Should Be',element=element, exp_link_text='Restart')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('QuickStart Status Should Not Be Set', element)
        open_quickstart_element_in_resource_section_by_name(element)
        count = get_the_count_of_quickstart_steps()
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Link Text On QuickStart Card Should Be',element=element, exp_link_text='Close')
        star_quickstart_tour()
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Current Step In QuickStart Should Be',n_steps=count, exp_step=1)
        close_quickstart_from_top(decision='cancel')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Current Step In QuickStart Should Be',n_steps=count, exp_step=1)
        close_quickstart_from_top(decision='leave')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Page Should Not Contain QuickStart Sidebar')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('QuickStart Status Should Be', element, 'In Progress')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Link Text On QuickStart Card Should Be',element=element, exp_link_text='Continue')

def stop_workbench(workbench_title, press_cancel=FALSE, from_running=TRUE):
    is_started = run_keyword_and_return_status('Workbench Status Should Be',workbench_title=workbench_title, status=WORKBENCH_STATUS_RUNNING)
    is_starting = run_keyword_and_return_status('Workbench Status Should Be',workbench_title=workbench_title, status=WORKBENCH_STATUS_STARTING)
    if is_started == TRUE or is_starting == TRUE:
        click_button(xpath=f'//div[@data-testid="table-row-title"]//*[text()="{workbench_title}"]/ancestor::tr//button[@data-testid="notebook-stop-action"]')
        wait_until_generic_modal_appears()
        handle_stop_workbench_confirmation_modal(workbench_title=workbench_title, press_cancel=press_cancel, from_running=from_running)
    else:
        fail(msg=f'Cannot stop workbench {workbench_title} because it is not neither running or starting...')

def get_list_of_atrributes(xpath, attribute):
    xpath = remove_string(xpath, ']')
    link_elements = get_webelements(f"{xpath} and not(starts-with({attribute}, '#'))]")
    list_of_atrributes = create_list()
    for ext_link in link_elements:
        ids = get_element_attribute(ext_link, attribute)
        append_to_list(list_of_atrributes, ids)
    return list_of_atrributes

def deploy_service_mesh_crs():
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc new-project {SERVICEMESH_CR_NS}')
    copy_file(SERVICEMESH_CONTROLPLANE_FILEPATH, f'{LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/smcp_filled.yaml')
