    copy_file(SERVICEMESH_ROLL_FILEPATH, f'{LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/smmr_filled.yaml')
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'sed -i\'\' -e "s/{{SERVICEMESH_CR_NS}}/{SERVICEMESH_CR_NS}/g" {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/smmr_filled.yaml')
    copy_file(SERVICEMESH_PEERAUTH_FILEPATH, f'{LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/peer_auth_filled.yaml')
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'sed -i\'\' -e "s/{{SERVICEMESH_CR_NS}}/{SERVICEMESH_CR_NS}/g" {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/peer_auth_filled.yaml')
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'sed -i\'\' -e "s/{{SERVERLESS_CR_NS}}/{SERVERLESS_CR_NS}/g" {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/peer_auth_filled.yaml')
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'sed -i\'\' -e "s/{{KSERVE_NS}}/{KSERVE_NS}/g" {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/peer_auth_filled.yaml')
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc apply -f {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/smcp_filled.yaml')
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc apply -f {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/smcp_filled.yaml')
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)
    wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector='app=istiod', namespace=SERVICEMESH_CR_NS)
    wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector='app=prometheus', namespace=SERVICEMESH_CR_NS)
    wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector='app=istio-ingressgateway', namespace=SERVICEMESH_CR_NS)
    wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector='app=istio-egressgateway', namespace=SERVICEMESH_CR_NS)
    wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector='app=jaeger', namespace=SERVICEMESH_CR_NS)
    wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector='app=kiali', namespace=SERVICEMESH_CR_NS)
    copy_file(SERVICEMESH_ROLL_FILEPATH, f'{LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/smmr_filled.yaml')
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"sed -i'' -e 's/{{SERVICEMESH_CR_NS}}/{SERVICEMESH_CR_NS}/g' {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/smmr_filled.yaml")
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"sed -i'' -e 's/{{KSERVE_NS}}/{KSERVE_NS}/g' {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/smmr_filled.yaml")
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc apply -f {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/smmr_filled.yaml')
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)
    add_peer_authentication(namespace=SERVICEMESH_CR_NS)
    add_peer_authentication(namespace=KSERVE_NS)

def install_rhoai_for_kserveraw(cluster_type, image_url):
    is_operator_installed = is_rhods_installed()
    if is_operator_installed:
        fail('Use a clean cluster to run this installation')
    if cluster_type == "selfmanaged":
        file_path = set_variable('tests/Resources/Files/operatorV2/')
        rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc create ns {OPERATOR_NAMESPACE}')
        if rc!=0:
            fail()
        log(out,console='yes')
        image_escaped = escape_forward_slashes(image_url)
        copy_file(source=f'{file_path}cs_template.yaml', destination=f'{file_path}cs_apply.yaml')
        run(f"sed -i'' -e 's/<OPERATOR_NAMESPACE>/openshift-marketplace/' {file_path}cs_apply.yaml")
        run(f"sed -i'' -e 's/<IMAGE_URL>/{image_escaped}/' {file_path}cs_apply.yaml")
        rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc apply -f {file_path}cs_apply.yaml')
        if rc!=0:
            fail()
        log(out,console='yes')
        remove_file(f'{file_path}cs_apply.yaml')
        wait_for_catalog_to_be_ready(catalog_name='rhoai-catalog-dev')
        copy_file(source=f'{file_path}operatorgroup_template.yaml', destination=f'{file_path}operatorgroup_apply.yaml')
        run(f"sed -i'' -e 's/<OPERATOR_NAMESPACE>/{OPERATOR_NAMESPACE}/' {file_path}operatorgroup_apply.yaml")
        rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc apply -f {file_path}operatorgroup_apply.yaml')
        if rc!=0:
            fail()
        log(out,console='yes')
        remove_file(f'{file_path}operatorgroup_apply.yaml')
        copy_file(source=f'{file_path}subscription_template.yaml', destination=f'{file_path}subscription_apply.yaml')
        run(f"sed -i'' -e 's/<OPERATOR_NAMESPACE>/{OPERATOR_NAMESPACE}/' {file_path}subscription_apply.yaml")
        run(f"sed -i'' -e 's/<UPDATE_CHANNEL>/{UPDATE_CHANNEL}/' {file_path}subscription_apply.yaml")
        run(f"sed -i'' -e 's/<CS_NAME>/rhoai-catalog-dev/' {file_path}subscription_apply.yaml")
        run(f"sed -i'' -e 's/<CS_NAMESPACE>/openshift-marketplace/' {file_path}subscription_apply.yaml")
        rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc apply -f {file_path}subscription_apply.yaml')
        if rc!=0:
            fail()
        log(out,console='yes')
        remove_file(f'{file_path}subscription_apply.yaml')
        wait_until_operator_subscription_last_condition_is(type='CatalogSourcesUnhealthy', status='False', reason='AllCatalogSourcesHealthy', subcription_name='rhoai-operator', namespace=OPERATOR_NAMESPACE)
    else:
        fail('Vanilla KserveRaw can only be installed in self-managed clusters')

def get_model_pod_label_selector(model_name, namespace):
    if IS_KSERVE_RAW:
        rc, hash = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"oc get pod -l serving.kserve.io/inferenceservice={model_name} -ojsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.labels.pod-template-hash}'")
        should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0,msg=hash)
        label_selector = set_variable(f'pod-template-hash={hash}')
    else:
        rev_id = get_current_revision_id(model_name=model_name, namespace=namespace)
        label_selector = set_variable(f'serving.knative.dev/revisionUID={rev_id}')
    return label_selector


def wait_for_deployment_replica_to_be_ready(label_selector, namespace, timeout='600s', exp_replicas=NONE):
    log_to_console(f'Waiting for Deployment with label "{label_selector}" in Namespace "{namespace}", to have desired Replica-Set ready')
    if exp_replicas != NONE:
        run_and_verify_command(f"oc get deployment -l {label_selector} -n {namespace} -o json | jq -e '.items[].spec | .replicas == {exp_replicas}'",print_to_log=FALSE)
    wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector, namespace, timeout, exp_replicas)
    run_and_verify_command(f"oc get deployment -l {label_selector} -n {namespace} -o json | jq -e '.status | .replicas == .readyReplicas'",print_to_log=FALSE)

def generate_modelregistry_certificates():
    output = run_process('pwd',shell='True', stdout='PIPE')
    log(f'Bash Command Output: {output.stdout}')
    generate_certs_script = set_variable('tests/Resources/CLI/ModelRegistry/generate_certs.sh')

def set_project_and_runtime(namespace, runtime_image=NONE, enable_metrics=FALSE, runtime='caikit-tgis-runtime', access_key_id=S3.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, access_key=S3.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, protocol='grpc', endpoint=MODELS_BUCKET.ENDPOINT, verify_ssl=TRUE, download_in_pvc=FALSE, storage_size='70Gi', model_name=NONE, model_path=model_name, download_timeout='600s', memory_request='40Gi'):
    set_up_test_openshift_project(test_ns=namespace)
    if download_in_pvc:
        create_pvc_and_download_model_from_s3(model_name=model_name, namespace=namespace, bucket_name=MODELS_BUCKET.NAME, use_https=USE_BUCKET_HTTPS, download_timeout=download_timeout, storage_size=storage_size, model_path=model_path, memory_request=memory_request)
    else:
        create_secret_for_s3_like_buckets(endpoint=endpoint, region=MODELS_BUCKET.REGION, namespace=namespace, access_key_id=access_key_id, access_key=access_key, verify_ssl=verify_ssl)
    deploy_serving_runtime(namespace=namespace, runtime=runtime, protocol=protocol)
    if enable_metrics == TRUE:
        enable_user_workload_monitoring()
        configure_user_workload_monitoring()
    else:
        log(message='Skipping UserWorkloadMonitoring enablement.')


def install_isv_operator_from_operatorhub_via_cli(operator_name, subscription_name, namespace='openshift-operators', channel='stable', catalog_source_name='certified-operators', cs_namespace='openshift-marketplace', operator_group_name=NONE, operator_group_ns=NONE, operator_group_target_ns=NONE):
    log_to_console(message=f"Installing the '{operator_name}' Operator")
    if operator_group_name != NONE:
        create_operator_group(name=operator_group_name, namespace=operator_group_ns, target_namespace=operator_group_target_ns, operator_name=operator_name)
    operator_sub_filepath = set_variable(f'{FILES_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/{operator_name}-sub.yaml')
    copy_file(SUBSCRIPTION_YAML_TEMPLATE_FILEPATH, operator_sub_filepath)
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'sed -i\'\' -e "s/<SUBSCRIPTION_NAME>/{subscription_name}/g" {operator_sub_filepath}')
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'sed -i\'\' -e "s/<OPERATOR_NAMESPACE>/{namespace}/g" {operator_sub_filepath}')
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'sed -i\'\' -e "s/<UPDATE_CHANNEL>/{channel}/g" {operator_sub_filepath}')
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'sed -i\'\' -e "s/<OPERATOR_NAME>/{operator_name}/g" {operator_sub_filepath}')
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'sed -i\'\' -e "s/<CATALOG_SOURCE>/{catalog_source_name}/g" {operator_sub_filepath}')
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'sed -i\'\' -e "s/<CS_NAMESPACE>/{cs_namespace}/g" {operator_sub_filepath}')
    oc_apply(kind='Subscription', src=operator_sub_filepath)
    wait_until_keyword_succeeds('1 min', '0 sec', 'Is Resource Present', 'Subscription', subscription_name, namespace, IS_PRESENT)
    while installplan_name == EMPTY:
        installplan_name = get_resource_attribute(namespace, 'Subscription', subscription_name, '.status.installPlanRef.name')
        sleep('20s')
    installplan_approval = get_resource_attribute(namespace, 'InstallPlan', installplan_name, '.spec.approval')
    if installplan_approval == "Manual":
        return_code, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc patch installplan {installplan_name} -n {namespace} --type=\'json\' -p \'[{"op": "replace", "path": "/spec/approved", "value": true}]\'')
        should_be_equal_as_integers(return_code, 0,msg='Error while approving installplan')

def run_regression_workload_on_notebook_image(image):
    if "minimal-notebook" in image:
        run_repo_and_clean('https://github.com/lugi0/minimal-nb-image-test', 'minimal-nb-image-test/minimal-nb.ipynb')
    elif "science-notebook" in image:
        run_repo_and_clean('https://github.com/lugi0/clustering-notebook', 'clustering-notebook/customer-segmentation-k-means-analysis.ipynb')
    elif "minimal-gpu" in image:
        nvcc_version = run_cell_and_get_output(input='!nvcc --version')
        should_not_contain(nvcc_version, '/usr/bin/sh: nvcc: command not found')
        run_repo_and_clean('https://github.com/lugi0/minimal-nb-image-test', 'minimal-nb-image-test/minimal-nb.ipynb')
    elif "tensorflow" in image:
        run_repo_and_clean('https://github.com/lugi0/notebook-benchmarks', 'notebook-benchmarks/tensorflow/GPU-no-warnings.ipynb')
    elif "pytorch" in image:
        run_repo_and_clean('https://github.com/lugi0/notebook-benchmarks', 'notebook-benchmarks/pytorch/PyTorch-MNIST-Minimal.ipynb')
    else:
        log_to_console('Unknown image')
        fail()


def get_cpu_requested(project, local_queue_name):
    result, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc get LocalQueue {local_queue_name} -n {project} -o=jsonpath=\'{.status.flavorsReservation[0].resources[?(@.name=="cpu")].total}\'')
    cpu_requested_array = get_regexp_matches(output, '(\\d+)m', 1)
    cpu_requested_array_length = get_length(cpu_requested_array)
    if cpu_requested_array_length == 0:
        cpu_requested = evaluate(output)
    else:
        cpu_requested_millicores = convert_to_number(f'{cpu_requested_array}[0]')
        cpu_requested = evaluate(f'{cpu_requested_millicores} / 1000')
    return cpu_requested


def get_events_and_pod_logs(namespace, label_selector):

    log(events)
    rc, podlogs = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc logs -l {label_selector} --all-containers -n {namespace} --ignore-errors')
    log(podlogs)
    return events, podlogs

def create_pvc_and_download_model_from_s3(model_name, bucket_name, use_https, namespace, storage_size, model_path, memory_request, download_timeout='500s'):
    set_log_level('NONE')
    set_test_variable(model_name)
    set_test_variable(bucket_name)
    set_test_variable(use_https)
    set_test_variable(namespace)
    set_test_variable(storage_size)
    set_test_variable(model_path)
    set_test_variable(memory_request)
    set_log_level('INFO')
    create_file_from_template(DOWNLOAD_PVC_FILEPATH, DOWNLOAD_PVC_FILLED_FILEPATH)
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc -n {namespace} apply -f {DOWNLOAD_PVC_FILLED_FILEPATH}')
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)
    remove_file(DOWNLOAD_PVC_FILLED_FILEPATH)
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Wait For Pods To Be Ready',label_selector=f'name=download-{model_name}', namespace=namespace)
    wait_for_pods_to_succeed(label_selector=f'name=download-{model_name}', namespace=namespace, timeout=download_timeout)
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc delete pods -l name=download-{model_name} -n {namespace}')
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)

def set_model_server_runtime(runtime='Caikit TGIS', retries=1):
    try:
        is_enabled = run_keyword_and_return_status('Element Should Be Enabled', 'xpath://button[@id="serving-runtime-template-selection"]')
        if is_enabled:
            for retry_idx in range(0, f'1+{retries}'):
                click_element('xpath://button[@id="serving-runtime-template-selection"]')
                page_should_contain_element(f'xpath://span[contains(., "{runtime}")]')
                selected = run_keyword_and_return_status('Click Element', f'xpath://span[contains(., "{runtime}")]')
                if selected==TRUE:
                    break
        else:
            element_should_be_disabled('id:serving-runtime-template-selection')
            text = get_text('xpath://button[@id="serving-runtime-template-selection"]/span')
            should_be_true(f'{runtime} in {text}')
    except ():
        log(f'framework {runtime} does not appear to be supported by the chosen model server')

def verify_installed_library_version(lib, ver):
    status, value = run_keyword_and_warn_on_failure('Run Cell And Check Output', f'!pip show {lib} | grep Version: | awk \'{split($0,a); print a[2]}\' | awk \'{split($0,b,"."); printf "%s.%s", b[1], b[2]}\'', ver)
    if 'status' == 'FAIL':
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('FAIL', f'"Expected {lib} at version {ver}, but {value}"')
    return status, value

def get_average_time_for_spawning(number_of_images):
    total_time = set_variable()
    for image in LIST_OF_IMAGES:
        avg = set_variable()
        spawn_and_stop_server(image)
        for counter in range(4):
            close_previous_tabs()
            sum = spawn_and_stop_server(image)
            avg = evaluate(f'{avg} + {sum}')
        avg = evaluate(f'{avg}/4')
        total_time = evaluate(f'{total_time} + {avg}')
    average_time = evaluate(f'{total_time} / {number_of_images}')
    return average_time


def verify_containers_have_zero_restarts(pod_names, namespace):
    pod_restart_data = get_containers_with_non_zero_restart_counts(pod_names, namespace)
    for pod_name, container_details in pod_restart_data:
        if len(container_details) > 0:
            run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('FAIL', f'Container restart "{container_details}" found for \'{pod_name}\' pod.')
        else:
            log('No container with restart count found!')

def perform_dashboard_api_endpoint_patch_call(endpoint, token, body, str_to_json=TRUE):
    headers = create_dictionary('Content-type=application/json',Cookie=f'_oauth_proxy={token}')
    payload = prepare_payload(body=body, str_to_json=str_to_json)
    args = create_dictionary(url=f'{ODH_DASHBOARD_URL}/{endpoint}', expected_status='any', headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=5, verify=False)
    response = run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Perform Request', 'PATCH', '&{args}')
    if response == NONE:
        log(msg='HTTP response is empty. The request may have failed to be performed', level='ERROR')

def export_variables_from_file(variables_file):
    file_data = get_file(variables_file)
    list = split_to_lines(file_data)
    for line in list:
        log(line)
        line = remove_string(line, 'export')
        var_and_value = split_string(string=line, separator='=')
        set_suite_variable(f'{{var_and_value}[0]}', f'{var_and_value}[1]')

def verify_blackboxexporter_includes_oauth_proxy():
    pod = find_first_pod_by_name(namespace=MONITORING_NAMESPACE, pod_regex='blackbox-exporter-')
    containers = get_containers(pod_name=pod, namespace=MONITORING_NAMESPACE)

def load_expected_data_of_rhods_explore_section():
    apps_dict_obj = load_json_file(APPS_DICT_PATH_LATEST)
    apps_dict_obj = set_variable(f'{apps_dict_obj}[apps]')
    is_self_managed = is_rhods_self_managed()
    if is_self_managed == TRUE:
        installed_rhods_type = set_variable('Self-managed')
    else:
        installed_rhods_type = set_variable('Cloud Service')
    for index, app in enumerate(apps_dict_obj):
        log(f'{index}: {app}: {apps_dict_obj}[{app}][rhods_type]')
        to_be_displayed = run_keyword_and_return_status('List Should Contain Value', f'{apps_dict_obj}[{app}][rhods_type]', installed_rhods_type)
        if to_be_displayed == FALSE:
            remove_from_dictionary(apps_dict_obj, app)
    return apps_dict_obj

def deploy_serverless_crs():
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc new-project {SERVERLESS_CR_NS}')
    add_peer_authentication(namespace=SERVERLESS_CR_NS)
    add_namespace_to_servicemeshmemberroll(namespace=SERVERLESS_CR_NS)
    copy_file(SERVERLESS_KNATIVECR_FILEPATH, f'{LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/knativeserving_istio_filled.yaml')
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"sed -i'' -e 's/{{SERVERLESS_CR_NS}}/{SERVERLESS_CR_NS}/g' {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/knativeserving_istio_filled.yaml")
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc apply -f {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/knativeserving_istio_filled.yaml')
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)
    sleep('15s')
    wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector='app=controller', namespace=SERVERLESS_CR_NS)
    wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector='app=net-istio-controller', namespace=SERVERLESS_CR_NS)
    wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector='app=net-istio-webhook', namespace=SERVERLESS_CR_NS)
    wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector='app=autoscaler-hpa', namespace=SERVERLESS_CR_NS)
    wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector='app=domain-mapping', namespace=SERVERLESS_CR_NS)
    wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector='app=webhook', namespace=SERVERLESS_CR_NS)
    wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector='app=activator', namespace=SERVERLESS_CR_NS)
    wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector='app=autoscaler', namespace=SERVERLESS_CR_NS)
    enable_toleration_feature_in_knativeserving(knative_serving_ns=SERVERLESS_CR_NS)

def set_default_storage_class_in_gcp(default):
    rc = run_and_return_rc(f'oc get storageclass {default}')
    if rc == 0:
        if default == "ssd-csi":
            run('oc patch storageclass standard-csi -p \'{"metadata": {"annotations":{"storageclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class":"false"}}}\'')
            run('oc patch storageclass ssd-csi -p \'{"metadata": {"annotations":{"storageclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class":"true"}}}\'')
        else:
            run('oc patch storageclass ssd-csi -p \'{"metadata": {"annotations":{"storageclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class":"false"}}}\'')
            run('oc patch storageclass standard-csi -p \'{"metadata": {"annotations":{"storageclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class":"true"}}}\'')
    else:
        log("Proceeding with default storage class because we're not in GCP")


def verify_that_server_can_be_stopped(timeout=30):
    handle_control_panel()
    wait_until_jupyterhub_spawner_is_ready()
    notebook_pod_name = get_user_notebook_pod_name(TEST_USER_3.USERNAME)
    stopped = set_variable(False)
    try:
        while not stopped:
            stopped = run_keyword_and_return_status('Run Keyword And Expect Error', 'Pods not found in search', 'OpenShiftLibrary.Search Pods', notebook_pod_name,namespace=NOTEBOOKS_NAMESPACE)
            sleep('1s')
    except ('WHILE loop was aborted',):
        delete_user_notebook_cr(TEST_USER_3.USERNAME)
        fail(f'User Notebook pod was not removed within {timeout}s')


def spawn_notebook(spawner_timeout='600 seconds', same_tab=True, expect_autoscaling=False):
    click_button('Start server')
    modal = run_keyword_and_return_status('Wait Until Page Contains', 'Starting server', '60s')
    if modal==False:
        log(message="Starting server modal didn't appear after 60s", level='ERROR')
        control_panel_visible = control_panel_is_visible()
        if control_panel_visible==True:
            click_button('Return to server')
            wait_until_page_does_not_contain_element(f'xpath:{KFNBC_CONTROL_PANEL_HEADER_XPATH}',timeout='15s', error="Redirect hasn't happened, check route annotation (opendatahub.io/link) in Notebook CR")
            return
        else:
            reload_page()
            sleep('5s')
            spawner_visible = jupyterhub_spawner_is_visible()
            control_panel_visible = control_panel_is_visible()
            JL_visible = jupyterlab_is_visible()
            if spawner_visible==True:
                modal_visible = spawner_modal_is_visible()
                if modal_visible==True:
                    spawn_fail = has_spawn_failed()
                    if spawn_fail==True:
                        return
                    else:
                        sleep('1s')
                        capture_page_screenshot()
            elif control_panel_visible==True:
                click_button('Return to server')
                return
            elif JL_Visible==True:
                return
            else:
                capture_page_screenshot()
                fail(msg='Unknown scenario while spawning server')
    wait_until_element_is_visible('xpath://div[@role="progressbar"]')
    if expect_autoscaling:
        wait_until_page_contains('TriggeredScaleUp',timeout='120s')
    wait_until_page_contains('The notebook server is up and running.', spawner_timeout)
    if same_tab:
        click_button('Open in current tab')
    else:
        click_button('Open in new tab')
        switch_window('NEW')

def load_json_file(file_path, as_string=FALSE):
    j_file = get_file(file_path)
    obj = evaluate(f"json.loads(r'''{j_file}''')", 'json')
    if as_string:
        obj = evaluate(f'json.dumps({obj})', 'json')
    return obj

def run_and_verify_command(command, print_to_log=TRUE, expected_rc=0):

    if print_to_log:
        log(result.stdout,console='True')
    should_be_true(f'{result.rc} == {expected_rc}')
    return result.stdout

def get_cpu_requested_tooltip_text():
    mouse_over(xpath='//*[@aria-label="CPU usage/requested"]')
    wait_until_element_is_visible("xpath://*[starts-with(@id,'pf-tooltip-')]")
    cpu_usage_hover_data = get_text("xpath://*[starts-with(@id,'pf-tooltip-')]")
    cpu_usage_list = split_to_lines(cpu_usage_hover_data)
    cpu_usage_line = set_variable(f'{cpu_usage_list}[0]')
    cpu_requested_line = set_variable(f'{cpu_usage_list}[1]')
    cpu_usage_value_array = get_regexp_matches(cpu_usage_line, '\\d+\\.?\\d*')
    cpu_requested_value_array = get_regexp_matches(cpu_requested_line, '\\d+\\.?\\d*')
    return f'{cpu_usage_value_array}[0]', f'{cpu_requested_value_array}[0]'

def run_and_watch_command(command, timeout='10 min', output_should_contain=NONE, output_should_not_contain=NONE, cwd='/Users/jdanek/IdeaProjects/ods-ci/ods_ci/tests/Resources'):
    log(f'Watching command output: {command}',console='True')
    is_test = run_keyword_and_return_status('Variable Should Exist', TEST NAME)
    if is_test == FALSE:
        incremental = generate_random_string(5, '[NUMBERS]')
        TEST NAME = set_variable(f'testlogs-{incremental}')
    process_log = set_variable(f'{OUTPUT DIR}/{TEST NAME}.log')
    temp_log = set_variable(f'{TEMPDIR}/{TEST NAME}.log')
    create_file(process_log)
    create_file(temp_log)
    process_id = start_process(command,shell='True', stdout=process_log, stderr='STDOUT', cwd=cwd)
    log('Shell process started in the background',console='True')
    wait_until_keyword_succeeds(timeout, '10 s', 'Check Process Output and Status', process_id, process_log, temp_log)
    proc_result = wait_for_process(process_id,timeout='3 secs')
    terminate_process(process_id,kill='true')
    should_be_equal_as_integers(proc_result.rc, 0,msg=f'Error occured while running: {command}')
    if output_should_contain != NONE:
        result = run_process(f"grep '{output_should_contain}' '{process_log}'",shell='yes')
        should_be_true(f'{result.rc} == 0',msg=f"'{process_log}' should contain '{output_should_contain}'")
    if output_should_not_contain != NONE:
        result = run_process(f"grep -L '{output_should_not_contain}' '{process_log}' | grep .",shell='yes')
        should_be_true(f'{result.rc} == 0',msg=f"'{process_log}' should not contain '{output_should_not_contain}'")
    return proc_result.rc

def get_resource_attribute(namespace, resource_type, resource_name, attribute_path):
    rc, value = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"oc get {resource_type}/{resource_name} -n {namespace} -o 'jsonpath={{attribute_path}}'")
    should_be_equal(f'"{rc}"', '"0"',msg=value)
    if value != EMPTY:
        log_to_console(f'{resource_type} {resource_name} in the namespace {namespace} attribute {attribute_path} value is {value}')
    else:
        log_to_console(f'{resource_type} {resource_name} in the namespace {namespace} attribute {attribute_path} value is EMPTY')
    return value

def wait_until_rhoam_installation_is_completed(retries=30, retries_interval='2min'):
    for retry_idx in range(0, f'1+{retries}'):
        log_to_console(f'checking rhoam stage: retry {retry_idx}')
        current_stage = get_rhoam_installation_stage()
        log_to_console(f'RHOAM current installation stage: {current_stage}')
        completed_flag = run_keyword_and_return_status('Should Be Equal', current_stage, 'complete')
        exit_for_loop_if('$completed_flag == True')
        sleep(retries_interval)
    if completed_flag == False:
        fail(f'RHOAM didn\'t get "complete" stage after {retries} retries.', f'(time between retries: {retries_interval}). Check the cluster..')

def delete_configmap_using_name(namespace, configmap_name):
    config_exists = check_if_configmap_exists(namespace, configmap_name)
    if 'config_exists'=='PASS':
        deleted_config = oc_delete(kind='ConfigMap', name=configmap_name, namespace=namespace)
        if len(deleted_config) == 0:
            fail(f'Error deleting configmaps: {deleted_config}')
        config_exists = check_if_configmap_exists(namespace, configmap_name)
        if 'config_exists'=='PASS':
            fail(f"ConfigMap '{configmap_name}' in namespace '{namespace}' still exists")
    else:
        log(level='WARN', message=f"No configmaps present with name '{configmap_name}' in '{namespace}' namespace")

def create_secret_for_s3_like_buckets(name=DEFAULT_BUCKET_SECRET_NAME, sa_name=DEFAULT_BUCKET_SA_NAME, namespace=TEST_NS, endpoint=S3.AWS_DEFAULT_ENDPOINT, region=S3.AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, access_key_id=S3.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, access_key=S3.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, use_https=USE_BUCKET_HTTPS, verify_ssl=TRUE):
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc get secret {name} -n {namespace}')
    if rc == 0:
        log(message=f'Secret {name} in {namespace} NS already present. Skipping secret setup...', level='WARN')
        return
    copy_file(BUCKET_SECRET_FILEPATH, f'{LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/bucket_secret_filled.yaml')
    copy_file(BUCKET_SA_FILEPATH, f'{LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/bucket_sa_filled.yaml')
    endpoint = replace_string(endpoint, 'https://', EMPTY)
    endpoint_escaped = escape_string_chars(str=endpoint)
    accesskey_escaped = escape_string_chars(str=access_key)
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"sed -i'' -e 's/{{ENDPOINT}}/{endpoint_escaped}/g' {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/bucket_secret_filled.yaml")
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"sed -i'' -e 's/{{USE_HTTPS}}/{use_https}/g' {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/bucket_secret_filled.yaml")
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"sed -i'' -e 's/{{REGION}}/{region}/g' {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/bucket_secret_filled.yaml")
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"sed -i'' -e 's/{{ACCESS_KEY_ID}}/{access_key_id}/g' {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/bucket_secret_filled.yaml")
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"sed -i'' -e 's/{{SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}}/{accesskey_escaped}/g' {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/bucket_secret_filled.yaml")
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"sed -i'' -e 's/{{NAME}}/{name}/g' {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/bucket_secret_filled.yaml")
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"sed -i'' -e 's/{{NAME}}/{sa_name}/g' {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/bucket_sa_filled.yaml")
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc apply -f {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/bucket_secret_filled.yaml -n {namespace}')
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)
    run_keyword_and_ignore_error('Run', f'oc create -f {LLM_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/bucket_sa_filled.yaml -n {namespace}')
    add_secret_to_service_account(sa_name=sa_name, secret_name=name, namespace=namespace)
    if verify_ssl == FALSE:
        rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"oc annotate secret {name} -n {namespace} serving.kserve.io/s3-verifyssl='false' --overwrite")
        should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)

def find_max_number_of_gpus_in_one_node():
    max_gpus = set_variable(0)
    node_names = get_gpu_nodes()
    for node in node_names:
        node_gpu_num = run(f'oc describe node {node} | grep nvidia.com/gpu.count | awk \'{split($0,a); print a[1]}\' | awk \'{split($0,b,"="); printf "%s", b[2]}\'')
        node_gpu_num = convert_to_integer(node_gpu_num)
        if node_gpu_num > max_gpus:
            max_gpus = set_variable(node_gpu_num)
    return max_gpus

def run_training_operator_odh_test(TEST_NAME, test_binary):
    log_to_console(f'"Running test: {TEST_NAME}"')
    result = run_process(f'./{test_binary} -test.run {TEST_NAME}', 'env:CODEFLARE_TEST_TIMEOUT_SHORT=5m', 'env:CODEFLARE_TEST_TIMEOUT_MEDIUM=10m', 'env:CODEFLARE_TEST_TIMEOUT_LONG=20m', f'env:CODEFLARE_TEST_OUTPUT_DIR=%{WORKSPACE}/codeflare-{test_binary}-logs', f'env:FMS_HF_TUNING_IMAGE={FMS_HF_TUNING_IMAGE}',shell='true', stderr='STDOUT')
    log_to_console(result.stdout)
    check_missing_go_test(result.stdout)
    if result.rc != 0:
        fail(f'{TEST_NAME} failed')

def container_hardware_resources_should_match_expected(container_name, pod_label_selector, namespace, exp_requests=NONE, exp_limits=NONE):
    resources_dict = get_pod_hardware_resources_and_limits(label_selector=pod_label_selector, namespace=namespace, container_name=container_name)
    if exp_requests == NONE:
        dictionary_should_not_contain_key(resources_dict, 'requests')
    else:
        requests = set_variable(f'{resources_dict}[requests]')
        for index, resource in enumerate(exp_requests.keys()):
            should_be_equal_as_strings(f'{requests}[{resource}]', f'{exp_requests}[{resource}]')
    if exp_limits == NONE:
        dictionary_should_not_contain_key(resources_dict, 'limits')
    else:
        limits = set_variable(f'{resources_dict}[limits]')
        for index, resource in enumerate(exp_limits.keys()):
            should_be_equal_as_strings(f'{limits}[{resource}]', f'{exp_limits}[{resource}]')

def extract_service_port(service_name, namespace, protocol):
    protocol_name = set_variable('name')
    if 'protocol' == 'grpc':
        port_name = set_variable('h2c')
    elif 'protocol' == 'TCP':
        protocol_name = set_variable('protocol')
        port_name = set_variable('TCP')
    else:
        port_name = set_variable(protocol)
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc get svc/{service_name} -n {namespace} -o jsonpath=\'{range .spec.ports[?(@.{protocol_name}=="{port_name}")]}{@.targetPort}{end}\'')
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0,msg=out)
    return out


def add_ui_admin_group_to_dashboard_admin():
    status = run_keyword_and_return_status('Check Group In Cluster', 'odh-ux-admins')
    if status == TRUE:
        rc, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc wait --for=condition=ready pod -l app=odh-dashboard -n {APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE} --timeout=400s')
        if rc != 0:
            log(message='Dashboard Pod is not up and running', level='ERROR')
        rc, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc patch OdhDashboardConfig odh-dashboard-config -n {APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE} --type merge -p \'{"spec":{"groupsConfig":{"adminGroups":"odh-admins,odh-ux-admins"}}}\'')
        if rc != 0:
            log(message='Unable to update the admin config', level='WARN')

def get_average_availability_for_time_range(pm_url, pm_token, time_range='15m', precision=2):
    response = prometheus.run_query(pm_url=pm_url, pm_token=pm_token, pm_query=f'avg_over_time(rhods_aggregate_availability[{time_range}])*100')
    value = set_variable(response.json()["data"]["result"][0]["value"][-1])
    value = convert_to_number(value, precision)
    return value


def run_command_in_container(namespace, pod_name, command, container_name=EMPTY):
    if container_name == EMPTY:
        output = run(f'oc exec {pod_name} -n {namespace} -- {command}')
    else:
        output = run(f'oc exec {pod_name} -n {namespace} -c {container_name} -- {command}')
    return output

def delete_buildconfig_using_name(namespace, name):
    config_exists = check_if_buildconfig_exists(namespace, name)
    if 'config_exists'=='PASS':
        oc_delete(kind='BuildConfig', name=name, namespace=namespace)
        wait_until_keyword_succeeds('10s', '2s', 'Dependent Build Should Not Present', name)
        config_exists = check_if_buildconfig_exists(namespace, name)
        if 'config_exists'=='PASS':
            fail(f"BuildConfig with name '{name}' in namespace '{namespace}' still exists")
    else:
        log(level='WARN', message=f"No BuildConfig present with name '{name}' in '{namespace}' namespace")


def get_kserve_inference_host_via_cli(isvc_name, namespace, retries=10):
    ksvc_host = set_variable("")
    condition1 = evaluate(f'{ksvc_host}=="{EMPTY}"')
    condition2 = evaluate(f'{retries} > 0')
    while condition1 and condition2:
        sleep('5s')
        rc, ksvc_host = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"oc get isvc {isvc_name} -n {namespace} -o jsonpath='{.status.url}' | cut -d'/' -f3")
        should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)
        retries = evaluate(f'{retries} - 1')
        condition1 = evaluate(f'"{ksvc_host}"=="{EMPTY}"')
        condition2 = evaluate(f'{retries} > 0')
    should_not_be_empty(ksvc_host)
    return ksvc_host


def create_openstack_resources():
    log(f"Creating OSP resources in Cloud '{infrastructure_configurations}[osp_cloud_name]'",console='True')
    result = run_process(f"echo '{infrastructure_configurations}[osp_cloud_name]' | base64 -w0",shell='yes')
    should_be_true(f'{result.rc} == 0')
    set_task_variable(OSP_CLOUD, result.stdout)
    FIP_API = evaluate(f"{infrastructure_configurations}.get('fip_api')")
    FIP_APPS = evaluate(f"{infrastructure_configurations}.get('fip_apps')")
    run_keyword_if(f'"{FIP_API}" == "" or "{FIP_APPS}" == ""', 'Create Floating IPs', 'ELSE', 'Log', 'Reusing existing Floating IPs',console='True')
    set_task_variable(FIP_API)
    set_task_variable(FIP_APPS)
    log(f'FIP_API = {FIP_API}',console='True')
    log(f'FIP_APPS = {FIP_APPS}',console='True')
    hive_yaml = set_variable(f'{artifacts_dir}/{cluster_name}_hive.yaml')
    create_file_from_template(template, hive_yaml)
    log(f'OSP Hive configuration for cluster {cluster_name}: {hive_yaml}',console='True')
    oc_apply(kind='List', src=hive_yaml, api_version='v1')


def verify_quick_starts_work_as_expected_when_one_step_is_marked_as_no(quickStartElements):
    for element in quickStartElements:
        open_quickstart_element_in_resource_section_by_name(element)
        count = get_the_count_of_quickstart_steps()
        star_quickstart_tour()
        for index in range(count):
            wait_until_keyword_succeeds('2 times', '0.3s', 'Mark Step Check As Yes')
            if index != count-1:
                go_to_next_quickstart_step()
        wait_until_keyword_succeeds('2 times', '0.3s', 'Mark Step Check As No')
        go_to_next_quickstart_step()
        close_quickstart_from_button()
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('QuickStart Status Should Be', element, 'Failed')


def push_some_changes_to_repo(github username, token, filepath, githublink, commitmsgg):
    clone_git_repository_in_current_folder(githublink)
    close_all_jupyterlab_tabs()
    open_folder_or_file(filepath)
    open_with_jupyterlab_menu('Edit', 'Select All Cells')
    open_with_jupyterlab_menu('Edit', 'Delete Cells')
    enter_text_in_file_and_save(code=f'print("Hi Hello {commitmsgg}")')
    set_simple_staging_status(status='ON')
    commit_changes(commit_message=commitmsgg, name=GITHUB_USER.USERNAME, email_id=GITHUB_USER.EMAIL)
    push_changes_to_remote(github_username=GITHUB_USER.USERNAME, token=GITHUB_USER.TOKEN)
    set_simple_staging_status(status='OFF')
    close_all_jupyterlab_tabs()
    sleep('2s')
    open_new_notebook()
    output = get_last_commit_message()
    should_be_equal(commitmsgg, output)

def verify_cpu_and_memory_requests_and_limits_are_defined_for_pod_container(container_info, nvidia_gpu=FALSE):
    container_info_dict = set_variable(container_info)
    openshift_resource_component_should_contain_field(container_info_dict, 'resources')
    if 'resources' in container_info_dict:
        openshift_resource_component_should_contain_field(container_info_dict.resources, 'requests')
    if 'resources' in container_info_dict:
        openshift_resource_component_should_contain_field(container_info_dict.resources, 'limits')
    if 'requests' in container_info_dict.resources:
        openshift_resource_component_should_contain_field(container_info_dict.resources.requests, 'cpu')
    if 'requests' in container_info_dict.resources:
        openshift_resource_component_should_contain_field(container_info_dict.resources.requests, 'memory')
    if 'limits' in container_info_dict.resources:
        openshift_resource_component_should_contain_field(container_info_dict.resources.limits, 'cpu')
    if 'limits' in container_info_dict.resources:
        openshift_resource_component_should_contain_field(container_info_dict.resources.limits, 'memory')
    if nvidia_gpu == TRUE:
        if 'requests' in container_info_dict.resources:
            openshift_resource_component_should_contain_field(container_info_dict.resources.requests, 'nvidia.com/gpu')
        if 'limits' in container_info_dict.resources:
            openshift_resource_component_should_contain_field(container_info_dict.resources.limits, 'nvidia.com/gpu')

def open_workbench(workbench_title):
    desc = does_workbench_have_a_description(workbench_title)
    open_workbench_link = set_variable(f'{WORKBENCH_SECTION_XP}//td[@data-label="Name"]//*[.="{workbench_title}"]')
    if desc:
        open_workbench_link = catenate(open_workbench_link, '/../../../td//a[.="Open"]')
    else:
        open_workbench_link = catenate(open_workbench_link, '/../../td//a[.="Open"]')
    seleniumlibrary.wait_until_page_contains_element(open_workbench_link,timeout='30s')
    seleniumlibrary.click_link(open_workbench_link)
    previous_handle = seleniumlibrary.switch_window('NEW')
    return previous_handle

def access_to_workbench(username, password, auth_type, expected_ide='JupyterLab'):
    run_keyword_and_warn_on_failure('Wait Until Page Contains', 'Log in with OpenShift',timeout='15s')
    oauth_prompt_visible = is_openshift_oauth_login_prompt_visible()
    if oauth_prompt_visible:
        click_button('Log in with OpenShift')
    run_keyword_and_warn_on_failure('Login To Openshift', username, password, auth_type)
    authorization_required = is_service_account_authorization_required()
    if authorization_required:
        authorize_jupyterhub_service_account()
    if expected_ide=="VSCode":
        wait_until_page_contains_element('xpath://div[@class="menubar-menu-button"]',timeout='60s')
        wait_until_page_contains_element('xpath://div[@class="monaco-dialog-box"]',timeout='60s')
        wait_until_page_contains('Do you trust the authors of the files in this folder?')
    elif expected_ide=="JupyterLab":
        wait_until_page_contains_element('xpath://div[@id="jp-top-panel"]',timeout='90s')
        maybe_close_popup()
    else:
        fail(msg=f"Unknown IDE typy given: '{expected_ide}'. Please check and fix or implement.")


def check_pagination_is_correct_on_the_current_page(page, total):
    actual_text = seleniumlibrary.get_text('xpath://button[@id="table-pagination-top-toggle"]')
    if page==1:
        expected_text = set_variable(f'1 - 10 of {total} items')
    elif page==2:
        expected_text = set_variable(f'11 - {total} of {total} items')
    should_be_equal(expected_text, actual_text)

def login_to_cluster():
    cluster_kubeconf = set_variable(f'{artifacts_dir}/kubeconfig')
    export_variables_from_file(cluster_details)
    create_file(cluster_kubeconf)
    result = run_process(f'KUBECONFIG\={cluster_kubeconf} oc login --username\={username} --password\={password} {api} --insecure-skip-tls-verify',shell='yes')
    should_be_true(f'{result.rc} == 0')
    result = run_process(f'KUBECONFIG\={cluster_kubeconf} oc status',shell='yes')
    log(f'{result.stdout}\n{result.stderr}',console='True')
    should_be_true(f'{result.rc} == 0')

def check_distributed_worklaod_status_overview(job_name, job_status, job_status_message):

def check_http_status_code(link_to_check, expected=200, timeout=20, verify_ssl=True, allow_redirects=True):
    headers = create_dictionary('User-Agent="Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64; rv:128.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/128.0"')
    response = requestslibrary.get(link_to_check,expected_status='any', headers=headers, timeout=timeout, verify=verify_ssl, allow_redirects=allow_redirects)
    status_verified = run_keyword_and_return_status('Status Should Be', expected, response)
    if not status_verified:
        log(f"URL '{link_to_check}' returned '{response.status_code}' - Retrying with empty Headers",console='True')
        response = requestslibrary.get(link_to_check,expected_status='any', timeout=timeout, verify=verify_ssl, allow_redirects=allow_redirects)
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Status Should Be', expected, response)
    return response.status_code


def login_to_openshift(ocp_user_name, ocp_user_pw, ocp_user_auth_type):
    expected_text_list = create_list('Log in with', 'Administrator', 'Developer', 'Data Science Projects')
    wait_until_page_contains_a_string_in_list(expected_text_list)
    should_login = does_current_sub_domain_start_with('https://oauth')
    if not should_login:
        return
    wait_until_element_is_visible('xpath://div[@class="pf-c-login"]',timeout='10s')
    select_auth_type = does_login_require_authentication_type()
    if select_auth_type:
        select_login_authentication_type(ocp_user_auth_type)
    wait_until_page_contains('Log in to your account')
    input_text(ocp_user_name,id='inputUsername')
    input_text(ocp_user_pw,id='inputPassword')
    click_button('//*[@type="submit"]')
    maybe_skip_tour()
    wait_until_page_does_not_contain('Log in to your account',timeout='30s')


def fetch_max_number_of_gpus_in_spawner_page():
    gpu_visible = run_keyword_and_return_status('Wait Until Accelerator Dropdown Exists')
    if gpu_visible==True:
        set_gpu_accelerator()
        max_operator_detected = run_keyword_and_return_status('Page Should Contain Element',xpath=KFNBC_MAX_ACCELERATOR_WARNING_XPATH)
        while not max_operator_detected:
            click_element(f'xpath:{KFNBC_ACCELERATOR_PLUS_BUTTON_XPATH}')
            max_operator_detected = run_keyword_and_return_status('Page Should Contain Element',xpath=KFNBC_MAX_ACCELERATOR_WARNING_XPATH)
            maxGPUs = get_value(f'xpath:{KFNBC_ACCELERATOR_INPUT_XPATH}')
            maxGPUs = convert_to_integer(maxGPUs)
            maxGPUs = set_variable(maxGPUs-1)
    else:
        maxGPUs = set_variable(0)
    return maxGPUs

def model_response_should_be(response, model_name, inference_type, runtime, query_idx=0):
    cleaned_response_text = replace_string_using_regexp(response, '\\s+', SPACE)
    rc, cleaned_response_text = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"echo -e '{cleaned_response_text}'")
    cleaned_response_text = replace_string_using_regexp(cleaned_response_text, '"', "'")
    if inference_type == "model-info":
        exp_response = set_variable(f'{EXP_RESPONSES}[{inference_type}][{model_name}][{runtime}]')
    else:
        exp_response = set_variable(f'{EXP_RESPONSES}[queries][{query_idx}][models][{model_name}][{runtime}][{inference_type}_response_text]')
    cleaned_exp_response_text = replace_string_using_regexp(exp_response, '\\s+', SPACE)
    predcited_ratio = get_strings_matching_ratio(cleaned_response_text, cleaned_exp_response_text)
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Compare GreaterOrEqual Based On Number', MATCHING_RATIO, predcited_ratio)


def verify_the_permissions_of_folder(path, permission):
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Run Cell And Check Output', f'!stat {path} | grep Access | awk \'{split($2,b,"."); printf "%s", b[1]}\' | awk \'{split($0, c, "/"); printf c[1]}\' | cut -c 2-5', f'{permission}[0]')
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Run Cell And Check Output', f'!stat {path} | grep Uid | awk \'{split($9,b,"."); printf "%s", b[1]}\' | awk \'{split($0, c, "/"); printf c[1]}\'', f'{permission}[1]')
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Run Cell And Check Output', f'!stat {path} | grep Gid | awk \'{split($5,b,"."); printf "%s", b[1]}\' | awk \'{split($0, c, "/"); printf c[1]}\'', f'{permission}[2]')

    displayed_key = get_value(displayed_key_xp)
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Should Be Equal As Strings', displayed_key, expected_key)
    displayed_val = get_value(displayed_value_xp)
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Should Be Equal As Strings', displayed_val, expected_value)
    if type == "Secret":
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Element Attribute Value Should Be', displayed_value_xp, 'type', 'password')
    else:
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Element Attribute Value Should Be', displayed_value_xp, 'type', 'text')

def get_current_memory_usage(namespace, workload_type):
    thanos_url = get_openshift_thanos_url()
    token = generate_thanos_token()
    expression = set_variable(f'sum by(owner_name, owner_kind) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind=~"{workload_type}", namespace="{namespace}"} * on (namespace, pod) group_right(owner_name, owner_kind) node_namespace_pod_container:container_memory_working_set_bytes)')
    wait_until_element_is_visible(xpath='//*[@id="topResourceConsumingMemory-ChartLegend-ChartLabel-0"]', timeout=60)
    query_result = prometheus.run_query(f'https://{thanos_url}', token, expression)
    if query_result.json()["data"]["result"] == "[]":
        for retry in range(MAX_RETRIES):
            query_result = prometheus.run_query(f'https://{thanos_url}', token, expression)
            exit_for_loop_if(f'"{query_result.json()["data"]["result"]}" != "[]"')
            log('failed. Retrying...')
            wait_until_element_is_visible(xpath='//*[@id="topResourceConsumingMemory-ChartLegend-ChartLabel-0"]', timeout=60)
    memory_usage_value = get_query_value(query_result)
    memory_requested = convert_to_number(memory_usage_value)
    memory_requested_gb_value = evaluate(f'round( {memory_requested} / (1024**3), 3)')
    return memory_requested_gb_value

def create_operator_group(name, namespace, target_namespace, operator_name):
    operator_group_filepath = set_variable(f'{FILES_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/{operator_name}-group.yaml')
    copy_file(OPERATORGROUP_YAML_TEMPLATE_FILEPATH, operator_group_filepath)
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'sed -i\'\' -e "s/<BASE_NAME>/{name}/g" {operator_group_filepath}')
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'sed -i\'\' -e "s/<NAMESPACE>/{namespace}/g" {operator_group_filepath}')
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'sed -i\'\' -e "s/<TARGET_NAMESPACE>/{target_namespace}/g" {operator_group_filepath}')
    oc_apply(kind='OperatorGroup', src=operator_group_filepath, api_version='v1')
    if target_namespace == NONE:
        rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc patch OperatorGroup {name} -n {namespace} -p \'{"spec": null}\' --type=merge')
        should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)
        rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc patch OperatorGroup {name} -n {namespace} -p \'{"spec": {}}\' --type=merge')
        should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)

def remove_oauth_token_from_header(headers, token):
    oauth_present = run_keyword_and_return_status('Dictionary Should Contain Key',dictionary=headers, key='Cookie')
    token = replace_string(string=token, search_for='_oauth_proxy=', replace_with=EMPTY)
    if oauth_present == TRUE:
        cookies = replace_string(string=f'{headers}[Cookie]', search_for=token, replace_with='***hidden***')
        set_to_dictionary(dictionary=headers, Cookie=cookies)


def install_kserve_dependencies():
    set_suite_variable(FILES_RESOURCES_DIRPATH, 'tests/Resources/Files')
    set_suite_variable(SUBSCRIPTION_YAML_TEMPLATE_FILEPATH, f'{FILES_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/isv-operator-subscription.yaml')
    set_suite_variable(OPERATORGROUP_YAML_TEMPLATE_FILEPATH, f'{FILES_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/isv-operator-group.yaml')
    is_installed = check_if_operator_is_installed_via_cli(AUTHORINO_OP_NAME)
    if not is_installed:
        install_authorino_operator_via_cli()
    else:
        log_to_console(message='Authorino Operator is already installed')
    is_installed = check_if_operator_is_installed_via_cli(SERVICEMESH_OP_NAME)
    if not is_installed:
        install_service_mesh_operator_via_cli()
    else:
        log_to_console(message='ServiceMesh Operator is already installed')
    is_installed = check_if_operator_is_installed_via_cli(SERVERLESS_OP_NAME)
    if not is_installed:
        install_serverless_operator_via_cli()
    else:
        log_to_console(message='Serverless Operator is already installed')


def verify_model_kserve_deployment(label_selector, namespace, runtime, exp_replicas):
    test_mode_var_exist = run_keyword_and_return_status('Variable Should Exist', KSERVE_MODE)
    dsc_raw_var_exist = run_keyword_and_return_status('Variable Should Exist', IS_KSERVE_RAW)
    if test_mode_var_exist:
        if KSERVE_MODE == "RawDeployment":
            set_test_variable(is_raw, TRUE)
        else:
            set_test_variable(is_raw, FALSE)
    elif dsc_raw_var_exist:
        if IS_KSERVE_RAW:
            set_test_variable(is_raw, TRUE)
        else:
            set_test_variable(is_raw, FALSE)
    else:
        fail(msg=f'either {KSERVE_MODE} or {IS_KSERVE_RAW} suite/global variables are expected to be set')
    load_runtime_query_formats()
    model_pods = oc_get(kind='Pod', namespace=namespace, label_selector=label_selector)
    containers = set_variable(f'{RUNTIME_FORMATS}[{runtime}][containers]')
    if not is_raw:
        serverless_container = create_list('queue-proxy', 'istio-proxy')
        append_to_list(containers, serverless_container)
    n_containers = get_length(containers)
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Verify Deployment', model_pods, exp_replicas, n_containers, containers)


def remove_model_mount_path_from_runtime(namespace, runtime='vllm-runtime'):

    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0,msg=out)


def wait_until_generic_modal_appears(id='pf-modal-', partial_match=TRUE, timeout='10s'):
    is_modal = is_generic_modal_displayed()
    if is_modal == FALSE:
        if partial_match == TRUE:
            wait_until_page_contains_element(xpath=f'//*[contains(@id,"{id}")]', timeout=timeout)
        else:
            wait_until_page_contains_element(xpath=f'//*[@id="{id}")]', timeout=timeout)
    else:
        log('No Modals on the screen right now..',level='WARN')

def setup_kueue_resources(project_name, cluster_queue_name, resource_flavor_name, local_queue_name):
    log(f'sh {KUEUE_RESOURCES_SETUP_FILEPATH} {cluster_queue_name} {resource_flavor_name} {local_queue_name} {project_name} "2" "8"')
    result = run_process(f'sh {KUEUE_RESOURCES_SETUP_FILEPATH} {cluster_queue_name} {resource_flavor_name} {local_queue_name} {project_name} "2" "8"',shell='true', stderr='STDOUT')
    log(result.stdout)
    if result.rc != 0:
        fail('Failed to setup kueue resources')

def compile_deploy_and_query_llm_model(model_storage_uri, model_name, isvc_name=model_name, runtime='caikit-tgis-runtime', model_format='caikit', protocol='grpc', inference_type='all-tokens', canaryTrafficPercent=EMPTY, namespace=TEST_NS, sa_name=DEFAULT_BUCKET_SA_NAME, n_queries=1, query_idx=0, validate_response=TRUE, limits_dict='&{EMPTY}', port_forwarding=FALSE):
    compile_inference_service_yaml(isvc_name=isvc_name, sa_name=sa_name, serving_runtime=runtime, model_storage_uri=model_storage_uri, canaryTrafficPercent=canaryTrafficPercent, model_format=model_format, limits_dict=limits_dict)
    deploy_model_via_cli(isvc_filepath=INFERENCESERVICE_FILLED_FILEPATH, namespace=namespace)
    wait_for_model_kserve_deployment_to_be_ready(label_selector=f'serving.kserve.io/inferenceservice={isvc_name}', namespace=namespace, runtime=runtime)
    pod_name = get_pod_name(namespace=namespace, label_selector=f'serving.kserve.io/inferenceservice={isvc_name}')
    if IS_KSERVE_RAW:
        start_port_forwarding(namespace=namespace, pod_name=pod_name)
    query_model_multiple_times(isvc_name=isvc_name, model_name=model_name, n_times=n_queries, namespace=namespace, query_idx=query_idx, validate_response=validate_response, protocol=protocol, runtime=runtime, inference_type=inference_type, port_forwarding=port_forwarding)

def container_image_url_should_use_image_digest_instead_of_tags_based_on_project_name(project_list):
    for namespace in project_list:
        if namespace == OPERATOR_NAMESPACE:
            return_code, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc get pods --namespace {namespace} -l name=rhods-operator -o json | grep "\\"image\\"" | cut -d ":" -f2-3 | sort | uniq')
            should_be_equal_as_integers(return_code, 0)
        else:
            return_code, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc get pods --namespace {namespace} -o json | grep "\\"image\\"" | cut -d ":" -f2-3 | sort | uniq')
            should_be_equal_as_integers(return_code, 0)
        isEmpty = run_keyword_and_return_status('Should Be Empty', output)
        if isEmpty:
            continue
        images = split_string(output, ',\n')
        for image in images:
            status = run_keyword_and_return_status('Should Contain', image, '@sha256')
            if not status:
                run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Fail',msg=f'Container image {image} is not using image digest in namespace {namespace}')

    spawn_notebook_with_arguments(image=img)
    status = check_versions_in_jupyterlab(list)
    clean_up_server()
    stop_jupyterlab_notebook_server()
    go_to(ODH_DASHBOARD_URL)
    wait_for_rhods_dashboard_to_load()
    launch_jupyter_from_rhods_dashboard_link()
    fix_spawner_status()
    wait_until_jupyterhub_spawner_is_ready()
    return status

def grpc_model_setup():
    if GPRC_MODEL_DEPLOYED == FALSE:
        set_project_and_runtime(namespace=GRPC_MODEL_NS)
        compile_inference_service_yaml(isvc_name=ISVC_NAME, model_storage_uri=STORAGE_URI)
        deploy_model_via_cli(isvc_filepath=INFERENCESERVICE_FILLED_FILEPATH, namespace=GRPC_MODEL_NS)
        wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector=f'serving.kserve.io/inferenceservice={ISVC_NAME}', namespace=GRPC_MODEL_NS)
        query_model_multiple_times(model_name=ISVC_NAME, runtime='caikit-tgis-runtime', inference_type='all-tokens', n_times=1, protocol='grpc', namespace=GRPC_MODEL_NS, validate_response=FALSE)
        set_suite_variable(GPRC_MODEL_DEPLOYED, TRUE)
    else:
        log(message='Skipping model deployment, it was marked as deployed in a previous test')
    host = get_kserve_inference_host_via_cli(isvc_name=ISVC_NAME, namespace=GRPC_MODEL_NS)
    set_suite_variable(GRPC_HOST, host)

def end_to_end_pipeline_workflow_using_kfp(username, password, admin_username, admin_password, project, python_file, method_name, pipeline_params, status_check_timeout=160, ray=FALSE):
    projects.delete_project_via_cli_by_display_name(project)
    projects.create_data_science_project_from_cli(name=project)
    datasciencepipelinesbackend.create_pipelineserver_using_custom_dspa(project)
    status = login_and_wait_dsp_route(admin_username, admin_password, project)
    should_be_true(f'{status} == 200', 'Could not login to the Data Science Pipelines Rest API OR DSP routing is not working')
    if ray == TRUE:
        setup_kueue_resources(project, 'cluster-queue-user', 'resource-flavor-user', 'local-queue-user')
    launch_data_science_project_main_page(username=admin_username, password=admin_password)
    assign_contributor_permissions_to_user_${username}_in_project_${project}()
    pip_index_url = get_variable_value(PIP_INDEX_URL, NONE)
    pip_trusted_host = get_variable_value(PIP_TRUSTED_HOST, NONE)
    log(f'pip_index_url = {pip_index_url} / pip_trusted_host = {pip_trusted_host}')
    run_id = create_run_from_pipeline_func(username, password, project, python_file, method_name,pipeline_params=pipeline_params, pip_index_url=pip_index_url, pip_trusted_host=pip_trusted_host)
    run_status = check_run_status(run_id,timeout=status_check_timeout)
    should_be_equal_as_strings(run_status, 'SUCCEEDED', "Pipeline run doesn't have a status that means success. Check the logs")


def check_gpu_resources():
    gpu_re_id, gpu_re_link, gpu_re_exp = set_gpu_expected_resources()
    elements = get_webelements(RES_CARDS_XP)
    len = get_length(elements)
    should_be_equal_as_integers(len, gpu_re_exp)
    for counter in range(len):
        page_should_contain_element(f'xpath:{RES_CARDS_XP}\[@id={gpu_re_id}[{counter}]]')
        if gpu_re_link[counter] == '#':
            counter = get_webelements(f"{RES_CARDS_XP}//button[text()='Open']")
            no_of_open_link = get_length(counter)
            if no_of_open_link == 2:
                log("There are two tile with `Open' link")
            else:
                fail("Mismatch on the number of GPU tile present with 'Open' link.Please check the RHODS dashboard.")
        else:
            page_should_contain_element(f'//a[@href={gpu_re_link}[{counter}]]')

def select_provisioner_template(provider_type):
    if provider_type == "AWS":
        set_task_variable(template, 'tasks/Resources/Provisioning/Hive/AWS/aws-cluster.yaml')
    elif provider_type == "GCP":
        set_task_variable(template, 'tasks/Resources/Provisioning/Hive/GCP/gcp-cluster.yaml')
    elif provider_type == "OSP":
        set_task_variable(template, 'tasks/Resources/Provisioning/Hive/OSP/hive_osp_cluster_template.yaml')
    elif provider_type == "IBM":
        set_task_variable(template, 'tasks/Resources/Provisioning/Hive/IBM/ibmcloud-cluster.yaml')
    elif provider_type == "AZURE":
        set_task_variable(template, 'tasks/Resources/Provisioning/Hive/AZURE/azure-cluster.yaml')
    else:
        fail('Invalid provider name')
    log(f'Setting {provider_type} Hive Template {template}',console='True')
    return template


def image_should_be_pinned_to_a_numeric_version():
    image_spec = run_cell_and_get_output("import os; os.environ['JUPYTER_IMAGE']")
    image_tag = fetch_from_right(string=image_spec, marker=':')
    matches = get_regexp_matches(image_tag, '(main|latest|master|dev|prod)')
    if len(matches) == 0:
        log(msg=f'Image Tag "{image_tag}" does not contain "latest", "main" or "master"')
    else:
        fail(msg=f'Image Tag "{image_tag}" refers to generic versions like "latest", "main" or "master"')
    matches = get_regexp_matches(image_tag, '[0-9]+')
    if len(matches) == 0:
        fail(msg=f'Image Tag "{image_tag}" is not pinned to a specific version')
    else:
        matches = get_regexp_matches(image_tag, '([0-9]\.[0-9])(.[0-9]|-[0-9]|)')
        log(f'Image Tag "{image_tag}" is (probably) pinned to a specific version')
        if len(matches) == 0:
            log(level='WARN', message=f'Image Tag "{image_tag}" is not in the format x.y.z-n or x.y-n or x.y')

def create_provider_resources():
    log(f'Creating Hive resources for cluster {cluster_name} on {provider_type} according to: {template}',console='True')
    if provider_type in ["AWS", "GCP", "AZURE"]:
        oc_apply(kind='List', src=template, api_version='v1', template_data=infrastructure_configurations)
    elif provider_type == "OSP":
        create_openstack_resources()
    elif provider_type == "IBM":
        create_ibm_credentialsrequests_and_service_ids()
        create_ibm_manifests_secret()
        hive_yaml = set_variable(f'{artifacts_dir}/{cluster_name}_hive.yaml')
        create_file_from_template(template, hive_yaml)
        oc_apply(kind='List', src=hive_yaml, api_version='v1')
    else:
        fail('Invalid provider name')

def verify_rhods_aggregated_availability_detects_downtime_in_component(component):
    label_selector = set_variable_if(f'"{component}" == "combined"', 'app in (jupyterhub, rhods-dashboard)',app=component)
    component_delete_result = oc_delete(kind='Pod', api_version='v1', label_selector=label_selector, namespace=APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE)
    count = get_length(component_delete_result[0]['items'])
    log(count)
    component_downtime_start_date = wait_until_keyword_succeeds('1m', '1s', 'Get Date When Availability Value Matches Expected Value', 0)
    component_downtime_end_date = wait_until_keyword_succeeds('10m', '1s', 'Get Date When Availability Value Matches Expected Value', 1)
    run_keyword_and_expect_error('There is a Downtime of *', 'Verify ODS Availability Range', component_downtime_start_date, component_downtime_end_date, '1s', component)


def perform_dashboard_api_endpoint_get_call(endpoint, token):
    headers = create_dictionary(Cookie=f'_oauth_proxy={token}')
    args = create_dictionary(url=f'{ODH_DASHBOARD_URL}/{endpoint}', expected_status='any', headers=headers, timeout=5, verify=False)
    response = run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Perform Request', 'GET', '&{args}')
    if response == NONE:
        log(msg='HTTP response is empty. The request may have failed to be performed', level='ERROR')
    return response

def install_service_mesh_stack():
    install_isv_operator_from_operatorhub_via_cli(operator_name=SERVICEMESH_OP_NAME, subscription_name=SERVICEMESH_SUB_NAME, catalog_source_name='redhat-operators')
    install_isv_operator_from_operatorhub_via_cli(operator_name=KIALI_OP_NAME, subscription_name=KIALI_SUB_NAME, catalog_source_name='redhat-operators')
    install_isv_operator_from_operatorhub_via_cli(operator_name=JAEGER_OP_NAME, subscription_name=JAEGER_SUB_NAME, catalog_source_name='redhat-operators')
    wait_until_operator_subscription_last_condition_is(type='CatalogSourcesUnhealthy', status='False', reason='AllCatalogSourcesHealthy', subcription_name=SERVICEMESH_SUB_NAME)
    wait_until_operator_subscription_last_condition_is(type='CatalogSourcesUnhealthy', status='False', reason='AllCatalogSourcesHealthy', subcription_name=KIALI_SUB_NAME)
    wait_until_operator_subscription_last_condition_is(type='CatalogSourcesUnhealthy', status='False', reason='AllCatalogSourcesHealthy', subcription_name=JAEGER_SUB_NAME)
    wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector='name=istio-operator', namespace=DEFAULT_OP_NS)
    wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector='name=jaeger-operator', namespace=DEFAULT_OP_NS)
    wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector='name=kiali-operator', namespace=DEFAULT_OP_NS)


def wait_for_pods_to_succeed(label_selector, namespace, timeout='300s', exp_replicas=NONE):
    wait_until_keyword_succeeds(timeout, '3s', 'Check If Pod Exists',namespace=namespace, label_selector=label_selector, status_only=FALSE)
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"oc wait --for=jsonpath='{.status.phase}'=Succeeded pod -l {label_selector} -n {namespace} --timeout={timeout}")
    if rc != 0:
        events, podlogs = get_events_and_pod_logs(namespace, label_selector)
        fail(msg='Pod did not succeed by timeout')
    if exp_replicas != NONE:
        replicas = oc_get(kind='Pod', namespace=namespace, label_selector=label_selector)
        length_should_be(replicas, exp_replicas)


def replace_prometheus_with_grafana_in_rhods_monitor_federation():
    openshiftlibrary.oc_patch(kind='ServiceMonitor', src='{"spec":{"selector":{"matchLabels": {"app":"grafana"}}}}', name='rhods-monitor-federation', namespace=MONITORING_NAMESPACE, type='merge')


def stop_workbench_from_projects_home_page(workbench_title, project_title, namespace=EMPTY, workbench_cr_name=EMPTY, press_cancel=FALSE):
    is_started = run_keyword_and_return_status('Workbench Status Should Be From Projects Home Page',workbench_title=workbench_title, status=WORKBENCH_STATUS_RUNNING, project_title=project_title)
    is_starting = run_keyword_and_return_status('Workbench Status Should Be From Projects Home Page',workbench_title=workbench_title, status=WORKBENCH_STATUS_STARTING, project_title=project_title)
    if is_started == TRUE or is_starting == TRUE:
        if workbench_cr_name == EMPTY:
            if namespace == EMPTY:
                namespace = get_openshift_namespace_from_data_science_project(project_title=project_title)
            _, workbench_cr_name = get_openshift_notebook_cr_from_workbench(workbench_title=workbench_title, namespace=namespace)
        kebab_button = set_variable(xpath=f'//a[@data-testid="notebook-route-link" and text()="{workbench_title}"]/ancestor::tr[@data-testid="project-notebooks-table-row"]//button[@aria-label="Kebab toggle"]')
        wait_until_element_is_visible(kebab_button,timeout='10s')
        click_element(kebab_button)
        stop_button = set_variable(xpath=f'//a[@data-testid="notebook-route-link" and text()="{workbench_title}"]/ancestor::tr[@data-testid="project-notebooks-table-row"]//button[@data-testid="notebook-stop-action"]')
        wait_until_element_is_visible(stop_button,timeout='10s')
        click_element(stop_button)
        handle_stop_workbench_confirmation_modal(workbench_title=workbench_title, press_cancel=press_cancel)
    else:
        fail(msg=f'Cannot stop {workbench_title} workbench because it is neither starting nor running.')
    wait_until_workbench_is_stopped_from_projects_home_page(workbench_title=workbench_title, project_title=project_title)


def verify_run_status(namespace, username, password, pipeline_run_id, pipeline_run_expected_status='"SUCCEEDED"'):
    pipeline_run_status = datasciencepipelinesbackend.get_run_status(namespace, username, password, pipeline_run_id)
    if pipeline_run_status != pipeline_run_expected_status:
        error_msg = catenate(f'Expected pipeline status was {pipeline_run_expected_status} but pipeline run', f'has status={pipeline_run_status}')
        fail(error_msg)

def create_pipeline_run(name, pipeline_name=NONE, run_type='Immediate', start_date=NONE, start_time=NONE, end_date=NONE, end_time=NONE, cron_expr=NONE, press_cancel=FALSE, model_param):
    projects.move_to_tab('Pipelines')
    pipelines.click_action_from_pipeline_actions_menu(pipeline_name=pipeline_name, action='Create run')
    fill_in_run_creation_form('&{model_param}',name=name, pipeline_name=pipeline_name, run_type=run_type, trigger_type='Periodic', start_date=start_date, start_time=start_time, end_date=end_date, end_time=end_time, cron_expr=cron_expr)
    if press_cancel:
        click_button(GENERIC_CANCEL_BTN_XP)
        wait_for_rhods_dashboard_to_load(expected_page='Pipelines', wait_for_cards=FALSE)
        workflow_name = set_variable(NONE)
    else:
        click_element(CREATE_RUN_BTN_XP)
        wait_until_page_contains_run_topology_page(run_name=name)
        workflow_name = get_workflow_name_from_topology_page()
    return workflow_name

def verify_pod_logs_contain_error():
    pod_name = get_pod_name(OPERATOR_NAMESPACE, OPERATOR_LABEL_SELECTOR)
    length = set_variable(0)
    try:
        while length == 0:
            pod_logs = oc_get_pod_logs(name=pod_name, namespace=OPERATOR_NAMESPACE, container=OPERATOR_POD_CONTAINER_NAME)
            match_list = get_regexp_matches(pod_logs, MSG_REGEX)
            entry_msg = remove_duplicates(match_list)
            length = get_length(entry_msg)
            sleep('10s')
    except ():
        fail(msg=f"Pod {pod_name} logs should contain message '{MSG_REGEX}'")

def clone_git_repository(REPO_URL):
    status, err_msg = run_keyword_and_ignore_error('Clone Repo and Return Error Message', REPO_URL)
    if status == "PASS":
        dir_name = get_directory_name_from_git_repo_url(REPO_URL)
        current_user = get_current_user_in_jupyterlab()
        delete_folder_in_user_notebook(admin_username=OCP_ADMIN_USER.USERNAME, username=current_user, folder=dir_name)
        status, err_msg = run_keyword_and_ignore_error('Clone Repo and Return Error Message', REPO_URL)
        if status == "PASS":
            log(f'Error Message : {err_msg}')
            fail()

def wait_notebook_to_be_loaded(image, version):
    ide = notebook_expected_ide(image)
    if ide=="VSCode":
        wait_until_page_contains_element('xpath://div[@class="menubar-menu-button"]',timeout='60s')
        wait_until_page_contains('Get Started with VS Code for the Web')
    elif ide=="JupyterLab":
        wait_until_page_contains_element('xpath://div[@id="jp-top-panel"]',timeout='60s')
        sleep('2s',reason='Wait for a possible popup')
        maybe_close_popup()
        open_new_notebook_in_jupyterlab_menu()
        spawned_image_check(image, version)
    else:
        fail(msg=f"Unknown IDE type has been resolved: '{ide}'. Please check and fix or implement.")

    self_managed = is_rhods_self_managed()

        upload_certificate_to_jupyter_notebook('openshift_ca.crt')
    jupyter_notebook_can_query_model_registry(JUPYTER_NOTEBOOK)
    seleniumlibrary.switch_window(handle)

    seleniumlibrary.close_all_browsers()

def serving_runtime_template_should_be_listed(displayed_name, serving_platform):
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Wait Until Page Contains Element', f'//*[@data-testid="serving-runtime {displayed_name}"]',timeout='10s')
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Wait Until Page Contains Element', f'//*[@data-testid="serving-runtime {displayed_name}"]//ancestor::*[@data-testid="serving-runtime-platform-label"]')
    actual_platform_labels_str = get_text(f'//*[@data-testid="serving-runtime {displayed_name}"]//ancestor::*[@data-testid="serving-runtime-platform-label"]')
    actual_platform_labels = split_to_lines(actual_platform_labels_str)
    if serving_platform == "both":
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Length Should Be', actual_platform_labels, 2)
        exp_platform_labels = create_list(f'{PLATFORM_LABELS_MAPPING}[single]', f'{PLATFORM_LABELS_MAPPING}[multi]')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Lists Should Be Equal', actual_platform_labels, exp_platform_labels)
    else:
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Should Be Equal', actual_platform_labels_str, f'{PLATFORM_LABELS_MAPPING}[{serving_platform}]')

def check_whether_dsc_exists_and_save_component_statuses():
    rc = run_and_return_rc(f'oc get datasciencecluster {DSC_NAME}')
    if rc == 0:
        set_global_variable(DSC_EXISTS, 'True')
        custom_cmp = create_dictionary()
        rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"oc get datasciencecluster {DSC_NAME} -o jsonpath='{.spec.components}'")
        custom_cmp = load_json_string(out)
        set_test_variable(custom_cmp, custom_cmp)
    else:
        set_global_variable(DSC_EXISTS, 'False')

def get_links_from_switcher():
    list_of_links = create_list()
    link_elements = get_webelements('//*[@data-testid="application-launcher-group"]//a[not(starts-with(@href, \'#\'))]')
    for ext_link in link_elements:
        href = get_element_attribute(ext_link, 'href')
        append_to_list(list_of_links, href)
    return list_of_links

def commit_changes(commit_message, name, email_id):
    click_element(xpath='//li[@title="Git"]')
    input_text(commit_message,xpath='//*[@id="jp-git-sessions"]//input[contains(@placeholder, "Summary")]')
    sleep('2s')
    attr = get_element_attribute('title',xpath='//div[contains(@class, "CommitBox")]//button[.="Commit"]')
    if '''attr''' == 'Disabled: No files are staged for commit':
        set_simple_staging_status(status='OFF')
        set_simple_staging_status(status='ON')
    click_button(xpath='//div[contains(@class, "CommitBox")]//button[.="Commit"]')
    identity = run_keyword_and_return_status('Wait Until Page Contains', 'Who is committing?',timeout='10s')
    if identity:
        input_text(name,xpath='//input[@placeholder="Name"]')
        input_text(email_id,xpath='//input[@placeholder="Email"]')
        click_ok_button_jupyterlab_version_agnostic()
    else:
        page_should_contain_element(xpath='//button[@title="Disabled: No files are staged for commit"]')


def verify_rhods_installation():
    set_global_variable(DASHBOARD_APP_NAME, f'{PRODUCT.lower()}-dashboard')
    log('Verifying RHODS installation',console='yes')
    log_to_console('Waiting for all RHODS resources to be up and running')
    wait_for_deployment_replica_to_be_ready(namespace=OPERATOR_NAMESPACE, label_selector=f'name={OPERATOR_NAME_LABEL}', timeout='2000s')
    wait_for_pods_status(namespace=OPERATOR_NAMESPACE, timeout=1200)
    log(f'Verified {OPERATOR_NAMESPACE}',console='yes')
    if UPDATE_CHANNEL == "odh-nightlies" or cluster_type != "managed":
        if PRODUCT == "ODH":
            apply_dscinitialization_customresource(dsci_name=DSCI_NAME)
            if TEST_ENV.lower() == "crc":
                timeout_in_seconds = set_variable(180)
            else:
                timeout_in_seconds = set_variable(60)
            wait_for_dscinitialization_customresource_to_be_ready(timeout=timeout_in_seconds)
        apply_datasciencecluster_customresource(dsc_name=DSC_NAME)
    dashboard = is_component_enabled('dashboard', DSC_NAME)
    if dashboard == "true":
        wait_for_deployment_replica_to_be_ready(namespace=APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE, label_selector=f'app={DASHBOARD_APP_NAME}', timeout='1200s')
        if PRODUCT == "ODH":
            add_ui_admin_group_to_dashboard_admin()
    workbenches = is_component_enabled('workbenches', DSC_NAME)
    if workbenches == "true":
        wait_for_deployment_replica_to_be_ready(namespace=APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE, label_selector='app=notebook-controller', timeout='400s')
        wait_for_deployment_replica_to_be_ready(namespace=APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE, label_selector='app=odh-notebook-controller', timeout='400s')
        oc_get(kind='Namespace', field_selector=f'metadata.name={NOTEBOOKS_NAMESPACE}')
        log(f'Verified Notebooks NS: {NOTEBOOKS_NAMESPACE}')
    modelmeshserving = is_component_enabled('modelmeshserving', DSC_NAME)
    if modelmeshserving == "true":
        wait_for_deployment_replica_to_be_ready(namespace=APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE, label_selector='app=odh-model-controller', timeout='400s')
        wait_for_deployment_replica_to_be_ready(namespace=APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE, label_selector='component=model-mesh-etcd', timeout='400s')
        wait_for_deployment_replica_to_be_ready(namespace=APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE, label_selector='app.kubernetes.io/name=modelmesh-controller', timeout='400s')
    datasciencepipelines = is_component_enabled('datasciencepipelines', DSC_NAME)
    if datasciencepipelines == "true":
        wait_for_deployment_replica_to_be_ready(namespace=APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE, label_selector='app.kubernetes.io/name=data-science-pipelines-operator', timeout='400s')
    kserve = is_component_enabled('kserve', DSC_NAME)
    if kserve == "true":
        wait_for_deployment_replica_to_be_ready(namespace=APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE, label_selector='app=odh-model-controller', timeout='400s')
        wait_for_deployment_replica_to_be_ready(namespace=APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE, label_selector='control-plane=kserve-controller-manager', timeout='400s')
    kueue = is_component_enabled('kueue', DSC_NAME)
    if kueue == "true":
        wait_for_deployment_replica_to_be_ready(namespace=APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE, label_selector='app.kubernetes.io/part-of=kueue', timeout='400s')
    codeflare = is_component_enabled('codeflare', DSC_NAME)
    if codeflare == "true":
        wait_for_deployment_replica_to_be_ready(namespace=APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE, label_selector='app.kubernetes.io/part-of=codeflare', timeout='400s')
    ray = is_component_enabled('ray', DSC_NAME)
    if ray == "true":
        wait_for_deployment_replica_to_be_ready(namespace=APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE, label_selector='app.kubernetes.io/part-of=ray', timeout='400s')
    trustyai = is_component_enabled('trustyai', DSC_NAME)
    if trustyai == "true":
        wait_for_deployment_replica_to_be_ready(namespace=APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE, label_selector='app.kubernetes.io/part-of=trustyai', timeout='400s')
    modelregistry = is_component_enabled('modelregistry', DSC_NAME)
    if modelregistry == "true":
        wait_for_deployment_replica_to_be_ready(namespace=APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE, label_selector='app.kubernetes.io/part-of=model-registry-operator', timeout='400s')
    trainingoperator = is_component_enabled('trainingoperator', DSC_NAME)
    if trainingoperator == "true":
        wait_for_deployment_replica_to_be_ready(namespace=APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE, label_selector='app.kubernetes.io/part-of=trainingoperator', timeout='400s')
    if dashboard == "true" or workbenches == "true" or modelmeshserving == "true" or datasciencepipelines == "true" or kserve == "true" or kueue == "true" or codeflare == "true" or ray == "true" or trustyai == "true" or modelregistry == "true" or trainingoperator == "true":
        log_to_console(f'Waiting for pod status in {APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE}')
        wait_for_pods_status(namespace=APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE, timeout=200)
        log(f'Verified Applications NS: {APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE}',console='yes')
    if cluster_type == "managed":
        log_to_console(f'Waiting for pod status in {MONITORING_NAMESPACE}')
        wait_for_pods_status(namespace=MONITORING_NAMESPACE, timeout=600)
        log(f'Verified Monitoring NS: {MONITORING_NAMESPACE}',console='yes')

    str = replace_string_using_regexp(string=str, pattern='[^a-zA-Z]', replace_with='-')

    return str
