def get_containers_with_non_zero_restart_counts(pod_names, namespace):
    pod_restarts = create_dictionary()
    for pod_name in pod_names:
        container_restarts = create_dictionary()
        data = oc_get(kind='Pod', namespace=namespace, field_selector=f'metadata.name=={pod_name}')
        for index, container in enumerate(data[0]['status']['containerStatuses']):
            value = convert_to_integer(container['restartCount'])
            if value > 0:
                set_to_dictionary(container_restarts, container['name'], value)
        set_to_dictionary(pod_restarts, pod_name, container_restarts)
    return pod_restarts


def create_workbench(workbench_title, workbench_description, prj_title, image_name, deployment_size, storage, pv_existent, pv_name, pv_description, pv_size, gpus=NONE, press_cancel=FALSE, version='default', envs=NONE, data_connection=NONE):
    open_data_science_project_details_page(project_title=prj_title, tab_id='workbenches')
    wait_until_element_is_enabled(WORKBENCH_CREATE_BTN_XP)
    click_element(WORKBENCH_CREATE_BTN_XP)
    wait_until_page_contains_element(WORKBENCH_NAME_INPUT_XP)
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Element Should Be Disabled', WORKBENCH_CREATE_BTN_2_XP)
    input_text(WORKBENCH_NAME_INPUT_XP, workbench_title)
    input_text(WORKBENCH_DESCR_TXT_XP, workbench_description)
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Element Should Be Disabled', WORKBENCH_CREATE_BTN_2_XP)
    select_workbench_image(image_name=image_name, version=version)
    if deployment_size != NONE:
        select_workbench_container_size(size_name=deployment_size)
    if gpus != NONE:
        select_workbench_number_of_gpus(gpus=gpus)
    if envs != NONE:
        envs_copy = copy_list(envs,deepcopy=TRUE)
        add_environment_variables_in_workbench(env_variables=envs_copy)
    if data_connection != NONE:
        add_existing_data_connection_in_workbench(data_connection=data_connection)
    version_check = is_rhods_version_greater_or_equal_than('1.20.0')
    if version_check==True:
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Page Should Not Contain Element',xpath='//input[contains(@name,"ephemeral")]')
    if storage == "Persistent":
        if pv_existent == TRUE:
            click_element('//a[@href="#cluster-storage"]')
            click_element('//*[@data-testid="existing-storage-button"]')
            select_an_existent_pv(pv_name, PV_MOUNT_PATH)
        elif pv_existent == FALSE:
            click_element('//a[@href="#cluster-storage"]')
            click_element(xpath='//input[@name="persistent-new-storage-type-radio"]')
            fill_in_new_pv_data(name=pv_name, description=pv_description, size=pv_size)
            log(msg=f"Delete PVC '{pv_name}' before creating new one via the Workbench dialog")
            delete_pvc_in_project_from_cli(pvc_title=pv_name, project_title=prj_title)
        else:
            log(msg='"pv_existent" argument not set, using default PV settings', level='WARN')
            delete_pvc_in_project_from_cli(pvc_title=workbench_title, project_title=prj_title)
    else:
        click_element(xpath='//input[@name="ephemeral-storage-type-radio"]')
    if press_cancel == TRUE:
        click_button(GENERIC_CANCEL_BTN_XP)
    else:
        wait_until_element_is_enabled(WORKBENCH_CREATE_BTN_2_XP)
        click_button(WORKBENCH_CREATE_BTN_2_XP)
    wait_until_element_is_not_visible('//form', '10s')
    open_data_science_project_details_page(project_title=prj_title, tab_id='workbenches')

def get_pagerduty_key_from_secrets():
    new = oc_get(kind='Secret', namespace=namespace, field_selector=f'metadata.name=={SECRET_NAME}')
    body = set_variable(new[0]['data']['PAGERDUTY_KEY'])
    string = evaluate(f"base64.b64decode('{body}').decode('ascii')",modules='base64')
    return string

def wait_for_namespace_to_be_active(namespace, timeout='30s'):
    while True:
        rc = run_and_return_rc(f'oc get namespace/{namespace}')
        if rc == "0":
            break
    rc, value = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"oc wait --for jsonpath='{.status.phase}=Active' --timeout={timeout} namespace/{namespace}")
    log(rc)
    log(value)
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)

                doc_link = set_variable(f'{doc_link[:{-1}]}')

def create_pachyderm_pipeline_using_jupyterlab(pachctl_version):
    run_cell_and_check_for_errors(f'!curl -o /tmp/pachctl.tar.gz -L https://github.com/pachyderm/pachyderm/releases/download/v{pachctl_version}/pachctl_{pachctl_version}_linux_amd64.tar.gz && tar -xvf /tmp/pachctl.tar.gz -C /tmp && cp /tmp/pachctl_{pachctl_version}_linux_amd64/pachctl /opt/app-root/bin/')
    run_cell_and_check_for_errors('!echo \'{"pachd_address":"pachd.pachyderm.svc.cluster.local:30650"}\' | pachctl config set context pachyderm --overwrite')
    run_cell_and_check_for_errors('!pachctl config set active-context pachyderm')
    run_cell_and_check_for_errors('!pachctl config get active-context')
    run_cell_and_check_for_errors('!pachctl version')
    run_cell_and_check_for_errors('!pachctl create repo images')
    run_cell_and_check_for_errors('!pachctl list repo')
    run_cell_and_check_for_errors('!pachctl put file images@master:liberty.png -f http://imgur.com/46Q8nDz.png')
    run_cell_and_check_for_errors('!pachctl list repo')
    run_cell_and_check_for_errors('!pachctl list commit images')
    command_string = create_command_in_multiple_lines()
    run_cell_and_check_for_errors(command_string)
    run_cell_and_check_for_errors('!pachctl create pipeline -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pachyderm/pachyderm/master/examples/opencv/edges.json')
    run_cell_and_check_for_errors('!pachctl list job')


def get_rhods_version(force_fetch='False'):
    if RHODS_VERSION == None or force_fetch=="True":
        if PRODUCT == None or PRODUCT == "RHODS":
            RHODS_VERSION = run(f'oc get csv -n {OPERATOR_NAMESPACE} | grep "rhods-operator" | awk -F \' {2,}\' \'{print $3}\'')
        else:
            RHODS_VERSION = run(f'oc get csv -n {OPERATOR_NAMESPACE} | grep "opendatahub" | awk -F \' {2,}\' \'{print $3}\'')
    log(f'Product:{PRODUCT} Version:{RHODS_VERSION}')
    return RHODS_VERSION

def handle_already_existing_cluster():
    if use_cluster_pool:
        log(f"Cluster name '{cluster_name}' already exists in Hive pool '{pool_name}' - Checking if it has a valid web-console",console='True')
        pool_namespace = get_cluster_pool_namespace(pool_name)
        result = run_process(f"oc -n {pool_namespace} get cd {pool_namespace} -o json | jq -r '.status.webConsoleURL' --exit-status",shell='yes')
    else:
        log(f"Cluster name '{cluster_name}' already exists as Hive ClusterDeployment - Checking if it has a valid web-console",console='True')
        result = run_process(f"oc -n {hive_namespace} get cd {cluster_name} -o json | jq -r '.status.webConsoleURL' --exit-status",shell='yes')
    if result.rc != 0:
        fail(f"Cluster '{cluster_name}' has previously failed to be provisioned but some Hive and/or Cloud resources are still present.")
    else:
        fail(f"Cluster '{cluster_name}' is already in use, please choose a different name.")

def check_resource_consuming_usage(usage_expected, usage_hover, resource_name):
    usage_lower_bound = evaluate(f'{usage_expected} - {tolerance}')
    usage_higher_bound = evaluate(f'{usage_expected} + {tolerance}')
    run_keyword_if(f'{usage_hover} == {usage_expected}', 'Log', f'{resource_name} Usage value is accurate', 'ELSE IF', f'{usage_hover} > {usage_lower_bound} and {usage_hover} < {usage_higher_bound}', 'Log', f'{resource_name} usage value is partially matches', 'ELSE', 'Fail', f'{resource_name} usage hover value {usage_hover} is not matching with expected value {usage_expected}')


def wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector, namespace, timeout='600s', exp_replicas=NONE):
    wait_until_keyword_succeeds(timeout, '3s', 'Check If Pod Exists',namespace=namespace, label_selector=label_selector, status_only=FALSE)
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc wait --for=condition=ready=true pod -l {label_selector} -n {namespace} --timeout={timeout}')
    if rc != 0:
        events, podlogs = get_events_and_pod_logs(namespace, label_selector)
        fail(msg=f'Pod defined by selector "{label_selector}" in "{namespace}" namespace is not ready by timeout.')
    if exp_replicas != NONE:
        replicas = oc_get(kind='Pod', namespace=namespace, label_selector=label_selector)
        length_should_be(replicas, exp_replicas)

def run_query_and_check_output(query_code, expected_output, use_regex=FALSE, cli=FALSE, host=NONE):
    if cli == FALSE:
        output = run_cell_and_get_output(query_code)
        output = replace_string(output, '\n', EMPTY)
    else:
        rc, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'echo "{query_code}" | trino --server http://{host}')
        output = replace_string_using_regexp(output, '.+\nWARNING:.+\n', EMPTY)
        output = replace_string(output, '"', "'")
        output = replace_string(output, '\n', SPACE)
        output = set_variable(f'[{output}]')
    if use_regex == FALSE:
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Should Be Equal As Strings', output, expected_output)
    else:
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Should Match Regexp', output, expected_output)

        page_should_not_contain_element(f"//a[@data-testid='metrics-link-test-model' and text()='{model_name}']{MS_TABLE_STATUS_SUCCESS}")

def wait_until_csv_is_ready(display_name, timeout='10m', operators_namespace='openshift-operators'):
    log(f"Waiting {timeout} for Operator CSV '{display_name}' in {operators_namespace} to have status phase 'Succeeded'",console='yes')
    while True:
        csv_created = run_process(f"oc get csv --no-headers -n {operators_namespace} | awk '/{display_name}/ {print \$1}'",shell='yes')
        if csv_created.stdout == EMPTY:
            continue
        csv_ready = run_process(f"oc wait --timeout\={timeout} --for jsonpath\='{.status.phase}'\=Succeeded csv -n {operators_namespace} {csv_created.stdout}",shell='yes')
        if csv_ready.rc == 0:
            break


def verify_displayed_gpu_count(server_name, no_gpus):

def delete_imagestream_using_name(namespace, name):
    image_exists = check_if_imagestream_exists(namespace, name)
    if 'image_exists'=='PASS':
        deleted_images = oc_delete(kind='ImageStream', namespace=namespace, label_selector='opendatahub.io/modified=false', field_selector=f'metadata.name=={name}')
        if len(deleted_images) == 0:
            fail(f'Error deleting ImageStreams: {deleted_images}')
        else:
            image_exists = check_if_imagestream_exists(namespace, name)
            if 'image_exists'=='PASS':
                fail(f"ImageStreams '{name}' in namespace '{namespace}' still exist")
    else:
        log(level='WARN', message=f"No ImageStream present with Name '{name}' in '{namespace}' namespace")

def get_thanos_metrics_list(thanos_url, thanos_token, search_text=EMPTY):
    cmd = set_variable(f'curl -k -H "Authorization: Bearer {thanos_token}" https://{thanos_url}/api/v1/label/__name__/values')
    if search_text == EMPTY:
        cmd = catenate(cmd, "| jq '.data'")
    else:
        cmd = catenate(f"{cmd} | jq '.data[]' | grep {search_text}")
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'{cmd} | tr -d \'"\'')
    return out

def verify_quick_starts_work_as_expected_when_restarted_and_left_in_between(quickStartElements):
    for element in quickStartElements:
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('QuickStart Status Should Be', element, 'Complete')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Link Text On QuickStart Card Should Be',element=element, exp_link_text='Restart')
        open_quickstart_element_in_resource_section_by_name(element)
        page_should_not_contain(f'//article[@id="{element}"]//span[@class="pf-v5-c-label pf-m-green pf-m-outline"]')
        count = get_the_count_of_quickstart_steps()
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Click Button', '//button[@data-testid="qs-drawer-start"]')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Wait Until Page Contains Element', '//div[@class="pfext-quick-start-content"]')
        half_count = set_variable(count // 2)
        for index in range(half_count):
            run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Wait Until Keyword Succeeds', '2 times', '0.3s', 'Mark Step Check As Yes')
            run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Go To Next QuickStart Step')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Close QuickStart From Top',decision='leave')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Page Should Not Contain QuickStart Sidebar')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('QuickStart Status Should Be', element, 'In Progress')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Link Text On QuickStart Card Should Be',element=element, exp_link_text='Continue')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Click Element', f'//*[@id="{element}"]//button[@data-testid="quick-start-button"]')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Wait Until Page Contains Element', '//div[@class="pf-v5-c-drawer__panel-main"]', 5)
        for index in range(half_count):
            run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Page Should Contain Element', f'//div[@class="pfext-quick-start-tasks__list"]//li[{index+1}]//{SUCCESS_STEP}')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Click Button', '//button[@data-testid="qs-drawer-side-note-action"]')
        for index in range(count):
            run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Page Should Contain Element', f'//ul[@class="pf-v5-c-list pfext-quick-start-task-header__list"]/li[{index}+1]')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Click Button', '//button[@data-testid="qs-drawer-start"]')
        for index in range(count):
            run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Wait Until Keyword Succeeds', '2 times', '0.3s', 'Mark Step Check As Yes')
            run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Go To Next QuickStart Step')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Go Back And Check Previouse Step Is Selected',n_steps=count, exp_step=count-1)
        go_to_next_quickstart_step()
        go_to_next_quickstart_step()
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Close QuickStart From Button')


def verify_installed_labextension_version(lib, ver):
    status, value = run_keyword_and_warn_on_failure('Run Cell And Check Output', f'!jupyter labextension list 2>&1 | grep {lib} | awk \'{split($0,a); print a[2]}\' | awk \'{split($0,b,"v"); printf "%s", b[2]}\' | awk \'{split($0,c,"."); printf "%s.%s", c[1],c[2]}\'', ver)
    if 'status' == 'FAIL':
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('FAIL', f'"Expected {lib} at version {ver}, but {value}"')
    return status, value


def apply_custom_manifest_in_datasciencecluster_customresource_using_test_variables():
    log_to_console('Applying Custom Manifests')
    file_path = set_variable('tasks/Resources/Files/')
    for cmp in COMPONENT_LIST:
        if cmp in CUSTOM_MANIFESTS:
            manifest_string = convert_to_string(f'{CUSTOM_MANIFESTS}[{cmp}]')
            run(f'sed -i\'\' -e "s|<{cmp}_devflags>|{manifest_string}|g" {file_path}dsc_apply.yml')
        else:
            run(f'sed -i\'\' -e "s|<{cmp}_devflags>||g" {file_path}dsc_apply.yml')


def fetch_openshift_ca_bundle():
    rc = run_and_return_rc('oc get secret -n openshift-ingress router-certs-default -o json | jq \'.data."tls.crt"\' | sed \'s/"//g\' | base64 -d > openshift_ca.crt')
    should_be_equal_as_strings(rc, 0)


def read_current_cpu_usage():
    expression = set_variable(f'sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container="",pod=~"jupyter-nb.*",namespace="{NOTEBOOKS_NAMESPACE}"}[1h]))')
    resp = prometheus.run_query(RHODS_PROMETHEUS_URL, RHODS_PROMETHEUS_TOKEN, expression)
    if resp.json()["data"]["result"] == []:
        cpu_usage = set_variable(0)
    else:
        cpu_usage = set_variable(resp.json()["data"]["result"][0]["value"][-1])
    return cpu_usage


def wait_until_project_is_deleted(project, timeout):
    for counter in range(timeout):
        project_exists = run_keyword_and_return_status('Oc Get',kind='Namespace', field_selector=f'metadata.name={project}')
        exit_for_loop_if(f'not {project_exists}')
    if project_exists:
        fail(f'Project {project} has not been deleted after {timeout} attempts!')


def apply_datasciencecluster_customresource(dsc_name=DSC_NAME, custom='False', custom_cmp=''):
    file_path = set_variable('tasks/Resources/Files/')
    if custom == True:
        log_to_console(message='Creating DataScience Cluster using custom configuration')
        generate_custommanifest_in_dsc_yaml()
        rename_devflags_in_datasciencecluster_customresource()
        yml = get_file(f'{file_path}dsc_apply.yml')
        log_to_console('Applying DSC yaml')
        log_to_console(yml)
        return_code, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc apply -f {file_path}dsc_apply.yml')
        log_to_console(output)
        should_be_equal_as_integers(return_code, 0,msg='Error detected while applying DSC CR')
        wait_for_dsc_conditions_reconciled(OPERATOR_NS, DSC_NAME)
    else:
        log_to_console('Requested Configuration:')
        for cmp in COMPONENT_LIST:
            try:
                log_to_console(f'{cmp} - {COMPONENTS.{cmp}}')
            except ():
                log_to_console(f'{cmp} - Removed')
        log_to_console(message='Creating DataScience Cluster using yml template')
        create_datasciencecluster_customresource_using_test_variables()
        apply_custom_manifest_in_datasciencecluster_customresource_using_test_variables()
        yml = get_file(f'{file_path}dsc_apply.yml')
        log_to_console('Applying DSC yaml')
        log_to_console(yml)
        return_code, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc apply -f {file_path}dsc_apply.yml')
        log_to_console(output)
        should_be_equal_as_integers(return_code, 0,msg='Error detected while applying DSC CR')
        remove_file(f'{file_path}dsc_apply.yml')
        for cmp in COMPONENT_LIST:
            if cmp not in COMPONENTS:
                component_should_not_be_enabled(cmp)
            elif 'COMPONENTS.${cmp}' == 'Managed':
                component_should_be_enabled(cmp)
            elif 'COMPONENTS.${cmp}' == 'Removed':
                component_should_not_be_enabled(cmp)

def css_property_value_should_be(locator, property, exp_value, operation='equal'):
    el_text = get_text(f'xpath:{locator}')
    log(f'Text of the target element: {el_text}')
    actual_value = get_css_property_value(f'xpath:{locator}', property)
    if operation == "contains":
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Should Contain', actual_value, exp_value)
    else:
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Should Be Equal', actual_value, exp_value)

        login_to_rhods_dashboard(username, TEST_USER.PASSWORD, TEST_USER.AUTH_TYPE)
        wait_for_rhods_dashboard_to_load()
        launch_jupyter_from_rhods_dashboard_link()
        login_to_jupyterhub(username, TEST_USER.PASSWORD, TEST_USER.AUTH_TYPE)
        page_should_not_contain('403 : Forbidden')
        authorization_required = is_service_account_authorization_required()
        if authorization_required:
            authorize_jupyterhub_service_account()
        fix_spawner_status()
        spawn_notebook_with_arguments()


def enable_user_workload_monitoring():
    return_code, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc apply -f {UWM_ENABLE_FILEPATH}')
    log_to_console(output)
    if "already exists" in output:
        log('configmap already existed on the cluster, continuing')
        return
    else:
        should_be_equal_as_integers(return_code, 0,msg='Error while applying the provided file')


def verify_sandbox_toolchain_data():
    result = run(f'cat {EXECDIR}/log.txt | grep "invalid\\|failed\\|error"')
    if "failed" in result or "invalid" in result or "error" in result:
        fail('RHODS onboarding script is not executed successfully.Check log for more detail.')
    else:
        k_data = run(f'cat {EXECDIR}/log.txt | grep -i "openshift-kube-apiserver"')
        k_mem_data = split_string(k_data, '\n')
        for data in k_mem_data:
            km_data = split_string(data, ':')
            m_value = convert_to_number(f'{km_data[1]}[:-3]')
            if not m_value <= MEMORY_THRESHOLD:
                run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('FAIL', 'Kube-API server value is higher than,', f'expected in toolchain result=> {km_data[0]} : {m_value}')

def deploy_minio(minio_image='quay.io/modh/ods-ci-minio-models@sha256:801f49a705e827283a9970d2e5a807fec8357f18457abd0f46d9797beabe8160', namespace='minio', podname='ods-ci-minio', service_name='ods-ci-minio-srv', route_name='ods-ci-minio-route'):
    exists = run_keyword_and_return_status('Check If Pod Exists',namespace=namespace, label_selector='app=minio', status_only=FALSE)
    if exists:
        log(message=f'Minio pod with name {podname} in {namespace} NS already present. Re-using existing one.')
    else:
        key, pw = generate_minio_random_credentials()
        set_test_variable(key)
        set_test_variable(pw)
        set_test_variable(podname)
        set_test_variable(minio_image)
        set_test_variable(service_name)
        set_test_variable(route_name)
        create_file_from_template(MINIO_POD_FILEPATH, f'{MINIO_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/minio_filled.yaml')
        rc = run_and_return_rc(f'oc new-project {namespace}')
        rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc apply -f {MINIO_RESOURCES_DIRPATH}/minio_filled.yaml -n {namespace}')
        wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector='app=minio', namespace=namespace)
    rc, route = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc get route {route_name} -n {namespace} --template={{.spec.host}}')
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)
    return route

def create_data_science_project(title, description, resource_name=NONE, existing_project=FALSE):
    if existing_project:
        filter_projects_by_name(title)
        existing_project = run_keyword_and_return_status('Wait Until Page Contains Element', f'xpath://a[text()="{title}"]')
    if existing_project:
        log(f"DS Project '{title}' already exists, reusing project",console='True')
        click_link(title)
    else:
        wait_until_page_contains_element(PROJECT_CREATE_BTN_XP)
        click_button(PROJECT_CREATE_BTN_XP)
        wait_until_page_contains_element(RESOURCE_EDIT_BTN_XP)
        click_button(RESOURCE_EDIT_BTN_XP)
        wait_until_page_contains_element(TITLE_INPUT_XP)
        run_keyword_and_warn_on_failure('Element Should Be Disabled', GENERIC_CREATE_BTN_XP)
        input_text(TITLE_INPUT_XP, title)
        input_text(DESCR_INPUT_XP, description)
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Validate Generated Resource Name',project_title=title)
        if resource_name == NONE:
            resource_name = get_value(RESOURCE_INPUT_XP)
            resource_name = generate_unique_namespace(resource_name)
        input_text(RESOURCE_INPUT_XP, resource_name)
        wait_until_element_is_enabled(GENERIC_CREATE_BTN_XP)
        click_button(GENERIC_CREATE_BTN_XP)
        wait_until_generic_modal_disappears()
    wait_until_project_is_open(project_title=title)
    open = run_keyword_and_return_status('Wait Until Project Is Open',project_title=title)
    if open == FALSE:
        is_home_open = is_data_science_projects_page_open()
        if is_home_open == TRUE:
            log(message=f'After DS Project {title} creation, user did not get redirected to details page...(RHODS-8477)', level='WARN')
            fail()

def create_openvino_models_for_kserve(server_name=RUNTIME_NAME, model_name=MODEL_NAME, project_name=PRJ_TITLE, num_projects=1, token=FALSE):
    project_postfix = set_variable(EMPTY)
    for idx in range(0, num_projects):
        new_project = set_variable(f'{project_name}{project_postfix}')
        log_to_console(f"Creating new DS Project '{new_project}' with Model '{model_name}'")
        open_data_science_projects_home_page()
        create_data_science_project(title=new_project, description=PRJ_DESCRIPTION, existing_project=TRUE)
        recreate_s3_data_connection(project_title=new_project, dc_name='model-serving-connection', aws_access_key=S3.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, aws_secret_access=S3.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, aws_bucket_name='ods-ci-s3')
        deploy_kserve_model_via_ui(model_name=model_name, serving_runtime='OpenVINO Model Server', data_connection='model-serving-connection', path='kserve-openvino-test/openvino-example-model', model_framework='openvino_ir')
        wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector=f'serving.kserve.io/inferenceservice={model_name}', namespace=new_project)
        verify_model_status(model_name, 'success')
        project_postfix = evaluate(f'{idx}+1')
        set_suite_variable(MODEL_CREATED, TRUE)

def select_notebook_image(notebook_image, version='default'):
    KFNBC_IMAGE_ROW = set_variable(f'//input[contains(@id, "{notebook_image}")]')
    KFNBC_IMAGE_DROPDOWN = set_variable(f'{KFNBC_IMAGE_ROW}/../../div[contains(@class, "notebook-image-tags")]')
    wait_until_element_is_visible('xpath://div[.="Notebook image"]/..')
    wait_until_element_is_visible(xpath=KFNBC_IMAGE_ROW)
    element_should_be_enabled(xpath=KFNBC_IMAGE_ROW)
    if version=="default":
        click_element(xpath=KFNBC_IMAGE_ROW)
    elif version=="previous":
        verify_version_dropdown_is_present(notebook_image)
        click_element(xpath=f'{KFNBC_IMAGE_ROW}/../..//button[.="Versions"]')
        click_element(xpath=f'{KFNBC_IMAGE_DROPDOWN}//label//div[contains(string(), "{PREVIOUS_NOTEBOOK_VER}")]/../../input')
    else:
        verify_version_dropdown_is_present(notebook_image)
        click_element(xpath=f'{KFNBC_IMAGE_ROW}/../..//button[.="Versions"]')
        sleep('5s')
        tag_exists = run_keyword_and_return_status('Page Should Contain Element',xpath=f'{KFNBC_IMAGE_DROPDOWN}//input[@data-id="{notebook_image}:{version}"]')
        if tag_exists==True:
            click_element(xpath=f'{KFNBC_IMAGE_DROPDOWN}//input[@data-id="{notebook_image}:{version}"]')
        else:
            log_to_console('Unknown image version requested')
            fail('Unknown image version requested')
    if version=="previous":
        update_globals_for_jupyterlab_3_custom()
    else:
        update_globals_for_jupyterlab_4()

def verify_cpu_and_memory_requests_and_limits_are_defined_for_all_containers_in_all_pods_in_project(project):
    project_pods_info = fetch_project_pods_info(project)
    for pod_info in project_pods_info:
        verify_cpu_and_memory_requests_and_limits_are_defined_for_pod(pod_info)
        if project == APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE:
            if "cuda-s2i" in pod_info['metadata']['name']:
                verify_requests_contains_expected_values(cpu=2, memory='4Gi', requests=pod_info['spec']['containers'][0]['resources']['requests'])
            if "minimal-gpu" in pod_info['metadata']['name'] or "pytorch" in pod_info['metadata']['name'] or "tensorflow" in pod_info['metadata']['name']:
                verify_requests_contains_expected_values(cpu=4, memory='8Gi', requests=pod_info['spec']['containers'][0]['resources']['requests'])


def query_model_multiple_times(model_name, namespace, runtime='caikit-tgis-runtime', isvc_name=model_name, inference_type='all-tokens', status_code=200, n_times=10, query_idx=0, validate_response=TRUE, string_check_only=FALSE, protocol='grpc', connect_timeout=10, port_forwarding=FALSE, port=443, body_params='&{EMPTY}', cert=False, token=None, args):
    if inference_type == "streaming":
        streamed_response = set_variable(TRUE)
    else:
        streamed_response = set_variable(FALSE)
    if validate_response == FALSE or string_check_only:
        skip_json_load_response = set_variable(TRUE)
    else:
        skip_json_load_response = set_variable(streamed_response)
    if port_forwarding:
        host = set_variable('localhost')
        port = extract_service_port(service_name=f'{isvc_name}-predictor', protocol=protocol, namespace=namespace)
        insecure = set_variable(FALSE)
        plaintext = set_variable(TRUE)
    else:
        host = get_kserve_inference_host_via_cli(isvc_name=isvc_name, namespace=namespace)
        insecure = set_variable(TRUE)
        plaintext = set_variable(FALSE)
    body, header, extra_args = llm.prepare_payload(runtime=runtime, protocol=protocol, inference_type=inference_type, model_name=model_name, body_params=body_params, query_text=f'{EXP_RESPONSES}[queries][{query_idx}][query_text]')
    if token != None:
        if protocol == "grpc":
            header = set_variable(f'"Authorization: Bearer {token}" -H {header}')
        else:
            set_to_dictionary(header, 'Authorization', f'Bearer {token}')
    runtime_details = set_variable(f'{RUNTIME_FORMATS}[{runtime}][endpoints][{inference_type}][{protocol}]')
    endpoint = set_variable(f'{runtime_details}[endpoint]')
    set_to_dictionary(args, '&{extra_args}')
    for counter in range(0, n_times, 1):
        log(counter)
        if protocol == "grpc":
            res = query_model_with_grpcurl('&{args}',host=host, port=port, endpoint=endpoint, json_body=body, json_header=header, insecure=insecure, plaintext=plaintext, skip_res_json=skip_json_load_response, cert=cert, connect_timeout=connect_timeout)
        elif protocol == "http":
            payload = odhdashboardapi.prepare_payload(body=body, str_to_json=TRUE)
            log_dictionary(args)
            set_to_dictionary(args,url=f'https://{host}:{port}/{endpoint}', expected_status='any', headers=header, json=payload, verify=cert)
            is_timeout = run_keyword_and_return_status('Dictionary Should Contain Key', args, 'timeout')
            if is_timeout == FALSE:
                set_to_dictionary(args,timeout=100)
            log_dictionary(args)
            res = run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Perform Request', '&{args}',request_type='POST', skip_res_json=skip_json_load_response)
            run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Status Should Be', status_code)
        log(res,console='yes')
        if validate_response == TRUE:
            if string_check_only:
                model_response_should_be(response=res, model_name=model_name, inference_type=inference_type, runtime=runtime, query_idx=query_idx)
            else:
                response_container_field = set_variable(f'{runtime_details}[response_fields_map][response]')
                if response_container_field != EMPTY:
                    res = set_variable(f'{res}[{response_container_field}][0]')
                run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Model Response Should Match The Expectation',model_response=res, model_name=model_name, runtime_details=runtime_details, runtime=runtime, streamed_response=streamed_response, query_idx=query_idx)


def get_directory_name_from_git_repo_url(repo_url):
    ans = split_path(repo_url)
    ans = remove_string(f'{ans}[1]', '.git')
    return ans


def is_component_enabled(component, dsc_name=DSC_NAME):
    return_code, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc get datasciencecluster {dsc_name} -o json | jq \'.spec.components.{component}.managementState // "Removed"\'')
    log(output)
    should_be_equal_as_integers(return_code, 0,msg='Error detected while getting component status')
    n_output = evaluate(f"'{output}' == ''")
    if n_output:
        return 'false'
    else:
        if output == "Removed":
            return 'false'
        elif output == "Managed":
            return 'true'

def verify_dspo_logs_show_error_encountered_when_parsing_dspa():
    stopped = set_variable(False)
    timeout = set_variable(180)
    pod_name = run(f"oc get pods -n {APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE} | grep data-science-pipelines-operator | awk '{print $1}'")
    log(pod_name)
    try:
        while not stopped:
            sleep('1s')
            logs = run(f'oc logs --tail=-1 {pod_name} -n {APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE}')
            stopped = set_variable_if(f'"Encountered error when parsing CR" in """{logs}"""', 'True', 'False')
    except ('WHILE loop was aborted',):
        fail(msg="Reconciliation wasn't triggered")

def is_rhods_version_greater_or_equal_than(target):
    if PRODUCT == "ODH":
        return TRUE
    ver = get_rhods_version()
    ver = fetch_from_left(ver, '-')
    if "1.18" in ver:
        return TRUE
    comparison = gte(ver, target)
    return comparison

def delete_gpu_node_in_self_managed_aws_cluster():
    gpu_nodes = oc_get(kind='Machine', label_selector='machine.openshift.io/instance-type=g4dn.xlarge')
    log(gpu_nodes[0]['metadata']['name'],console='True')
    run_and_return_rc(f'oc annotate machine/{gpu_nodes[0][\'metadata\'][\'name\']} -n openshift-machine-api machine.openshift.io/cluster-api-delete-machine="true"')
    run_and_return_rc(f"oc adm cordon {gpu_nodes[0]['metadata']['name']}")
    run_and_return_rc(f"oc adm drain {gpu_nodes[0]['metadata']['name']} --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data")
    gpu_machineset = oc_get(kind='MachineSet', label_selector='gpu-machineset=true')
    run_and_return_rc(f"oc scale --replicas=0 machineset/{gpu_machineset[0]['metadata']['name']} -n openshift-machine-api")

def get_model_runtime_template_resource_name_by_runtime_name_or_display_name(runtime_name=EMPTY, runtime_display_name=EMPTY):
    if runtime_name != "":
        return_code, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc get templates -ojson -n {APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE} | jq \'.items[] | select(.objects[].metadata."name"=="{runtime_name}") | .metadata.name\' | tr -d \'"\'')
        log_to_console(output)
        should_be_equal_as_integers(return_code, 0,msg='Error while applying the provided file')
        return output
    elif runtime_display_name != "":
        return_code, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc get templates -ojson -n {APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE} | jq \'.items[] | select(.objects[].metadata.annotations."openshift.io/display-name"=="{runtime_display_name}") | .metadata.name\' | tr -d \'"\'')
        log_to_console(output)
        should_be_equal_as_integers(return_code, 0,msg='Error while applying the provided file')
        return output
    elif runtime_name == "" and runtime_display_name == "":
        fail(msg='Kindly provide runtime name or display name')

def run_kuberay_e2e_test(test_name):
    log_to_console(f'Running Kuberay E2E test: {test_name}')
    result = run_process(f'./e2e -test.timeout 30m -test.parallel 1 -test.run {test_name}', 'env:KUBERAY_TEST_TIMEOUT_SHORT=2m', 'env:KUBERAY_TEST_TIMEOUT_MEDIUM=7m', 'env:KUBERAY_TEST_TIMEOUT_LONG=10m', f'env:KUBERAY_TEST_RAY_IMAGE={KUBERAY_TEST_RAY_IMAGE}', 'env:KUBERAY_TEST_OUTPUT_DIR=%{WORKSPACE}/kuberay-logs',shell='true', stderr='STDOUT', timeout='20m', stdout=f'{TEMPDIR}/output.txt')
    log_to_console(result.stdout)
    check_missing_go_test(result.stdout)
    if result.rc != 0:
        fail(f'{test_name} failed')


def run_openshift_metrics_query(query, username, password, auth_type, retry_attempts=10, return_zero_if_result_empty='False'):
    open_ocp_console()
    loginpage.login_to_openshift(ocp_user_name=username, ocp_user_pw=password, ocp_user_auth_type=auth_type)
    ocpmenu.switch_to_administrator_perspective()
    menu_observe_exists = run_keyword_and_return_status('Menu.Page Should Contain Menu', 'Observe')
    if menu_observe_exists:
        menu.navigate_to_page('Observe', 'Metrics')
    else:
        menu_monitoring_exists = run_keyword_and_return_status('Menu.Page Should Contain Menu', 'Monitoring')
        if menu_monitoring_exists:
            menu.navigate_to_page('Monitoring', 'Metrics')
        else:
            fail(msg=f'{username} can\'t see the Observe/Monitoring section in OpenShift Console, please make sure it belongs to a group with "view" role')
    metrics.verify_page_loaded()
    metrics.run_query(query, retry_attempts)
    result = metrics.get_query_results(return_zero_if_result_empty=return_zero_if_result_empty)
    return result

def start_workbench_from_projects_home_page(workbench_title, project_title, namespace=EMPTY, workbench_cr_name=EMPTY):
    is_stopped = run_keyword_and_return_status('Workbench Status Should Be From Projects Home Page',workbench_title=workbench_title, status=WORKBENCH_STATUS_STOPPED, project_title=project_title)
    if is_stopped == TRUE:
        if workbench_cr_name == EMPTY:
            if namespace == EMPTY:
                namespace = get_openshift_namespace_from_data_science_project(project_title=project_title)
            _, workbench_cr_name = get_openshift_notebook_cr_from_workbench(workbench_title=workbench_title, namespace=namespace)
        kebab_button = set_variable(xpath=f'//a[@data-testid="notebook-route-link" and text()="{workbench_title}"]/ancestor::tr[@data-testid="project-notebooks-table-row"]//button[@aria-label="Kebab toggle"]')
        wait_until_element_is_visible(kebab_button,timeout='10s')
        click_element(kebab_button)
        start_button = set_variable(xpath=f'//a[@data-testid="notebook-route-link" and text()="{workbench_title}"]/ancestor::tr[@data-testid="project-notebooks-table-row"]//button[@data-testid="notebook-start-action"]')
        wait_until_element_is_visible(start_button,timeout='10s')
        click_element(start_button)
    else:
        fail(msg=f'Cannot start {workbench_title} workbench because it is not stopped.')
    wait_until_workbench_is_started_from_projects_home_page(workbench_title=workbench_title, project_title=project_title)


def get_current_cpu_usage(namespace, workload_type):
    thanos_url = get_openshift_thanos_url()
    token = generate_thanos_token()
    expression = set_variable(f'sum by(owner_name, owner_kind) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind=~"{workload_type}", namespace="{namespace}"} * on (namespace, pod) group_right(owner_name, owner_kind) node_namespace_pod_container:container_cpu_usage_seconds_total:sum_irate)')
    wait_until_element_is_visible(xpath='//*[@id="topResourceConsumingCPU-ChartLegend-ChartLabel-0"]', timeout=60)
    query_result = prometheus.run_query(f'https://{thanos_url}', token, expression)
    if query_result.json()["data"]["result"] == "[]":
        for retry in range(MAX_RETRIES):
            query_result = prometheus.run_query(f'https://{thanos_url}', token, expression)
            exit_for_loop_if(f'"{query_result.json()["data"]["result"]}" != "[]"')
            log('failed. Retrying...')
            wait_until_element_is_visible(xpath='//*[@id="topResourceConsumingCPU-ChartLegend-ChartLabel-0"]', timeout=60)
    cpu_usage_value = get_query_value(query_result)
    cpu_requested = convert_to_number(cpu_usage_value)
    cpu_usage_rounded_value = evaluate(f'round( {cpu_requested}, 3)')
    return cpu_usage_rounded_value


def get_model_route_via_ui(model_name):
    endpoint_link = set_variable(f'//a[@data-testid="metrics-link-{model_name}" and text()="{model_name}"]/ancestor::tr//td//button[@data-testid="internal-external-service-button"]')
    seleniumlibrary.wait_until_page_contains_element(endpoint_link)
    seleniumlibrary.click_button(endpoint_link)
    route_xpath = set_variable('//span[text()="External (can be accessed from inside or outside the cluster)"]/ancestor::dl//dd/div/div/span[1]')
    seleniumlibrary.wait_until_page_contains_element('//div[@data-testid="external-service-popover"]')
    seleniumlibrary.wait_until_page_contains_element(route_xpath)
    sleep(2,reason='The element takes a little bit longer than expected rendering the url')
    url = get_text(route_xpath)
    kserve = run_keyword_and_return_status('SeleniumLibrary.Page Should Contain', 'Single-model serving enabled')
    if kserve:
        url = catenate(url, f'/v2/models/{model_name}/infer',SEPARATOR=)
    return url

def download_python_client_dependencies(destination, package_version):
    open_new_notebook()
    python_version = get_xy_python_version_from_jupyterlab()

def get_pod_hardware_resources_and_limits(label_selector, namespace, container_name=NONE):
    if container_name == NONE:
        rc, resources = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f"oc get pods -l {label_selector} -n {namespace} -ojson | jq '.items[].spec.containers[] | .resources'")
    else:
        rc, resources = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc get pods -l {label_selector} -n {namespace} -ojson | jq \'.items[].spec.containers[] | select(.name=="{container_name}") | .resources\'')
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)
    resources = load_json_string(resources)
    return resources


def add_environment_variables_in_workbench(env_variables):
    click_element('//a[@href="#environment-variables"]')
    click_element(WORKBENCH_ADD_VAR_BTN_XP)
    n_objects = get_length(env_variables)
    for idx, env_variable in enumerate(env_variables, start=1):
        k8s__type = set_variable(f'{env_variable}[k8s_type]')
        input_type = set_variable(f'{env_variable}[input_type]')
        remove_from_dictionary(env_variable, 'k8s_type', 'input_type')
        select_environment_variable_types(k8s_type=k8s__type, input_type=input_type, variable_index=idx)
        if input_type == KEYVALUE_TYPE:
            n_pairs = get_length(env_variable.keys())
            for pair_idx, key, value in enumerate(env_variable):
                log(f'{pair_idx}-{key}-{value}')
                run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Wait Until Page Contains Element',xpath=f'//input[@aria-label="key of item {pair_idx}"]')
                input_text(f'{ENV_VARIABLES_SECTION_XP}/div[contains(@class, "-l-split")][{idx}]//input[@aria-label="key of item {pair_idx}"]', key)
                input_text(f'{ENV_VARIABLES_SECTION_XP}/div[contains(@class, "-l-split")][{idx}]//input[@aria-label="value of item {pair_idx}"]', value)
                if n_pairs-pair_idx > 1:
                    another_key_button_xpath = set_variable(f'//section[@aria-label="Environment variables"]/div[contains(@class, "-l-split")][{idx}]//button[@data-testid="another-key-value-pair-button"]')
                    execute_javascript(f"document.evaluate('{another_key_button_xpath}', document, null, XPathResult.FIRST_ORDERED_NODE_TYPE, null).singleNodeValue.scrollIntoView()")
                    click_element(xpath=another_key_button_xpath)
        elif input_type == UPLOAD_TYPE:
            rc, pwd = run_and_return_rc_and_output('echo $PWD')
            choose_file(f'{ENV_VARIABLES_SECTION_XP}/div[(contains(@class, "-l-split"))][{idx}]//div[(contains(@class, "-c-file-upload"))]//input[@type="file"]', f'{pwd}/{env_variable}[filepath]')
        if n_objects-idx > 0:
            click_button('Add more variables')

def check_limits_and_requests_for_every_workbench_pod_container(containers_info, wb_cr_name, gpu_present=TRUE, exp_gpu_value=1):
    for container_info in containers_info:
        container_name = set_variable(container_info['name'])
        if container_name == wb_cr_name:
            verify_cpu_and_memory_requests_and_limits_are_defined_for_pod_container(container_info,nvidia_gpu=gpu_present)
            requests = set_variable(container_info['resources']['requests'])
            limits = set_variable(container_info['resources']['limits'])
            if gpu_present == TRUE:
                run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Should Be Equal', requests['nvidia.com/gpu'], exp_gpu_value)
                run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Should Be Equal', limits['nvidia.com/gpu'], exp_gpu_value)
            else:
                run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Dictionary Should Not Contain Key', requests, 'nvidia.com/gpu')
                run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Dictionary Should Not Contain Key', limits, 'nvidia.com/gpu')
        else:
            verify_cpu_and_memory_requests_and_limits_are_defined_for_pod_container(container_info,nvidia_gpu=FALSE)

def handle_deletion_confirmation_modal(item_title, item_type, press_cancel=FALSE, additional_msg=NONE):
    delete_btn_xp = set_variable(xpath="//button[contains(text(), 'Delete')]")
    wait_until_generic_modal_appears()
    run_keyword_and_warn_on_failure('Page Should Contain', f'Delete {item_type}?')
    run_keyword_and_warn_on_failure('Page Should Contain', 'This action cannot be undone.')
    if additional_msg != NONE:
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Page Should Contain', additional_msg)
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Page Should Contain', f'Type {item_title} to confirm deletion:')
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Element Should Be Disabled', delete_btn_xp)
    input_text(item_title,xpath='//input[@id="delete-modal-input"]')
    wait_until_element_is_enabled(delete_btn_xp)
    if press_cancel == TRUE:
        click_button(GENERIC_CANCEL_BTN_XP)
    else:
        click_button(delete_btn_xp)
    wait_until_generic_modal_disappears()


def set_component_state(component, state):
    result = run_process('oc get datascienceclusters.datasciencecluster.opendatahub.io -o name',shell='true', stderr='STDOUT')
    if result.stdout == "":
        fail('Can not find datasciencecluster')
    cluster_name = set_variable(result.stdout)
    result = run_process(f'oc patch {cluster_name} --type \'json\' -p \'[{"op" : "replace" ,"path" : "/spec/components/{component}/managementState" ,"value" : "{state}"}]\'',shell='true', stderr='STDOUT')
    if result.rc != 0:
        fail(f'Can not enable {component}: {result.stdout}')
    log_to_console(f'Component {component} state was set to {state}')

def verify_model_inference_with_retries(model_name, inference_input, expected_inference_output, token_auth=FALSE, project_title=NONE, retries=5, deployment_mode='UI', kserve_mode='Serverless', service_port=NONE, end_point=NONE):
    status = run_keyword_and_return_status('Verify Model Inference', model_name, inference_input, expected_inference_output, token_auth, project_title, deployment_mode)
    if not status:
        retry = set_variable(0)
        while retry < retries:
            if retry > 0:
                log(message=f'Modelmesh inference call failed {retry}/{retries}.', level='WARN')
            status = run_keyword_and_return_status('Verify Model Inference', model_name, inference_input, expected_inference_output, token_auth,project_title=project_title, deployment_mode=deployment_mode, kserve_mode=kserve_mode, service_port=service_port, end_point=end_point)
            if status:
                break
            retry = evaluate(f'{retry} + 1')
            sleep('5s')
        if not status:
            fail(msg=f'Inference operation failed after {retries+1} attempts')


def install_serverless_operator_via_cli():
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc create namespace {SERVERLESS_NS}')
    install_isv_operator_from_operatorhub_via_cli(operator_name=SERVERLESS_OP_NAME, namespace=SERVERLESS_NS, subscription_name=SERVERLESS_SUB_NAME, catalog_source_name='redhat-operators', operator_group_name='serverless-operators', operator_group_ns=SERVERLESS_NS, operator_group_target_ns=NONE)
    wait_until_operator_subscription_last_condition_is(type='CatalogSourcesUnhealthy', status='False', reason='AllCatalogSourcesHealthy', subcription_name=SERVERLESS_SUB_NAME, namespace=SERVERLESS_NS, retry=150)
    wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector='name=knative-openshift', namespace=SERVERLESS_NS)
    wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector='name=knative-openshift-ingress', namespace=SERVERLESS_NS)
    wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector='name=knative-operator', namespace=SERVERLESS_NS)

def delete_all_accelerator_profiles_which_starts_with(ap_prefix, ns=APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE):
    ap_str = run(f'oc get acceleratorprofiles -n {ns} -o json | jq .items[].metadata.name | grep {ap_prefix} | tr -d \'"\'')
    ap_list = split_string(ap_str,separator='\n')
    log(f'List of Accelerator Profiles to be deleted: {ap_list}',console='yes')
    for ap_name in ap_list:
        ap_desc = run(f'oc get acceleratorprofile {ap_name} -n {ns} -o json')
        log(ap_desc,console='yes')
        return_code = run_and_return_rc(f'oc delete acceleratorprofile {ap_name} -n {ns}')
        should_be_equal_as_integers(return_code, 0,msg=f'Error deleting Accelerator profile {ap_name}')


def delete_workbench_from_cli(workbench_title, project_title):
    ns_name = get_openshift_namespace_from_data_science_project(project_title=project_title)
    _, cr_name = get_openshift_notebook_cr_from_workbench(workbench_title=workbench_title, namespace=ns_name)
    if cr_name == EMPTY:
        log(msg=f'There is probably no Workbench with Display Name equal to {workbench_title}', level='WARN')
    else:
        oc_delete(kind='Notebook', name=cr_name, namespace=ns_name)
        while TRUE:
            _, cr_name = get_openshift_notebook_cr_from_workbench(workbench_title=workbench_title, namespace=ns_name)
            if cr_name == EMPTY:
                break
            sleep('5s',reason="let's not overload the API")

def create_openvino_models(server_name=RUNTIME_NAME, model_name=MODEL_NAME, project_name=PRJ_TITLE, num_projects=1, token=FALSE):
    project_postfix = set_variable(EMPTY)
    for idx in range(0, num_projects):
        new_project = set_variable(f'{project_name}{project_postfix}')
        log_to_console(f"Creating new DS Project '{new_project}' with Model '{model_name}'")
        open_data_science_projects_home_page()
        create_data_science_project(title=new_project, description=PRJ_DESCRIPTION, existing_project=TRUE)
        recreate_s3_data_connection(project_title=new_project, dc_name='model-serving-connection', aws_access_key=S3.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, aws_secret_access=S3.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, aws_bucket_name='ods-ci-s3')
        create_model_server(token=FALSE, server_name=server_name, existing_server=FALSE)
        serve_model(project_name=new_project, model_name=model_name, framework='openvino_ir', existing_data_connection=TRUE, data_connection_name='model-serving-connection', model_path='openvino-example-model', existing_model=TRUE)
        runtime_pod_name = replace_string_using_regexp(string=server_name, pattern='\\s', replace_with='-')
        runtime_pod_name = convert_to_lower_case(runtime_pod_name)
        wait_until_keyword_succeeds('5 min', '10 sec', 'Verify Openvino Deployment',runtime_name=runtime_pod_name, project_name=new_project)
        wait_until_keyword_succeeds('5 min', '10 sec', 'Verify Serving Service', new_project)
        verify_model_status(model_name, 'success')
        project_postfix = evaluate(f'{idx}+1')
        set_suite_variable(MODEL_CREATED, TRUE)

def verify_accelerator_profile_values_via_cli(name, identifier=EMPTY, description=EMPTY, enabled='True', tolerations=EMPTY, tol_operator='Equal', tol_effect='None', tol_key='key', tol_value='value', tol_seconds='Forever', ns=APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE):
    ap_spec_dict = get_accelerator_profile_spec_values_via_cli(name, ns)
    name_from_spec = get_from_dictionary(ap_spec_dict, 'displayName')
    enabled_from_spec = get_from_dictionary(ap_spec_dict, 'enabled')
    bool_enabled = convert_to_boolean(enabled)
    should_be_equal(name_from_spec, name)
    should_be_equal(enabled_from_spec, bool_enabled)
    if identifier != EMPTY:
        identifier_from_spec = get_from_dictionary(ap_spec_dict, 'identifier')
        should_be_equal(identifier_from_spec, identifier)
    if description != EMPTY:
        description_from_spec = get_from_dictionary(ap_spec_dict, 'description')
        should_be_equal(description_from_spec, description)
    if tolerations != EMPTY:
        tolerations_from_spec = get_from_dictionary(ap_spec_dict, 'tolerations')
        tol_operator_retrieved = get_from_dictionary(f'{tolerations_from_spec}[0]', 'operator')
        should_be_equal(tol_operator_retrieved, tol_operator)
        tol_key_retrieved = get_from_dictionary(f'{tolerations_from_spec}[0]', 'key')
        should_be_equal(tol_key_retrieved, tol_key)
        tol_value_retrieved = get_from_dictionary(f'{tolerations_from_spec}[0]', 'value')
        should_be_equal(tol_value_retrieved, tol_value)
        tol_effect_retrieved = get_from_dictionary(f'{tolerations_from_spec}[0]', 'effect')
        if tol_effect == "None":
            should_be_equal(tol_effect_retrieved, "")
        else:
            should_be_equal(tol_effect_retrieved, tol_effect)
        if tol_seconds != "Forever":
            tol_seconds_retrieved = get_from_dictionary(f'{tolerations_from_spec}[0]', 'tolerationSeconds')
            should_be_equal(f'"{tol_seconds_retrieved}"', f'"{tol_seconds}"')

def fix_spawner_status(username=TEST_USER.USERNAME):
    spawner_visible = jupyterhub_spawner_is_visible()
    if spawner_visible!=True:
        control_panel_visible = control_panel_is_visible()
        if control_panel_visible==True:
            handle_control_panel()
        else:
            JL_visible = jupyterlab_is_visible()
            if JL_visible==True:
                maybe_close_popup()
                clean_up_server(username=username)
                stop_jupyterlab_notebook_server()
    else:
        modal_visible = spawner_modal_is_visible()
        if modal_visible==True:
            handle_spawner_modal()

def get_query_value(query_response):
    data = builtin.evaluate(f'list({query_response.json()["data"]["result"]})')
    log(data)
    size = get_length(data)
    total = set_variable(0)
    if size>1:
        for item in data:
            value = get_from_dictionary(item, 'value')
            last_value = get_from_list(value, '-1')
            total = evaluate(f'{total} + {last_value}')
    else:
        total = set_variable(query_response.json()["data"]["result"][0]["value"][-1])
    return total

def get_memory_requested_tooltip_text():
    mouse_over(xpath='//*[@aria-label="Memory usage/requested"]')
    wait_until_element_is_visible("xpath://*[starts-with(@id,'pf-tooltip-')]")
    memory_usage_hover_data = get_text("xpath://*[starts-with(@id,'pf-tooltip-')]")
    memory_usage_list = split_to_lines(memory_usage_hover_data)
    memory_usage_line = set_variable(f'{memory_usage_list}[0]')
    memory_requested_line = set_variable(f'{memory_usage_list}[1]')
    memory_usage_value_array = get_regexp_matches(memory_usage_line, '\\d+\\.?\\d*')
    memory_requested_value_array = get_regexp_matches(memory_requested_line, '\\d+\\.?\\d*')
    return f'{memory_usage_value_array}[0]', f'{memory_requested_value_array}[0]'


def create_datasciencecluster_customresource_using_test_variables(dsc_name=DSC_NAME):
    file_path = set_variable('tasks/Resources/Files/')
    copy_file(source=f'{file_path}dsc_template.yml', destination=f'{file_path}dsc_apply.yml')
    run(f"sed -i'' -e 's/<dsc_name>/{dsc_name}/' {file_path}dsc_apply.yml")
    for cmp in COMPONENT_LIST:
        if cmp not in COMPONENTS:
            run(f"sed -i'' -e 's/<{cmp}_value>/Removed/' {file_path}dsc_apply.yml")
        elif 'COMPONENTS.${cmp}' == 'Managed':
            run(f"sed -i'' -e 's/<{cmp}_value>/Managed/' {file_path}dsc_apply.yml")
        elif 'COMPONENTS.${cmp}' == 'Removed':
            run(f"sed -i'' -e 's/<{cmp}_value>/Removed/' {file_path}dsc_apply.yml")
        if 'cmp' == 'modelregistry':
            run(f"sed -i'' -e 's/<{cmp}_namespace>/{MODEL_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE}/' {file_path}dsc_apply.yml")

def get_pod_tolerations(pod_name, ns=NOTEBOOKS_NAMESPACE):
    openshiftlibrary.search_pods(pod_name,namespace=ns)
    output = run(f'oc describe pod {pod_name} -n {ns}')
    create_file('podspec.txt', output)
    tolerations_list = parse_file_for_tolerations('podspec.txt')
    remove_file('podspec.txt')
    return tolerations_list

def get_containers(pod_name, namespace):
    containers = run(f"oc get pod {pod_name} -n {namespace} -o json | jq '.spec.containers[] | .name'")
    containers = replace_string(containers, '"', EMPTY)
    containers = split_string(containers, '\n')
    return containers


def verify_deployment(component, nPods, nContainers, containerNames, podStatuses=NONE, containerStatuses=NONE):
    length_should_be(component, nPods)
    for index in range(0, nPods):
        pod = set_variable(f'{component}[{index}]')
        length_should_be(pod.status.containerStatuses, nContainers)
        names = create_list()
        for j in range(0, nContainers):
            append_to_list(names, f'{pod.status.containerStatuses[{j}].name}')
            state = get_dictionary_keys(f'{pod.status.containerStatuses[{j}].state}')
            if podStatuses == NONE:
                should_be_equal_as_strings(pod.status.phase, 'Running')
            else:
                should_be_equal_as_strings(pod.status.phase, f'{podStatuses[{index}]}')
            if containerStatuses == NONE:
                should_be_equal_as_strings(f'{state}[0]', 'running')
            else:
                should_be_equal_as_strings(f'{state}[0]', f'{containerStatuses[{j}]}')
        sort_list(names)
        sort_list(containerNames)
        lists_should_be_equal(names, containerNames)

def change_component_status(component, run=TRUE, enable='Managed'):
    if component not in COMPONENTS:
        log(f'unknown component: {component}',level='WARN')
        return
    if run==TRUE:
        command = catenate(PATCH_PREFIX, f'"{component}":{"managementState": {enable}}', "}}}'",SEPARATOR=)
        return_code, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output(command)
        log(output)
        should_be_equal_as_integers(return_code, 0,msg='Error detected while applying DSC CR')
        sleep('30s')
    else:
        return f'"{component}":{"managementState": {enable}}'

    log_to_console(output)
    should_be_equal_as_integers(return_code, 0,msg='Error detected while installing RHODS')

def storage_size_should_be(name, size, namespace):
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Wait Until Page Contains Element', STORAGE_SECTION_XP)
    click_element(f'{STORAGE_SECTION_XP}//tr[td//*/div[text()="{name}"]]//button[@aria-label="Details"]')
    wait_until_element_is_visible(f'{STORAGE_SECTION_XP}//tr[contains(@class, "-table__expandable-row pf-m-expanded")]')
    rc, pvc_status_phase = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc get pvc -n {namespace} -o jsonpath=\'{.items[?(@.metadata.annotations.openshift\\\\.io/display-name=="{name}")].status.phase}\'')
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0, f'An error occurred during the check of PVC {name} .status.phase value!')
    storage_size_xp = set_variable(f'{STORAGE_SECTION_XP}//tr[td//*/div[text()="{name}"]]/following-sibling::*//td[contains(@data-label,"Size")]//div[strong[text()="Size"]]')
    if pvc_status_phase == "Pending":
        wait_until_page_contains_element(storage_size_xp,timeout='2m')
        displayed_sizes = get_all_text_under_element(f'{storage_size_xp}//*')
        matched_sizes = get_all_strings_that_contain(displayed_sizes, f'Max {size}Gi')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Should Not Be Empty', matched_sizes)
    elif pvc_status_phase == "Bound":
        wait_until_page_contains_element(storage_size_xp,timeout='2m')
        displayed_sizes = get_all_text_under_element(f'{storage_size_xp}//*')
        matched_sizes = get_all_strings_that_contain(displayed_sizes, f'{size}Gi')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Should Not Be Empty', matched_sizes)
        rc, oc_object_size = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc get pvc -n {namespace} -o jsonpath=\'{.items[?(@.metadata.annotations.openshift\\\\.io/display-name=="{name}")].status.capacity.storage}\'')
        should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0, f"An error occurred during the check of PVC {name} '.status.capacity.storage' value!")
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Should Contain', oc_object_size, f'{size}Gi')
    else:
        error_msg = catenate(f"The PVC is in a '{pvc_status_phase}' state which we don't expect for this", "scenario. We expect either 'Pending' or 'Bound' states here. Please, either complete the", 'implementation or investigate the test failure.')
        fail(error_msg)
        return 1
    rc, oc_object_size = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc get pvc -n {namespace} -o jsonpath="{.items[?(@.metadata.annotations[\'openshift\\\\.io/display-name\']==\'{name}\')].spec.resources.requests.storage}"')
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0, f"An error occurred during the check of PVC {name} '.spec.resources.requests.storage' value!")
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Should Be Equal As Strings', oc_object_size, f'{size}Gi')

def create_an_accelerator_profile_via_ui(name, identifier, description=EMPTY, enabled='True', tolerations=EMPTY, tol_operator='Equal', tol_effect=EMPTY, tol_key='key', tol_value='value', tol_seconds='Forever'):
    click_on_create_accelerator_profile_button()
    wait_until_page_contains_element(ACCELERATOR_NAME,timeout='5s')
    input_text(ACCELERATOR_NAME, name)
    input_text(ACCELERATOR_IDENTIFIER, identifier)
    if description != EMPTY:
        input_text(ACCELERATOR_DESCRIPTION, description)
    if enabled != True:
        click_element(ACCELERATOR_ENABLED_SWITCH)
    if tolerations != EMPTY:
        click_button(ACCELERATOR_ADD_TOLERATION_BTN)
        wait_until_element_is_visible(ACCELERATOR_ADD_TOLERATION_MODAL_FORM)
        click_button(ACCELERATOR_TOLERATION_OPERATOR_DROPDOWN)
        click_element(f'//li[@data-testid="dropdown-item {tol_operator}"]')
        click_button(ACCELERATOR_TOLERATION_EFFECT_DROPDOWN)
        click_element(f'//li[@data-testid="dropdown-item {tol_effect}"]')
        input_text(ACCELERATOR_TOLERATION_KEY, tol_key)
        input_text(ACCELERATOR_TOLERATION_VALUE, tol_value)
        if tol_seconds != "Forever":
            click_element(ACCELERATOR_TOLERATION_SECONDS_CUSTOM_RADIO)
            clear_element_and_input_text(ACCELERATOR_TOLERATION_SECONDS_CUSTOM_VALUE, tol_seconds)
        else:
            click_element(ACCELERATOR_TOLERATION_SECONDS_FOREVER_RADIO)
        click_button(ACCELERATOR_TOLERATION_ADD_OR_UPDATE_BUTTON)
    click_button(CREATE_OR_UPDATE_ACCELERATOR_PROFILE_DETAIL_BTN)

def select_framework(framework, retries=1):
    try:
        is_enabled = run_keyword_and_return_status('Element Should Be Enabled', 'xpath://button[@id="inference-service-framework-selection"]')
        if is_enabled:
            for retry_idx in range(0, f'1+{retries}'):
                click_element('xpath://button[@id="inference-service-framework-selection"]')
                page_should_contain_element(f'xpath://span[contains(., "{framework}")]')
                selected = run_keyword_and_return_status('Click Element', f'xpath://span[contains(., "{framework}")]')
                if selected==TRUE:
                    break
        else:
            element_should_be_disabled('id:inference-service-framework-selection')
            text = get_text('xpath://button[@id="inference-service-framework-selection"]/span')
            should_be_true(f'{framework} in {text}')
    except ():
        log(f'framework {framework} does not appear to be supported by the chosen model server')

            run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Wait Until Keyword Succeeds', '2 times', '0.3s', 'Mark Step Check As Yes')
            go_to_next_quickstart_step()
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Go Back And Check Previouse Step Is Selected',n_steps=count, exp_step=count-1)

        go_to_next_quickstart_step()
        close_quickstart_from_button()
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Page Should Not Contain QuickStart Sidebar')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('QuickStart Status Should Be', element, 'Complete')

def capture_and_validate_memory_utilization_of_openshift_api_server_pod():
    memory_usage = run(f"kubectl top pod -n {NAMESPACE} -l {LABEL_SELECTOR} | awk '{if(NR>1)print $3}'")
    memory = split_string(memory_usage, '\n')
    if len(memory) < 2:
        fail('One or more pods may not be available. Check your cluster')
    else:
        memory_value = create_list()
        for m_usage in memory:
            m_value = convert_to_integer(f'{m_usage}[:-2]')
            append_to_list(memory_value, m_value)
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('RHODS Performance Result Validation', memory_value)
        pod_names = get_pod_names(OPERATOR_NAMESPACE,name='rhods-operator')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Verify Containers Have Zero Restarts', pod_names, OPERATOR_NAMESPACE)

def create_ray_cluster_workload(project, local_queue, ray_cluster_name):
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'sed -e "s/\\$NAMESPACE/{project}/g" -e "s/\\$LOCAL_QUEUE/{local_queue}/g" -e "s/\\$RAY_CLUSTER_NAME/{ray_cluster_name}/g" {RAY_CR_FILE} | oc apply -f -')
    if rc != 0:
        fail('Creating ray cluster workload failed')
    else:
        set_global_variable(RAY_WORKLOAD_CREATED, 'True')

def get_machinesets():
    machine_sets_oc = run("oc get machinesets -n openshift-machine-api | awk '{split($0,a); print a[1]}'")
    machinesets = split_to_lines(machine_sets_oc)
    tmp = remove_from_list(machinesets, 0)
    should_be_equal_as_strings(tmp, 'NAME')
    return machinesets

def operation_should_be_allowed(accept_code_500=FALSE):
    if accept_code_500 == FALSE:
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Status Should Be', 200)
    else:
        run_keyword_and_ignore_error('Status Should Be', 200)
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Status Should Be', 500)
        log(message=WARN_MSG_500, level='WARN')


def delete_openvino_notebook_cr(cr_kind, cr_name, cr_ns):
    openvinos = oc_get(api_version='intel.com/v1alpha1', kind=cr_kind, namespace=cr_ns, fields="['metadata.name']")
    n_openvinos = get_length(openvinos)
    if n_openvinos > 1:
        log(message='There are more than once instance of Openvino..deleting all of them!', level='WARN')
    for instance in openvinos:
        oc_delete(api_version='intel.com/v1alpha1', kind=cr_kind, name=f'{instance}[metadata.name]', namespace=cr_ns)


def delete_serving_runtime_template_from_cli_by_runtime_name_or_display_name(runtime_name=EMPTY, runtime_display_name=EMPTY):
    if runtime_name != "":
        template_name = get_model_runtime_template_resource_name_by_runtime_name_or_display_name(runtime_name=runtime_name)
        return_code, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc delete templates {template_name} -n {APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE}')
        log_to_console(output)
        should_be_equal_as_integers(return_code, 0,msg='Error while applying the provided file')
    elif runtime_display_name != "":
        template_name = get_model_runtime_template_resource_name_by_runtime_name_or_display_name(runtime_display_name=runtime_display_name)
        return_code, output = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc delete templates {template_name} -n {APPLICATIONS_NAMESPACE}')
        log_to_console(output)
        should_be_equal_as_integers(return_code, 0,msg='Error while applying the provided file')
    elif runtime_name == "" and runtime_display_name == "":
        fail(msg='Kindly provide runtime name or display name')


def verify_that_inactive_server_has_been_culled_within_a_specific_window_of_time(acceptable_drift=120, loop_control=20):
    notebook_pod_name = get_user_notebook_pod_name(TEST_USER.USERNAME)
    culled = set_variable('False')
    drift = set_variable(0)
    for index in range(loop_control):
        culled = run_keyword_and_return_status('Run Keyword And Expect Error', 'Pods not found in search', 'OpenShiftLibrary.Search Pods', notebook_pod_name,namespace=NOTEBOOKS_NAMESPACE)
        exit_for_loop_if(f'{culled}==True')
        sleep('30s')
        drift = evaluate(f'{drift}+{30}')
    if drift>acceptable_drift:
        fail(f'Drift was over {acceptable_drift} seconds, it was {drift} seconds')


def upgrade_runtime_image(new_image_url, namespace, container, runtime):
    rc, container_idx = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc get ServingRuntime/{runtime} -n {namespace} -o json | jq \'.spec.containers | map(.name == "{container}") | index(true)\'')
    rc, out = run_and_return_rc_and_output(f'oc patch ServingRuntime {runtime} -n {namespace} --type=json -p="[{\'op\': \'replace\', \'path\': \'/spec/containers/{container_idx}/image\', \'value\': \'{new_image_url}\'}]"')
    should_be_equal_as_integers(rc, 0)

    text_list = create_list()

def is_cluster_type_self_managed():
    matches = get_regexp_matches(OCP_CONSOLE_URL, 'rh-ods')
    size = get_length(matches)
    if size>0:
        domain = get_from_list(matches, 0)
        if domain == "rh-ods":
            return TRUE
    else:
        return FALSE


def check_requested_resources_chart(project, cpu_requested, memory_requested):
    mouse_over(xpath="(//*[name()='svg']//*[local-name()='g']//*[local-name()='path'])[2]")

    should_match(hover_cpu_requested, f'Requested by {project}: {cpu_requested} cores')
    mouse_over(xpath='//*[@id="requested-resources-chart-CPU-ChartLegend-ChartLabel-0"]')
    mouse_over(xpath="(//*[name()='svg']//*[local-name()='g']//*[local-name()='path'])[8]")
    hover_memory_requested = get_requested_resources_tooltip_text()
    should_match(hover_memory_requested, f'Requested by {project}: {memory_requested} GiB')
    mouse_over(xpath='//*[@id="requested-resources-chart-CPU-ChartLegend-ChartLabel-0"]')
    mouse_over(xpath="(//*[name()='svg']//*[local-name()='g']//*[local-name()='path'])[1]")
    hover_cpu_shared_quota = get_requested_resources_tooltip_text()
    should_match(hover_cpu_shared_quota, f'Total shared quota: {CPU_SHARED_QUOTA} cores')
    mouse_over(xpath='//*[@id="requested-resources-chart-CPU-ChartLegend-ChartLabel-0"]')
    mouse_over(xpath="(//*[name()='svg']//*[local-name()='g']//*[local-name()='path'])[7]")
    hover_memory_shared_quota = get_requested_resources_tooltip_text()
    should_match(hover_memory_shared_quota, f'Total shared quota: {MEMEORY_SHARED_QUOTA} GiB')


def metrics_should_exist_in_userworkloadmonitoring(thanos_url, thanos_token, search_metrics):
    metrics = create_list()
    for index, metric_search_text in enumerate(search_metrics):
        log(f'{index}: {metric_search_text}')
        metrics_names = get_thanos_metrics_list(thanos_url=thanos_url, thanos_token=thanos_token, search_text=metric_search_text)
        found = run_keyword_and_return_status('Should Not Be Empty', metrics_names)
        if found:
            metrics_names = split_to_lines(metrics_names)
            append_to_list(metrics, metrics_names)
        else:
            run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Fail',msg=f'{metric_search_text} not found')
    return metrics

def handle_stop_workbench_confirmation_modal(workbench_title, press_cancel=FALSE, from_running=TRUE):
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Page Should Contain', 'Stop workbench?')
    if from_running == TRUE:
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Page Should Contain', f'Any unsaved changes to the {workbench_title} workbench will be lost.')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Page Should Contain', 'To save changes, open the workbench.')
        run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Page Should Contain Element',xpath='//a[.="open the workbench"]')
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Page Should Contain Element',xpath='//input[@id="dont-show-again"]')
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Click Element',xpath='//input[@id="dont-show-again"]')
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Click Element',xpath='//input[@id="dont-show-again"]')
    if press_cancel == TRUE:
        click_button(GENERIC_CANCEL_BTN_XP)
    else:
        click_button(WORKBENCH_STOP_BTN_XP)


def verify_displayed_gpu_count_in_single_model_serving(model_name, no_gpus):
    seleniumlibrary.wait_until_page_contains_element(f'xpath://td[@data-label="Name"]/div[text()="{model_name}"]')
    expanded = run_keyword_and_return_status('Page Should Contain Element', f'xpath://td[@data-label="Name"]/div[text()="{model_name}"]/../..//button[@aria-expanded="true"]')
    if not expanded:
        seleniumlibrary.click_element(f'xpath://td[@data-label="Name"]/div[text()="{model_name}"]/../..//button[@aria-expanded="false"]')
    sleep('5s',reason='Sometimes the number of current Accelerators take a few seconds to update')
    current_accs = seleniumlibrary.get_text(f'xpath://td[@data-label="Name"]/div[text()="{model_name}"]/../../../tr[last()]//span[.="Number of accelerators"]/../../dd/div')
    should_match(current_accs, no_gpus)

def set_runtime_image(gpu_type):
    if RUNTIME_IMAGE == EMPTY:
        if gpu_type == "nvidia":
            set_test_variable(runtime_image, 'quay.io/modh/vllm@sha256:c86ff1e89c86bc9821b75d7f2bbc170b3c13e3ccf538bf543b1110f23e056316')
        elif gpu_type == "amd":
            set_test_variable(runtime_image, 'quay.io/modh/vllm@sha256:10f09eeca822ebe77e127aad7eca2571f859a5536a6023a1baffc6764bcadc6e')
        else:
            fail(msg='Provided GPU type is not yet supported. Only nvidia and amd gpu type are supported')
    else:
        log_to_console(msg=' Using the image provided from terminal')

def edit_accelerator_profile(original_display_name, display_name=EMPTY, identifier=EMPTY, description=EMPTY, enabled=EMPTY, tolerations=EMPTY, tol_operator=EMPTY, tol_effect=EMPTY, tol_key=EMPTY, tol_value=EMPTY, tol_seconds=EMPTY):
    click_on_edit_accelerator_profile(original_display_name)
    wait_for_dashboard_page_title(f'Edit {original_display_name}')
    if display_name != EMPTY:
        clear_element_and_input_text(ACCELERATOR_NAME, display_name)
    if identifier != EMPTY:
        clear_element_and_input_text(ACCELERATOR_IDENTIFIER, identifier)
    if description != EMPTY:
        clear_element_and_input_text(ACCELERATOR_DESCRIPTION, description)
    if enabled != EMPTY:
        click_element(ACCELERATOR_ENABLED_SWITCH)
    if tolerations != EMPTY:
        first_kebab = catenate(ACCELERATOR_EDIT_TOLERATION_KEBAB_BTN, '[1]',SEPARATOR=)
        click_button(first_kebab)
        wait_until_element_is_visible(f'{first_kebab}/following::div//span[text()="Edit"]',timeout=10)
        click_element(f'{first_kebab}/following::div//span[text()="Edit"]')
        wait_until_element_is_visible(ACCELERATOR_EDIT_TOLERATION_MODAL_FORM,timeout=10)
        if tol_operator != EMPTY:
            click_button(ACCELERATOR_TOLERATION_OPERATOR_DROPDOWN)
            click_element(f'//li[@data-testid="dropdown-item {tol_operator}"]')
        if tol_effect != EMPTY:
            click_button(ACCELERATOR_TOLERATION_EFFECT_DROPDOWN)
            click_element(f'//li[@data-testid="dropdown-item {tol_effect}"]')
        if tol_key != EMPTY:
            clear_element_and_input_text(ACCELERATOR_TOLERATION_KEY, tol_key)
        if tol_value != EMPTY:
            clear_element_and_input_text(ACCELERATOR_TOLERATION_VALUE, tol_value)
        if tol_seconds != EMPTY:
            if tol_seconds != "Forever":
                click_element(ACCELERATOR_TOLERATION_SECONDS_CUSTOM_RADIO)
                clear_element_and_input_text(ACCELERATOR_TOLERATION_SECONDS_CUSTOM_VALUE, tol_seconds)
            else:
                click_element(ACCELERATOR_TOLERATION_SECONDS_FOREVER_RADIO)
        click_button(ACCELERATOR_TOLERATION_ADD_OR_UPDATE_BUTTON)
    click_button(CREATE_OR_UPDATE_ACCELERATOR_PROFILE_DETAIL_BTN)

def apply_openshift_configuration(config):
    command = set_variable(f'oc apply -f {config}')
    result = run_process(command,stdin=config, shell='True', stdout='PIPE', stderr='PIPE')
    should_be_equal_as_strings(result.rc, 0, 'The oc apply command failed')
    log(result.stdout)


def add_openshift_groups_to_data_science_administrators(admin_groups):

            click_element(f'{ADMIN_GROUPS_SECTION}//*[text()="{group}"]')
    press_keys('None', 'ESC')


def enable_access_to_prometheus_using_openshift_port_forwarding():
    promethues_port_forwarding_process = start_process(f"oc -n {MONITORING_NAMESPACE} port-forward $(oc get pods -n {MONITORING_NAMESPACE} | grep prometheus | awk '{print $1}') 9090",shell='True')
    return promethues_port_forwarding_process


def number_of_items_should_be(expected_number):
    version_check = is_rhods_version_greater_or_equal_than('1.21.0')
    if version_check==True:
        versioned_title_xp = set_variable('//div[contains(@class, "-c-card__title")]//div[contains(@class, "-c-content")]')
    else:
        versioned_title_xp = set_variable('//div[@class="pf-c-card__title odh-card__doc-title"]')
    items = get_webelements(versioned_title_xp)
    actual_n_results = get_length(items)
    run_keyword_and_continue_on_failure('Should Be Equal As Integers', actual_n_results, expected_number)
    return items, actual_n_results


def http_model_setup(user=TEST_USER_3.USERNAME, pw=TEST_USER_3.PASSWORD, auth=TEST_USER_3.AUTH_TYPE):
    launch_dashboard(user, pw, auth, ODH_DASHBOARD_URL, BROWSER.NAME, BROWSER.OPTIONS)
    if HTTP_MODEL_DEPLOYED == FALSE:
        set_up_project(namespace=HTTP_MODEL_NS, single_prj=FALSE)
        open_data_science_project_details_page(HTTP_MODEL_NS,tab_id='model-server')
        deploy_kserve_model_via_ui(model_name=ISVC_NAME, serving_runtime='Caikit', data_connection='kserve-connection', path=MODEL_S3_DIR)
        wait_for_pods_to_be_ready(label_selector=f'serving.kserve.io/inferenceservice={ISVC_NAME}', namespace=HTTP_MODEL_NS)
        query_model_multiple_times(model_name=ISVC_NAME, runtime='caikit-tgis-runtime', inference_type='all-tokens', n_times=1, namespace=HTTP_MODEL_NS, protocol='http', timeout=20, validate_response=FALSE)
        set_suite_variable(HTTP_MODEL_DEPLOYED, TRUE)
    else:
        log(message='Skipping model deployment, it was marked as deployed in a previous test')
        open_data_science_project_details_page(HTTP_MODEL_NS,tab_id='model-server')
    host = get_kserve_inference_host_via_ui(ISVC_NAME)
    set_suite_variable(HTTP_HOST, host)

def get_start_time_and_end_time(interval):
    end_time = get_current_date()
    end_time = builtin.evaluate(f'datetime.datetime.fromisoformat("{end_time}").timestamp()')
    start_time = subtract_time_from_date(end_time, interval)
    start_time = builtin.evaluate(f'datetime.datetime.fromisoformat("{start_time}").timestamp()')
    time = create_list(start_time, end_time)
    return time

def wait_until_rollout_is_started(previous_pods, namespace, label_selector, comparison_fields="['metadata.name']", retries=5, retries_interval='5s'):
    log(previous_pods)
    for retry_idx in range(0, f'1+{retries}'):
        current_pods = oc_get(kind='Pod', namespace=namespace, label_selector=label_selector, fields=comparison_fields)
        log(current_pods)
        equal_flag = run_keyword_and_return_status('Should Not Be Equal As Strings', previous_pods, current_pods)
        exit_for_loop_if('$equal_flag == True')
        sleep(retries_interval)
    if equal_flag == False:
        fail('Rollout has not started...Please check your cluster')

def escape_string_chars(str, chars=DEFAULT_CHARS_TO_ESCAPE):
    for char in chars:
        str = replace_string(str, char, f'\\{char}')
    return str


def wait_until_new_log_lines_are_generated_in_a_dashboard_pod(prev_length, pod_name, retries=10, retries_interval='3s'):
    for retry_idx in range(0, f'1+{retries}'):
        pod_logs_lines, n_lines = get_dashboard_pod_logs(pod_name=pod_name)
        log(f'{n_lines} vs {prev_length}')
        equal_flag = run_keyword_and_return_status('Should Be True', f'"{n_lines}" > "{prev_length}"')
        exit_for_loop_if('$equal_flag == True')
        sleep(retries_interval)
    if equal_flag == False:
        fail('Something got wrong. Check the logs')
    return f'{pod_logs_lines}[{prev_length}:]', n_lines


def search_last_build(namespace, build_name_includes):
    build = run(f"oc get builds --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp -n {namespace} | grep {build_name_includes} | tail -n 1 | awk '{print $1;}'")
    if build == EMPTY:
        fail(msg=f'Could not find any build including {build_name_includes} in {namespace} namespace')
    builds = split_string(build, '\n')
    return f'{builds}[-1]'
